tei:div.tei:p: ༷spyo / sduX // // tram̐ spyaX raṃ /༷ ༷/ rdo ༷ saX /༷ ༷༷ sa50dzo 5650
༄0/ /'od kyi gso'ag skor gyi shes bya drisagan blo gsalaster mkho legasarigad sgo 'byed ces byarabazhugs so/ /lhamoskyed kyisabasgrigs/mirigasadaposkrun khang /

dkar chagale'u dang po/ lorgyus0 skor/ 1sa bcad dang po/ gso rig gi skor/ 1sa bcad gnyis pa/ rtsis kyi lo rgyus dang rmang gzhi'i shes bya'i skor/ 29le'u gnyis pa/ zang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 36sa bcad dang po/ rtsa rgyud/ 36sa bcad gnyis pa/ grub pa lus/ 42sa bcad gsum pa/ 'phel 'grib nad/ 62sa bcad bzhi pa/ tha mal nad med/ 70sa bcad lnga pa/ cha byad dpyad/ 73sa bcad drug pa/ ngos bzung rtags/ 82sa bcad bdun pa/ gso byed thabs/ 95sa bcad brgyad pa/ bya byed sman pa/ 99sa bcad dgu pa/ mjug don yongs gtad/ 101sa bcad bcu pa/ nyes gsum gso ba/ 107sa bcad bcu gcig pa/ khong nad gso ba/ 117

2 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/sa bcad bcu gnyis pa/ tsha ba gso ba/ 128sa bcad bcu gsum pa/ gnyan rims gso ba/ 137sa bcad bcu bzhi pa/ lus stod gso ba/ 142sa bcad bco lnga pa/ thor nad gso ba/ 147sa bcad bcu drug pa/ lhan skyes rma gso ba/ 154sa bcad bcu bdun pa/ byis pa gso ba/ 157sa bcad bco brgyad pa/ mo nad gso ba/ 160sa bcad bcu dgu pa/ gdon nad gso ba/ 163sa bcad nyi shu pa/ mtshon rma gso ba/ 167sa bcad nyer gcig pa/ dug nad gso ba/ 174le'u gsum pa/ man gyi skor/ 178sa bcad dang po/ sbyor ba sman/ 178sa bcad gnyis pa/ zhi byed sman sbyor/ 191sa bcad gsum pa/ sbyong byed las/ 205sa bcad bzhi pa/ sman sbyor kha thor gyi skor/ 209dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/ 222

le'u dngas/ 'o rgyus kyi skor/sa bcad dang po/ gso rig gi skor/1 'dzam gling gi srol rgyun gso rig chen po bzhi ni gang gang yin nam/lan/ de dag ni rgya gar gyi gso ba rig pa dang / bod kyi gso ba rig pa/ghi ri si'i gso ba rig pa/ rgya nag gi gso ba rig pa bcas yin/2 bodakyi gtam rgyud du nad dang / nad pa/ sman/ sman pa bcas kyi snga ba gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ nad la snga ba ma zhu ba dang / nad pa la snga ba shed bu/ sman la snga ba chu khol/ sman pa la snga ba tshangs pa yin pa 'jig rten du grags/2 gso rig 'bum bzhi zhes pa sus mdzad pa dang / 'bum bzhi po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ bon gyi sman dpe 'bum bzhi ni ston pa gshen rab mi bo che dang de'i gdung sras gnyis pa dpyad bu khri shes gnyis kyis zhu ba zhus lan gyi tshul du gsungs shing mdzad pa dang / bon gyi bka' 'gyur khrod bzhugs pa'i

2 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bdud rtsi bang mdzod 'bum bzhi'i mdo zhes pa de yin par bshad/ 'bum bzhi po ni rtsa ba thugs 'bum mkha' sngon dang / sman 'bum dkar po/dpyad 'bum khra bo/ nad 'bum nag po bcas so/ /4 dug la sman yod ces pa'i bzhed tshul 'di bod rgyal su'i sku ring du byung ba yin nam/ de las nga chos don ci 'dra zhig go thub bam/lan/ bod rgyal dang po gnya' khri btsan po rgyal sar 'khod skabs rje khong gis gdan 'dren pa rnams la dogs pa drug bton pa'i don tshan lnga pa ni dug yod ces gsungs pa la/ rtsibs lha skar ma yol sde zhes pa'i shes pa can des dug la sman yod ces lan btab/ de las go thub pa ni skabs de dus nas bod la sman dpyad kyi rig pa dar nas dug gam nad kyi sdug bsngal sel byed la sman dpyad kyi thabs yod pa shes thub pas gso dpyad kyi tshad gzhi nges can zhig la slebs yod pa gsal lo/ /5 dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo mdzad pa po ni su yin nam/lan/ dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo ni ston pa shākya thub pa'i gsung rab la mdo sngags gnyis su phye zhing / mdo la'ang 'dul ba dang mngon pa/mdo sde ste sde snod gsum du grags pa las mdo 'di nyid ni theg pa chen po'i mdo'i khongs su gtogs shing / gso rig gi gzhung dang nye bar 'brel ba'i gsung rab kyi gras yin no/ /6 sbyor ba brgya pa dang rtsa a wa'i cho ga'i mdzad pa po su yin nam/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 3lan/ gzhung de gnyis kyi mdzad pa po ni rgya gar rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi ya rgyal slob dpon klu sgrub mchog yin no/ /7 bod0grol po su'i ring la 'phags yul gyi gso dpyad bod la thog mar dar ba yin/lan/ bod kyi rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sku ring la rgya gar gyi sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang bi lha dga' mdzes ma bya ba'i ming sring gnyis bod du phebs nas lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la bod du rgya gar gyi sman dpyad spel te bod la dar ba red// lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi skabs su gso dpyad kyi dbu brnyes zer ba nges sam ma nges/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi skabs su gso dpyad kyi dbu brnyes zer ba ni ma nges te/ gang lags she na/ btsan po de'i sngun la bon gyi ston pa gshin rab mi bo che'i sku dus nas dar ba'i bod rang gi gso dpyad ji snyed cig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /9 sman pa dung gi thor cog can gyi yab yum gnyisaskul gang gi mi yin/mtshan la ci zer/lan/ yab ni rgya gar gyi sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang / yum ni lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sras mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha yin/10 sras dung gi thor cog can gyis rang nyid kyi yab chen las gso

4 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/dpyad kyi mdo lnga bslab pa'i mdo lnga bo de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ gso dpyad kyi mdo lnga zhes pa ni reg pa rtsa yi mdo/ 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ sbyor ba sman gyi mdo/ rma chas bzo ba'i mdo/ gtar bsreg dpyad kyi mdo bcas lnga'o/ /11 bod kyi yig thog tu bkod pa'i rgyal po rnams la bla sman bsko bzhag gnang ba'i lugs srol de btsan po su'i skabs la dar ba yin/ bla sman thog ma de su yin nam/lan/ rgyal po'i snyun gso zhing gegs sel bar byed pa'i sku gshen re bsten pa'i lugs srol bod rgyal dang po gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs nas yod par bshad kyang / yig thog tu bkod pa'i rgyal po la bla sman bsko bzhag gnang ba de bod kyi rgyal po nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi skabs nas dar ba yin/ bla sman thog ma nyid ni sman pa dung gi thor cog can yin la/sman pa des lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sku tshe smad kyi bla sman gnang ba ma zad/lha tho tho ri'i sras bod rgyal nyer dgu ba khri gnyan gzung btsan gyi sku tshe stod kyi bla sman yang mdzad do/ /12 bod kyi lo rgyas thog rgyal po su la mdze nad byung nas gson por dur du bzhugs pa yin/lan/ bod kyi rgyal rabs sum cu pa 'brong gnyan lde ru la mdze nad byung nas skabs de dus nas bod rigs mdzangs mi rnams kyis nad de ni gcig

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 5nas gcig la 'gos 'gro ba zhig yin pa shes rtogs byung ste/ mi gzhan la 'gos khyab mi 'gro ba'i ched rgyal po nyid gson por dur du bzhugs pa yin/12 bod kyi sman pas mig nad bar 'gribs thur mas phye pa nas da bar lo ci tsam phyin yod/ khungs gtug sa gang yin/lan/ bod kyi sman pas mig nad bar 'gribs thur mas gshags bcos byas nas spyi lo 2009lo'i bar lo 1424tsam phyin yod/ de'i khungs gtug sa ni bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs so gcig pa stag ri gnyan gzigs ni bod lcags byi lo ste spyi lo 580lor 'khrungs par bshad la/ khong 'khrungs dus nas dmus long yin pas mtshan la dmus long dkon pa bkras zhes btags/sras dgung lo lngar phebs dus bod kyi shar phyogs kyi rgyal phran 'a zha'i yul nas 'a zha rje zhes pa'i sman pa bos te spyan thur mas phye pa legs grub byung nas/skyid shod stag mo ri na ri dwags gnyan gyis rtswa za ba mthong nas rgyal po'i mtshan bsgyur te stag ri gnyan gzigs zhes gsol ba lo rgyus kyi deb ther rnams su shin tu gsal ba 'di'o/ /14 rgya nag gi gso dpyad kyi gzhung lugs sman dpyad chen mo pod yig tu bsgyur mkhan su yin nam/lan/ rgya nag gi sras mo wun shing kong jo bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor phebs dus bsnams pa'i sman dpyad chen mo de rgya nag gi sman pa hwa shang ma hā de ba dang bod kyi lo tsā ba dharma ko ṣa gnyis kyis bod yig

6 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/tu bsgyur ba yin/15 mi 'jigs pa'i mchon cha ni dus rabs nam zhig la mkhas pa sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus la 'phags yul gyi sman pa bha ra rda dza dang rgya nag gi sman pa lhan wan hang de/ stag gzig gi sman pa ga le nos sam 'jo ro bcas gso rig gi sman pa mkhas pa gsum bod kyi rgyal po'i snyun gso bar spyan drangs pa de gsum gyis mnyam bgros sgos bod kyi gnam gshes dang sa babs la mthun pa'i gzhung chen po 'di gsar du brtsams par bshad/16 bod0sgyul rabs so bzhi ba gung ri gung btsan dang so lnga ba mang srong mang btsan gnyis0 bla sman sus gnang ba yin/lan/ bod rgyal 'di gnyis kyi bla sman ni yab blo gros bshes gnyen (srong btsan sgam po'i bla sman )dang yum jo mo dkon cog bzang mo gnyis kyi sras 'dre rje rgya gar badz+ras gnang ba yin/17 g.yu thog pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'di thog mar man pa su la thogs pa yin/ mtshan de ltar btags pa'ir+gha mtshan ci/lan/ g.yu thog pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'di thog mar 'dre rje rgya gar badz+ra la thogs pa yin/ mtshan de ltar 'dogs dgos don sngar gyi gtam rgyud ltar na/sman pa mkhas pa 'di nyid stod lung skyid snar bzhugs skabs nad pa tshabs

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 7chen zhig nad las grol bar mdzad pa'i bya dga' la bud med rked pa yan chad gser g.yus brgyan pa'i ro gcig chur bskur te 'dre rje rgya gar badz+ra la gnang ba de'i rgyan cha tshags byas nas rang gi khang thog tu bkrams nas bskam pa phyugs rdzi zhig gis mthong ste/ rgya gar badz+ra la g.yu'i thog phub 'dug byas pa las g.yu thog pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs par grags/ de'i rjes 'dre rje rgya gar badz+ra'i gdung rgyud phyi ma rnams la g.yu thog pa zhes thogs pa yin/1〈 sman dpyadazla ba'i la po dus nam zhig la byung ba yin/ gzhung 'di mdzad mkhan su yin nam/lan/ sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po'am so ma rā dza zhes pa'i gzhung 'di nyid bod kyi rgyal rabs sum cu so bdun pa khri lde gtsug brtan nam mes ag tshom gyi sku dus la byung zhing / sus mdzad pa'i skor la lo rgyus kyi deb ther rnams su bzhed tshul 'dra min mang du mchis kyang / deng sang rgya nag gi sman pa ha shang ma hā kyin da dang bod kyi sman pa khyung po tse tse sogs mkhas pa mang pos bod kyi sngar dar gso rig gi gzhung lugs khag la gzhi bcol ba dang gso dpyadagasar bsgyur rnams kyi snying po blangs te/ bod kyi yul dus dbang bo dang 'tshams pa zhig zhib 'jug bka' bgros mdzad nas gsar du btsams pa ste/ mdor na kong sprul yon tan rgyal mtshos mkhas mang bgros pas so ma rā dza byung zhes pa 'di la mkhas pa rnams zhal mthun byung yod/19 g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po'i 'khrungs lo dang 'khrungs

8 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/yul gang yin/ yab yum gyi mtshan la ci zer/lan/ spyi lo 708lo ste bod sa sprel lor yab g.yu thog khyung po rdo rje dang /yum rgya sa chos kyi sgron me gnyis kyi sras su g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po stod lung skyid sna zhes par 'khrungs/20 chos la khri srong lde btsan gyis rgyal srid thog mar skyong dus sman pa sprul ba'i sras gsum du grags pa de gang dang gang yin/lan/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan nam tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis rgyal srid thog mar bzhes skabs sngar yab mes kyi dus su gdan drangs pa'i rgya nag gi sman pa ha shang ma hā kyin da dang / stod phyogs nas gdan drangs pa'i tsan pa shi la ha/ btsan po khong gis gdan 'dren zhus pa'i rgya gar gyi sman pa dharmā rā dza bcas gsum la sprul ba'i sras gsum du grags/21 phyogs rigs0 man pa dgu zhes pa su su yin/lan/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus la 'phags yul nas shin+ta shan+ti dang / kha che nas gubya badz+ra/ rgya nag nas stong gsum gang ba/ ha shang ba la/hang ti pa ta gsum/ stag gzig nes ha la shan+ti/ gru gu nas seng mdo 'od chen/ dol po nas khyol ma ru rtse/ bal bo nas rnyarma shī la rnams mtha' bzhi nas byon pa la phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgu'am rgyal po'i bla sman dgu zhes grags/22 man pa'i ming la 'cho byed sman pa dang lha rje zhes ming 'dogs

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 9mkhan gyi rgyal po su dang su yin/lan/ 'tsho byed sman pa zhes pa ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos sman pa rnams la gnang ba'i go thob kyi mtshan snyan zhig dang / lha rje zhes pa'i ming 'di ni khri srong lde btsan gyis sman pa rnams la che bstod mdzad pa'i mtshan snyan yin/22 'jam dbyangs sngo 'bum dang sgrol ma sngo 'bum bsgyur mkhan gyi lo tsā ba su yin nam/lan/ 'jam dbyangs sngo 'bum ni be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur ba dang / sgrol ma sngo 'bum ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la rgya gar gyi mkhan po sharnyi gar+bha dang gzhan bla sman bdun gyis mdzad pa de sharnyi gar+bhas bsgyur bar grags/24 bod kyi lo rgyas thog gso rig gi slob grwa dang po de dus nam zhig la mkhas pa sus yul gang du btsugs pa yin/ der khyad chos ci yod/lan/ spyi lo 763lor g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pos kong po'i sman lung du bod kyi lo rgyus thog gso rig gi slob grwa dang po btsugs pa yin/de dus slob ma sum brgya tsam 'du zhing / rjes su slob ma stong tsam yod pa'i nang sman pa bud med cig kyang yod par bshad/ slob grwa'i ming la sman gyi dgon pa lta na sdug ces zer/ slob bu rnams la rgyud bzhi cha lag kha skong dang bcas pa slob khrid gnang / 25 dus da lta'ang spyod bzhin pa'i sman pa'i lag rtsal gyi go rim dbye

10 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/stangs 'di srol 'dod mkhan su yin nam/ dus nam zhig la dar ba yin/lan/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng sman pa'i lag rtsal gyi go rim dbye stangs srol 'dod mkhan ni g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po yin/ khong gis spyi lo 763lor kong po'i sman lung du gso rig gi slob grwa 'dzugs skabs sman pa rnams kyi lag rtsal rim pa dang po sman pa 'bum rams pa dang / rim pa gnyis pa sman pa rab 'byams pa/ rim pa gsum pa sman pa bka' bcu pa/rim pa bzhi ba sman pa bsdus ra pa bcas go rim bzhi la dbye ba yin/26 bod sman mkhas pa mi dgu po su su yin/lan/ bod sman mkhas pa mi dgu ni stod na cher rje zhig po dang / zhug pa chos bzang / bi byi legs mgon gsum/ bar na g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po dang / mi nyag rong rje/ brang ti rgyal bzang gsum/ smad du gnya' ba chos bzang dang / mtha' bzhi dar po/ stong pa grags rgyal gsum bcas dgu'o/ /27 yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa dang de'i 'grel ba zla zer bod du bsgyuramakhan su yin nam/lan/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa dang de'i 'grel ba kha che paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mngon dgas mdzad pa'i zla zer gnyis ni bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po mchog gis bod yig tu bsgyur te gtan la phab pa

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 11yin/28 rgyud bzhi gter ma'i lugs kyi brgyud rim rags tsam ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gter ma'i lugs ni thog mar chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang lo chen be+e ro tsa na rnam gnyis kyis dpal ldan rgyud bzhi bsam yas dbu rtse'i bar khang gi ka ba bum pa can du gter du sbas pa de spyi lo 1038lor gter ston grwa ba mngon shes kyis gter nas bton te bu dpe bzos/ phyis su bu dpe de dbus pa dar ma grags par gnang / des rog ston dkon mchog skyabs la gnang / des g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon por gnang / des sum stonaye shes gzungs la spel pa ni gter ma'i lugs kyi dar tshul rags tsam mo/ /29 rang gi bla ma la blang thur rgyag skabs thur log byung nas bla ma dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / mthar rang nyid kyang cing thur gyi thal skyon las gshegs pa'i mkhas pa de su yin nam/lan/ gter ston grwa ba mngon shes kyis rang gi bla ma gzus la snying chu bsags pa sman gyis ma 'drongs pas/ snyun gso ba'i ched du snying thur rgyag skabs thur log tu song nas grongs/ mthar grwa ba mngon shes rang nyid kyang dgung lo bdun cu don dgu'i thog rang gi slob ma la lag len bslab ched snying thur brgyab pa thal skyon byung nas zhi bar gshegs/

12 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/20 rje btsun mi la ras par nyi zla lta bu'i slob bu gnyis yod pa'i nyi ma lta bu de ni suyin nam/ mtshan gzhan la ci zer/lan/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i nyi ma lta bu'i thugs sras ni mnyam med dwags po lha rje yin/ dwags sman 'tsho byed/ dge slong 'tsho byed/ zla 'od gzhon nu sogs ni khong gi mtshan yin/21 g.yu thog gsar ma'i 'khrungs lo dang 'khrungs yul gang yin/yab yum gyi mtshan la ci zer/lan/ bod rab byung gnyis pa'i me rta lo ste spyi lo 1126lor g.yu thog rnying ma'i rigs las mched pa'i gdung rabs bcu gsum pa g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po gtsang nyang stod kyi sgo bzhi re thang du yab g.yu thog khyung po rdo rje dang / yum pad+ma 'od ldan gnyis kyi rigs kyi myu gur 'khrungs zhes lo rgyus kyi deb ther phal mo che ru gsungs 'dug22 g.yu thog gsar rnying rnam gnyis bod kyi gso rig gi ched du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du thengs du la phebs/lan/ rgya gar yul la lan gsum byon/ / gnad zab man ngag du ma blangs/ / zhes pa ltar g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po rgya gar la thengs gsum dang / g.yu thog gsar ma thengs drug la phebs pa yin/22 g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i thugs sras gsum ni su dang su yin nam/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 13lan/ g.yu thog gsar ma'i thugs sus gsum ni sum ston ye shes gzungs dang / 'bal sman nyi ma dpal/ nyid kyi sras g.yu thog 'bum seng gsum yin/ 24 bu don ma zhes pa'i gzhung 'di ni mkhas pa gus gang gi ched du mdzad pa yin/lan/ gzhung 'di ni g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon pos gso dpyad kyi gnad bsdus te bu slob rnams kyi don du mdzad par zhu'o/ /25 rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba thams cad kyi thog ma de gang dang mdzad mkhan su red/ khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma su yin nam/lan/ rgyud 'grel thams cad kyi thog ma ni g.yu thog gsar ma'i thugs sras gtso bo sum ston ye shes gzungs kyis mdzad pa'i bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba 'bum nag gsal sgron yin par grags/26 gso dpyad la po'i dkor mdzod mdzad mkhan su yin/lan/ gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ni sa skya gong ma lnga'i ya gyal rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gso rig gtsug lag las byung ba'i nye mkho'i sman sbyor dang man ngag bcos thabs sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu sdebs nas bsgrigs pa yin/27 bod la dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i phyag len nyams pa slar gso mdzad mkhan su yin nam/

14 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ grub chen u rgyan pas 'phags yul gyi slob dpon byā da lis mdzad pa'i dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos bod du bsgyur ba ma zad/ sngar rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pos srol btod pa'i dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bar skabs gcig la rgyun chad pa de'i phyag len gyi rgyun slar mthud pa red/2/ sman ming rgya mcho dang sngo 'bum sman gyi gter mdzod mdzad mkhan su yin nam/lan/ sman ming rgya mtsho ni grub chen u rgyan pa'i thugs sras kyi dam par gyur pa'i kurma rang byung rdo rje yis mdzad pa yin la/ sngo 'bum sman gyi gter mdzod ni byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang gi slob ma mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don ldan gyis mdzad pa yin/29 zang ti'i mkhas pa su nas bzung zang ti'i brgyud pas sa skya'i bla sman byas pa yin/ sa skya man grong zhes pa'i mtshan de mkhas pa su'i skabs nas dar ba yin/lan/ brang ti rgyal mnyes mkhar phug nas bzung brang ti'i brgyud pa chos rgyal gyi bla sman du dbang bskur zhing / brang ti 'jam dpal bzang po nas bzung brang ti'i brgyud pa gtso bo sa skyar 'phos nas phyis su sa skya sman grong pa zhes mtshan chags/4༷ man ngag gser bre dngul bre sus mdzad pa yin nam/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 15lan/ man ngag gser bre dngul bre ni brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i legs bshad yin/41 brangalta dpal ldan 'tsho byed rgyal po su'i bla sman du dbang bskur ba dang / mkhas pa des mdzad pa'i rtsa da kyi 'grel ba'i mtshan la ci zer/lan/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bla sman mdzad pa dang / khong gis rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba rgyud don rab gsal bcoms pa yin/42 yongs grags su ril dkar dang ril dmar zhes pa'i sman mchog 'di gnyis sbyar mkhan suyin nam/lan/ nad brgya sman gcig gi tshul du 'du ba spyi snyoms kyi sman ril bu dkar po ste grub thob ril dkar dang / gnyan rims sogs phyi nang gi nad phal che la bsngags pa'i ril bu dmar po gnyis ni grub chen thang stong rgyal pos gsar du sbyar ba yin/42 bod sman mkhas pas brtsams pa'i rgyud bzhi bslab/ / ces pa 'di mkhas pa gu'i gsungs yin/lan/ bod sman mkhas pas btsams pa'i rgyud bzhi bslab ces pa 'di ni bo dong paṇ+ḍi ta phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsungs yin/44 stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis rtsa chu'i sgo nas nad brtag pa ni bod kyi mkhas pa'i lugs yin par bshad pa'i mig cha tshang de ji

16 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa chu'i sgo nas nad ngos 'dzin pa ni/ / rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gsungs pa med/ / bod kyi sman pa byang chub sems dpas mdzad/ /ces gsungs/45 byang lugs dang zur lugs zhes lugs chen po gnyis yod pa de dus rabs gang nas de 'dra'i dbye srol dar ba dang / lugs de gnyis kyi srol 'dod mkhan su yin pa/ byang lugs dang zur lugs la khyad chos ci 'dra yod/lan/ bod lugs gso rig gi lo rgyus thog byang lugs dang zur lugs zhes lugs srol chen po gnyis yod pa de dus rabs bco lnga ba tsam nas dar ba'i 'go tshugs shing / byang lugs kyi thog ma'i srol btod pa po ni byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang dang / zur lugs kyi thog ma'i srol btod byed po ni zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje yin/byang lugs kyi khyad chos gtso bo ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i 'grel lugs dang / sman dpyad bya thabs gang thad gtsang stod byang ngos kyi sa bab dang gnam gshes sogs kyi khyad chos la bstun nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nasagatsang stod byang phyogs khul du bod lugs gso rig gi bstan pa rgya cher spel nas dpal ldan byang lugs zhes pa'i srol chen de nyid gtad/ de la yul gyi dbang gis byang lugs sam stod lugs zhes brjod pa yin/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 17zur lugs kyi khyad chos ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i 'grel lugs dang /sman dpyad bya thabs sogs bod lho rong khul gyi sa babs dang / gnam gshes/'tsho ba spyod stangs bcas tsha khul gyi khyad chos dngos dang bstun nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas lho rong rgyud du bod lugs gso rig gi bstan pa rgya cher spel nas dpal ldan zur lugs zhes pa'i srol chen de nyid gtad/ de la yul gyi dbang gis smad lugs zhes brjod tshul yang mchis/46 byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang dang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje rnam gnyis0 'khrungs lo dang 'khrungs yul gang yin nam/lan/ byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang mchog ni bod rab byung bdun pa'i shing phag lo ste/ spyi lo 1395lor gtsang stod ngam ring du yab gu'i gung chos grags dpal bzang dang yum 'bum skyong rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs pa dang / zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'am dharma su mi ni bod rab byung bdun pa'i sa lug lo ste/ spyi lo 1439lor shar dwags po la thog zur mkhar du yab rig 'dzin phun tshogs dang / yum kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi lcam mo zung gi rigs kyi myu gur 'khrungs pa yin/47 yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po btus pa yid bzhin nor bu dang bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba bdud rtsi'i chu na gnyis mdzad mkhan su yin nam/lan/ gzhung 'di gnyis ni byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang gi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i legs par bshad pa red/

18 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/4ra man ngag bye ba ring bsrel sus mdzad pa yin/ mtshan de ltar 'dogs dgos pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ man ngag bye ba ring bsrel ni zur lugs kyi srol gtod mkhan zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje yis mdzad pa yin te/ gzhung 'di po ti ring bsrel tsam gyi nang du man ngag bye ba 'dus yod pas man ngag bye ba ring bsrel zhes grags/49 zar mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje la gso rig gi mthar phyin slob ma bzhi yod pa de su dang su yin/lan/ rje 'di nyid kyi mthar phyin slob ma bzhi ni man ngag mthar phyin mi 'gyur tshe brtan dang / 'phrin las mthar phyin phrag dbon bsod nams bkra shis/ lag len mthar phyin tshe 'bum rdo rje/ bshad pa mthar phyin li chung pad+ma skyabs bcas yin/50 byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang gi gso rig slob ma dang bla sman zung du 'brel pa de su yin nam/lan/ de ni mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don ldan nam byams pa dkon mchog rin chen zhu ba de yin/51 bsod nams ye shes rgyal mtshan su'i bla sman du dbang bskur ba dang / khong gis mdzad pa'i bshad rgyud kyi 'grol ba skad grags can de'i mtshan la ci zer/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 19lan/ bsod nams ye shes rgyal mtshan rin spungs pa'i bla sman du dbang bskur zhing / khong gis bshad rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri med kun gsal mdzad pa yin/52 gso ba rig pa'i gzhung rgyud don cing po dgos 'dod kun 'byung mdzad mkhan dang da bzhi par du brko mkhan su yin nam/lan/ de ni lhun sdings bdud rtsi 'gyur med yin/52 gong sman dkon tsog bde legs kyi rtsom gtso bo dag ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ gong sman par grags pa'i lugs la mchog tu gyur pa'i mkhas dbang 'dis mdzad pa'i legs bshad gtso bo ni gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung ngam bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes pa dang / man ngag po ti dmar po/ pod nag pod phra bcas yin/54 nyams yig brgya rtsa sus mdzad pa red/lan/ nyams yig brgya rtsa ni gong sman dkon mchog 'phan dar gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i legs bshad yin/55 skyem pa che dbang gis mdzad pa'i rgyad bzhi'i rnam bshad kyi rgyud so so'i 'grel ba'i ming la ci zer/lan/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba legs bshad smra ba'i mchog thob/ bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba tshig don nyi ma/ man ngag rgyud kyi 'grel ba bde ba'i 'dod

20 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'jo/ phyi ma rgyud kyi 'grel ba lag len gsal byed bcas lags so/ /56 zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i brtsams chos gtso po dag ni gang dang gang yin/lan/ mkhas mchog 'di'i bcoms chos gtso bo la rtsa bshad chu mdo yan gyi 'grel ba mes po'i zhal lung dang / rdo ring mdzes byed kyi dris lan rgan po'i kha chems mtshan mo mun nag gi glog 'od lta bu/ drang srong mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam thar 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po/ gso rig chos 'byung shes bya spyi'i khog 'bugs bcas yod/57 gru thang rgyud bzhi thog mar par du brkomakhan su yin nam/lan/ gso rig lo rgyus thog grwa thang rgyud bzhi zhes skad grags che ba'i gzhung 'di ni zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos zhu dag gnang nas thengs dang por par du brkos pa yin/5/ 'bri gung pa'i lugs srol 'dod mkhan su yin pa dang lugs de byang zur gnyis las gang gi khongs su gtogs pa yin/lan/ 'bri lugs kyi srol 'dod mkhan ni 'bri gung chos grags yin la/lugs 'di bod kyi gso rig gi lo rgyus steng byang lugs dang zur lugs zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i zur lugs kyi khongs su gtogs/59 rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos bod kyi gso ba rig par mdzad rjes gtso bo gang dang gang bzhag yod/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 21lan/ kun mkhyen lnga pa rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog gis gso rig thad bzhag pa'i bla med kyi mdzad rjes gtso bo ni cha lag bco brgyad dang mes po'i zhal lung cha tshang / g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar bcas la par gzhi gsar du brkos nas par du bskrun par mdzad pa dang /lhag par gso dpyad kyi bstan pa dar rgyas gong 'phel yong ched 'bras spungs pho brang nub mar gso rig 'gro phan gling dang gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtser drang srong 'dus pa'i gling ste gso rig slob grwa khag gnyis btsugs/ da dung rin chen grang sbyor chen mo sogs rin chen ril bu mang po tshul bzhin sbyor bzo byed par mi dman pa'i thugs rje bskyangs te 'gro phan gyi mdzad pa bla na mngon par 'phags so/ /60 dus nam zhig la dpal ldanargyud bzhi sog yig tu bskyur ba yin/lan/ spyi lo dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang rgyal dbang lnga pa'i skabs su nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs bod kyi mkhas pa mang po snga phyir sog yul du phebs nas chos dang rig gnas mang du spel/ dus de tsam du dpal ldan rgyud bzhi sog yig tu bsgyur/61 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mcho'i 'khrungs lo dang 'khrungs yul gang yin/ mkhas mchog 'di'i gso rig skor gyi jigs rtsom gtso po gang gang yin/lan/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul lo ste/ spyi lo 1653lor lha sa grong khyer gyi byang phyogs nyang bran grong smad

22 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gzhis kur yab a sug dang yum bu khrid rgyal mo'i sras su 'khrungs/ mkhas dbang 'di'i sman gyi bstan bcos la man rgyud kyi lhan thabs zug rngu'i tsha gdung sel ba'i gzu ra dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri dang / rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba be+eḍūr+ya sngon po/ gso rig khog 'bugs drang srong dgyes pa'i dga' ston sogs yod/62 ji srid sangs rgyas rgya mchos bzhengs pa'i rgyud bzhi'i man bang gi da so sor mtshon khra can gyi man thang du re yod/lan/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bod du skad grags yod pa'i lha 'bri pa rnams bsdus nas rtsa ba'i rgyud la sman thang bzhi dang / bshad pa'i rgyud la sum cu so lnga/ man ngag rgyud la bcu drug phyi ma rgyud la nyi shu rtsa bzhi bcas gzhung don tshang ba'i sman thang bdun cu don dgu dang / de'i steng du bla rgyud kyi thang ga gcig bzhengs nas bsdoms pas sman thang ngo grangs brgyad cu yod/62 lcags po ri'i sman pa grwa tshang dus nam zhig la sus phyag btab pa yin/lan/ bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me byi lo ste spyi lo 1696lor mi'i dbang bo sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog gis lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs pa yin/64 dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyi ljags rtsom gtso bo gang gang yin/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 23lan/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i sku'i bla sman dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyi ljags rtsom gtso bo dag ni man ngag bka' rgya ma dang /man rgyud dang phyi ma rgyud chu mdo'i man gyi 'grel ba mes po'i zhal lung / phyi ma rgyud kyi mchan 'grel bka' phreng mun sel sgron me bcas yin/65 si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis btsugs pa'i gso rig gi slob grwa de gang yin nam/lan/ mdo khams sde dge dpal spungs chos 'khor gling du gso rig gis mtshon pa'i rig gnas bshad grwa btsugs nas sku ngo mas gso rig bstan pa'i byed po mang du gso skyong mdzad pa yin/66 de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun chogs kyi 'khrungs lo dang 'khrungs yul gang yin nam/lan/ bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu glang lo ste spyi lo 1672lor chab mdo go 'jo rdzong du 'khrungs/ bi byi'i gdung brgyud yin par bshad/ de'u dmar zhes pa ni 'khrungs yul go 'jo'i gser dga' zhes grong tsho'i 'gram na ri de'u dmar po zhig yod pa'i nye logs mtshams khang brgyab nas bzhugs pas mtshan de ltar byung /67 deng sang sman rdzas rig pa'i bstan bcos tshad ldan du bzung dang 'dzin bzhin pa'i shel gong phreng zhes pa 'di'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ gzhung 'di ni de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs mchog gis

24 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lo du ma'i ring rgya gar nag dang bod khams kyi yul gru kun tu sku dngos su phebs nas 'dri rtsad brtag dpyad gang legs gnang ste brtsams pa yin/68 bde ba'i srin bu dbyung mi bya/ / phyung na zungs rnams dbyung dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa dang / lus kyi zungs khrag brtan gyur na/ / snying 'phyungab dang khyad par med/ / ces pa'i lung 'di gnyis mkhas pa su dang su'i gsungs yin/lan/ lung sdun ma ni de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi gsungs yin la/ phyi ma ni a tsa ra phyag rdum gyi gsungs yin/69 kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i gso rig skor gyi brtsams chos ches gtso che ba de gang yin pa dang / de labad chos ci 'dra yod/lan/ mkhas mchog 'di'i gso rig skor gyi brtsams chos ches gtso bo ni zin tig gces bsdus bdud rtsi'i thigs pa yin/ gzhung 'di'i nang rgyun mthong gi nad rigs brgya lhag gi gso thabs dang / gzhan yang sman 'dul tshul dang nus 'don byed tshul gyi lag len rnams tshig bde zhing go sla ba/lag len du bstar bde ba bcas mkhas rmongs kun gyis rtogs sla bar bkod yod pas deng sang gi sman pa rnams la med du mi rung ba'i deb cig tu gyur yod/70 zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi sman mdzod mdzad mkhan su yin pa dang gzhung 'di'i nang don gtso bo ci yin nam/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 25lan/ zin tig mdzes rgyan ni dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i nang o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa yin la/ 'di'i nang zin tig gces bsdus su 'khod pa'i nad de dag gi gso ba la nye bar mkho ba'i sman gyi sdeb yig rnams bkod yod/71 sman bsdus e waṃ zhes pa de gnyis kyi ming gzhan la ci zer/gzhung 'di gnyis mkhas pa sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ sman bsdus e yi ming gzhan la phan bde bsil zer 'phro ba'i zla ba gsar ba zer ba dang / sman bsdus waṃ yi ming gzhan la phan bde nor bu'i bang mdzod zer/ gzhung 'di gnyis ni si tu'i dngos slob kurma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa yin/72 sku 'bum gyi gso rig dar rgyas gzhan phan nor bu'i gling zhes pa de dus nam zhig la mkhas pa sus phyag btab pa yin/lan/ bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags yos lo ste/ spyi lo 1711lor rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin chu bzang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sku 'bum byams pa gling du don la sman pa grwa tshang btsugs kyang re zhig ming la sngags pa grwa tshang zhes thogs pa de btsugs pa yin/72 bla zang bkra shis 'khyil gyi sman pa grwa tshang dus nam zhig la sus phyag btab pa yin/

26 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku phreng gnyis pa kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing 'brug lo ste/ spyi lo 1724lor sku nyid kyis gdan sa bla brang bkra shes 'khyil du sman pa grwa tshang gso rig gzhan phan gling phyag btab pa yin/74 bla zang bkra shis 'khril gyi sman pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon thog ma de su yin nam/lan/ bla brang sman pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon thog ma ni lcags ri bla sman chen po thabs mkhas pa mchog gi thugs zin gyi slob ma mched bzhi'i dang po gtsang sman ye shes bzang po yin/75 brong khyer chen po pe cin gyi g.yung hā dgon nam dga' ldan byin chags gling gi bod lugs gso rig slob grwa de dus nam zhig la btsugs pa yin/ lan/ gong ma chan lung khrir bzhugs dgu ba'i sku dus te/ bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang(spyi lo 1745)lor dga' ldan byin chags gling du gso rig slob grwa btsugs nas ris med kyi slob ma skyed sring byas pa yin/76 lha sa'i sman rtsis khang dus nam zhig la sus phyag btab pa dang /sman rtsis khang gi dbu khrid dang po su yin nam/lan/ bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i me 'brug lo ste/ spyi lo 1916lor rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis gso rig gi slob grwa chen mo bod ljongs lha sa'i sman rtsis 'gro phan gling zhes pa gsar du btsugs pa

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 27dang / dbu khrid dang po ni sku nyid kyi bla sman gzhon pa'am chung ba mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu yin/77 byis pa btsa' thabs kun phan zla ba'i me long zhes pa de sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ de ni mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis mdzad pa yin no/ /7〈 bod0 lo rgyus steng gi mo nad dang sbu gu'i sde khag thog ma de dus nam zhig la gsar du btsugs pa yin/ sde khag de'i dbu khrid dang po su yin nam/lan/ spyi lo 1962lor mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu'i sku drin las lha sa'i sman rtsis khang du bod kyi lo rgyus steng gi mo nad dang phru gu'i sde khag thog mgasar du btsugs nas ched las can gyi sman bcos bya thabs dang do dam lam lugs kyi rnam pa gsar ba thon/ bud med sman pa mkhas chen dbyangs can lha mo(mtshan gzhan la mkha' 'gro dbyangs dga' yang zer)ni mig 'byed lag rtsal gyi yang rtser phyin pa ma zad/ mo nad dang byis pa'i nad la'ang shin tu mkhas phyir sman rtsis khang gi mo nad dang phru gu'i sde khag gi dbu 'dzin dang por bsko bzhag gnang /79 nad thog lag len bad nye bar mkho ba'i gso rig snying bsdus skya rengs gsar ba mdzad mkhan su yin nam/

28 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ de ni bod ljongs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo bsam gtan lags yin/ra0 deng sang bod kyi che rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshad mar 'dzin bzhin pa'i skad grags can gyi gso rig chig mdzod g.yu thog dgongs rgyan zhes pa 'di sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ de ni bod ljongs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo go 'jo dbang 'dus dgung lo sum cu so gnyis kyi steng du brtsams pa yin//1 gangs ljongs gso rig bstan pa'i nyin byed rim byon gyi rnam thar phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa 'di mdzad mkhan su yin nam/lan/ 'di ni deng dus kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa 'phrin las mchog gis brtsams pa yin/〈2 bdud rtsi sman gyi 'khrungs dpe legs bshad nor bu'i phreng mdzes sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ sman rdzas rig pa'i bstan bcos 'di ni kurma chos 'phel mchog gis rtsom sgrig byas pa yin/82 bod ljongs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge gan chen mo dga' bo'i rdorjes mdzad pa'i sman gyi 'khrungs dpe chen mo de'i mtshan la ci zer/lan/ dge dga' bo lags kyis bcoms pa'i sman gyi 'khrungs dpe chen mo'i mtshan la 'khrungs dpe dri med shel gyi me long zer/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 29/4 gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen drang srong zhal lung sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ 'grel chen 'di ni deng dus kyi mkhas pa'i khyu mchog khro ru tshe rnam mchog gis brtsams pa yin no/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ rtsisakyi lo rgyus dang zang gzhi'i shes bya'i skor/1 bod la dus gang gi che rtsis rig thog mar dar ba yin/lan/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo nyis brgya yas mas su bod kyi rgyal po thog ma gnya' khri btsan po byon/ de'i dus su rgyu yi bon shes pa can bcu gnyis zhes pa byung ste/ phan shes sman dpyad kyis nad gso bas tshe'i bar chad med pa/skor shes rtsis mkhan gyis rtsis 'debs pas snga phyi'i ltas bzung ba sogs las gnya' khri'i yar sngon nas bod la zla skar brtsi srol yod pa shes/2 skar rtsis dang nag rtsis gnyis yul gang dang gang nas bod la dar ba yin nam/lan/ skar rtsis ni rgya gar gyi gzhung chen mo dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bod du bsgyur nas dar ba dang / nag rtsis ni rgya nag gi yul dang bon gzhung nas dar bar bshad/2 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa bod du bsgyur

30 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/ba'i lo tsā ba su su yin/lan/ chos 'di ni gyi jo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer dang / 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags pa/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ tsā mi sangs rgyas grags pa bcas kyis bod skad du bsgyur bar bshad/4 rab byung gi rtsis srol dus nam zhig la dar ba dang srol 'dod mkhan su yin nam/lan/ dus 'khor gyi chos 'di bod du thog mar dar ba'i dus te bod me yos lo(spyi lo 1027)de lo 'gor rtsis nas rab byung skor gcig 'go tshugs pa'i rtsis srol dar ba dang / gyi jo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer gyis rtsis srol btod pa yin/ /ga dus rabs gang la bod du lo tho'i srol thog mar dar ba dang /mkhas pa su dang sus srol brtad pa yin/lan/ dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dus dkyil sa skya 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas srid dbang bskyangs pa'i skabs der/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal dang kun dga' dpal ba sogs gnam rig skar rtsis la mkhas pa rnams kyis rgya nag gi hwang le dpe bzung nas bod kyi lo zla zhag dus kyi babs dang mthun pa'i sa skya'i lo tho zhes pa sgrig pa yin/6 bod0 rtsis rig gi lugs chen gnyis ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ mtshur lugs dang phug lugs gnyis yin/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 317 mtshur lugs zhes pa'i rtsis 'di dus nam zhig la sus srol btod pa yin/lan/ rab byung bdun pa'i shing sbrul lo ste spyi lo 1425lor mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer gyis kurma rang byung rdo rje'i rjes su 'brangs te rtsis gzhung chen mo mdzad nas mtshur lugs zhes grags// phug lugs zhes pa'i rtsis 'di dus nam zhig la dar ba dang srol 'dod mkhan su yin nam/lan/ rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos lo ste spyi lo 1447lor phug pa yab sras kyis rtsis gzhung pad dkar zhal lung ma bu sogs mdzad nas phug lugs rtsis kyi srol btod/kha marata brgyad dang de'ikhamasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ li me khams dang / khon sa khams/ dwa lcags khams/ khen gnam khams/ kham chu khams/ gin ri'am sa khams/ zin shing khams/zon rlung khams bcas brgyad do/ /10 sparata brtsi tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ skyes pa li nas khon phyogs bskor/ / bud med kham nas khen phyogs bskor/ / bcu kha ma longs re re brtsi/ / bcu kha longs na zur la mchongs/ / zhes so/ /11 tshe ba dgu bo so so'i kha dog dang 'byungakhamasaji ltar yin nam/

32 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ ma hā gser gyi rus sbal gyi bu ga la byung ba'i lus 'di nyid la sme ba kha dog gis dbye ba'i gcig dkar dang / gnyis nag gsum mthing /bzhi ljang / lnga ser/ drug dkar/ bdun dmar/ brgyad dkar/ dgu dmar bcas sme ba dgu de dkar gsum lcags la nag mthing chu/ bzhi ljang shing la lnga ser sa/ dgu dmar bdun dmar me yin no/ /12 lortags pho mo'i khyad par ltar yin nam/lan/ byi stag 'brug rta sprel khyi pho/ / glang yos sbrul lug bya phag mo /12 dar gud bcu gnyis zhes pa gang /lan/ dbugs len mngal gnas lus rdzogs gsum/ / btsas pa khrus byed gos gyon gsum/ / las byed dar ba gud pa gsum/ / na ba shi ba dur zhugs gsum/ / bcas lags/14 lo 'gros so so'i lus 'chol ba'i lde miga' ltar yin nam/lan/ ji skad du/ de nas lus kyi lde mig ni/ / stag yos bya sprel kham(chu)nas brtsi/ / glang lug rta byi zin(shing)nas brtsi/ / khyi 'brug phag sbrul dwa(lcags)nas brtsi/ / lcags chu me sa shing du bgrang / / zhes pa ltar ro/ /15 lozla zhag dus kyi dbang thang brtsi tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ lo zla zhag dus de dag gi / dbang thang lo zla gnyis sbrag la/ /

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 33zhag dang dus tshod rkyang bar 'ded/ / gnam lo ma la zla ba bu/ / zla ba ma la zhag ni bu/ / zhag ni ma la dus tshod bu/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/16 gza' brgyadakyi khams dang gnas yula' ltar yin nam/lan/ nyi ma mig dmar me yin lho/ / zla ba lhag pa chu yin byang / /phur shing shar te sangs lcags nub/ / spen pa sa yin mtshams la dbang / /rā hu spyi khyab 'byung lnga tshang / / zhes so/ /17 'byung rtsis zhes pa'i byed las gang yin nam/lan/ 'byung rtsis man ngag zla ba'i 'od zer las/ byed las ma 'khrugs bde ster zhing / / 'khrugs na na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bskyed/ / de phyir 'byung 'dus phung bo la/ / rnam rtog las bskyed 'du ba yi/ / nad dang ye 'brog gshed bzhis spyod/ / bde sdug ma lus 'byung bas byed/ / de bsal phyir na rtsis 'di gces/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /1〈 rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug phug pa rgya mtsho rnam gsum zhu ba de dag su dang su yin nam/lan/ phug pa rgya mtsho rnam gsum ni gtsang chung kurma chos grags rgya mtsho dang / mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho bcas yin/19 g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pos mdzad pa'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos gang dang gang yod/lan/ skar rtsis ri bo rdul 'bebs dang / nag rtsis 'khor 'das

34 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gtan 'bebs/ 'bras rtsis shing rta'i srol 'byed sogs yod/2༷ karma rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos gtso bo de gang yin nam/lan/ rje rang byung rdo rjes rang nyid dgung lo sum cu so lnga ste spyi lo 1318lor rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa mdzad pa yin/21 rtsis gzhung mkhas pa dga' byed ces pa de ni sus mdzad pa yin/lan/ bstan bcos 'di ni bu ston rin chen grub kyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i legs bshad yin/22 min gling lo chen dharma shrīs mdzad pa'i rtsis gzhung gtso bo dag ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ mkhas chen 'dis 'byung rtsis man ngag zla ba'i 'od zer dang /rtsis gzhung nyin byed snang ba dang de'i rnam 'grel gser gyi shing rta sogs mdzad pa yin/22 rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsis gzhung gi mtshan la ci zer/lan/ der skar nag rtsis kyi dris lan nyin byed dbang po'i snang ba zhes brjod/24 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mchos mdzad pa'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos gang dang gang yod/

lo rgyus kyi skor/ 35lan/ rtsis kyi bstan bcos gtso bo la phug lugs rtsis kyi legs bshad be+eḍūr+ya dkar po dang be+eḍūr+ya dkar po'i dris lan 'khrul snang g.ya' sel sogs yod do/ /25 mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu'i rtsis kyi thad rig pa'i mdzad rjes gtso bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ mkhas dbang 'dis lha sa sman rtsis khang gi dbu 'dzin gnang ba dang chabs cig skar rtsis skor la sa rta rigs ldan snying thig rab rgyal me yos la rtsis 'go spo zhing snga phyir brtsams chos grangs nyi shu la nye ba yig 'jog gnang yod par bshad/ da dung bod kyi lo tho shin tu rgyas pa 'don pa'i phyag len kyang mdzad/26 skar rtsisakun 'dus nor bu rtsom sgrig mdzad mkhan su yin nam/lan/ rtsis gzhung 'di ni deng dus kyi rtsis rig pa'i mkhas dbang bsam 'grub rgya mtshos rtsom sgrig byas pa yin/27 bod kyi rtsis rig kun 'dus chen mo zhes pa 'di rtsom sgrig mdzad mkhan su dang dus nam zhig la legs grub byung ba yin nam/lan/ deng dus kyi mkhas dbang byams pa 'phrin las sku nyid kyis gtso 'gan bzhes nas bod kyi rtsis rig kun 'dus chen mo rtsom zhus u yon lhan tshogs kyis lo ngo du ma'i ring la dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas nas spyi lo 1998lor dngos su 'grems spel byas pa yin no/ / / /

le'u gnyis pa/ rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dngagan thogalag len gyi skor/sa bcad dang po/ rtsa rgyud/1 gleng gzhi'i brjod bya gtso bo ci yin nam/lan/ rig gnas che ba lnga'i brjod byar gyur pa'i bstan bcos gang yang rgyu gleng gzhi dang rkyen gleng slong 'bras bu rgyud don gsum gyi sgo nas bstan yod la/ 'dir rgyu gleng gzhi'i brjod don nyid don tshan lnga'i sgo nas gsungs pa ste/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa bcas phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan ni gleng gzhi'i brjod bya gtso bo yin/2 dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dum bu dang por ci'i phyir rtsa rgyud ces ming btags pa yin/lan/ dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi po'i brjod bya kun 'dus shing gzhi rtags gso gsum gyi dgongs don rnams sa bon gyi tshul du gnad du

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 37bsdus nas rtsa bar gyur pa'i phyir te/ yongs gtad le'ur/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud 'di sa bon 'dra/ / 'di las ma skyes gso dpyad yod ma yin/ / zhes gsungs pas so/ /2 rgyud ces pa la dbye na rnam pa gsum yod pa de dag gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ lus nad gnyen po gsum bdag nyid gcig par 'brel bas rgyu'i rgyud dang / lus la brten nas nad/ nad la brten nas rtags/rtags la brten nas gso thabs bcas 'byung ba'i phyir na thabs kyi rgyud/zug rngu zhi nas nad med par bde ba dang ldan nas 'bras bu phun sum tshogs shing bla na med pa'i yon tan thob pa 'bras bu'i rgyud bcas so/ /4 rgyudakyi yan lag bzhi po gang gang yin/lan/ gleng gzhi 'byung ba'i yan lag dang / gleng slong rtsa ba'i yan laga'abrel ba dgos ched kyi yan lag rgyud don ngo bo'i yan lag bcas rgyud kyi 'chad thabs yan lag bzhi'o/ /ga zha nad ces pa la ming gi rnam grangs gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ bstan bcos brgyad par/ nad dang sdig pa rims gnod byed/ / 'gyur byed sdug bsngal ma zhu'i skyon/ / zad byed 'tsho dka' 'khun gnod rkyen/ / ming gi rnam grangs sgra bshad do/ / zhes so/ /6 rtsargyud skabs0 rtsa ba gsum po dposne ltar bkod yod dam/

38 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ rtsa ba gsum gyi dpe bkod tshul ni chu dang chab rom gyi tshul du gnas lugs nad gzhi/ me dang du ba'i tshul du ngos 'dzin rtags/ nyi ma dang ba mo'i tshul du gso byed thabs bcas so/ /7 rtsargyudabya skabs su rlung grang ba dang 'phel 'grib nad kyi skabs su rlungatsha grang gnyis ga'i khyab byed yin zhes pas de gnyis nang 'gal ma yin nam/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ de gnyis nang 'gal ma yin te/ rtsa rgyud kyi skabs su mtshan nyid la bltas nas rlung grang ba yin par gsungs pa dang / 'phel 'grib nad kyi skabs su byed las la bltas nas rlung tsha grang gnyi ga'i khyab byed yin zhes gsungs pa yin pas so/ /rdo grin dang chu ser tsha grang gang yang ma yin par thun mong du gnas par bshad pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ srin dang chu ser tsha grang thun mong gnas zhes pa ni de gnyis rnam par ma gyur skabs tsha ba dang grang ba gang yang ma yin zhing lus zungs thams cad la khyab par gnas pas thun mong du byas pa dang / de gnyis rkyen nam grogs kyi dbang gis tsha ba dang grang ba la 'gyur ba yod de/ dper na srin la dbye na rlung mkhris bad kun khrag bcas yod pa dang / chu ser la dkar nag ces ngo bo tsha grang la sbyar tshul yod pa lta bu'o/ /9 dri ma la rna spangs dang mchi ma/ sna'i snabs sogs bcu gnyis yod

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 39kyang rtsargyud du dri ma gsum las ma gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rtsa rgyud du dri ma bshang gci rngul gsum las ma gsungs pa ni gtso che ba dang mang du 'byung ba la dgongs nas dri ma gsum ma gtogs gzhan rnams ma bstan lo/10 'bras bu srog gcod nad dag bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ 'tsho ba gsum zad 'du ba gshed du babs/ / sbyor ba mtshungs dang gnad du babs pa dang / / dus 'das rlung nad srog rten chad pa dang / / tsha ba la 'das grang ba gting 'khar ba/ / zungs kyis mi thub rnam par 'tshe ba rnams/ / 'bras bu srog gcod nad dgu zhes su bshad/ / ces gsungs pa 'di'o/ /11 gas pa rlung mi dang dar ma mkhris pa'i mi/ byis pa bad dzin gyi mi yin don ci yin nam/lan/ mi rgan pa rnams la sha tshil rkang khu ba bcas zungs bcud shor zhing sa chu'i stobs rim gyis nyams pas rlung 'jug sla bas rlung gi mi yin/lus kyi 'byung stobs yongs su 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dar ma rnams la bcud 'phel pas rlung skyed mi srid la bskyed kyang zhi sla/ mkhris pa lhag pas tsha bas skams pas bad kun skyed dka' la bskyed kyang zhi sla/ khrag mkhris bskyed na mtshan nyid chos mthun gyi dbang gis zhi dka' bas dar ma mkhris pa'i mi yin/ma'i nu zho sogs brlan shas che ba'i kha zas kyis 'tsho zhing kun tu nyal ba'i

40 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/byis pa rnams la 'ju stobs chung bas kha zas 'ju dka' zhing brlan 'phel/brlan 'phel 'phro de snum shas che bas rlung skyed dka' zhing bskyed kyang zhi sla/brlan de grang ba yin pas khrag mkhris skyed dka' zhing bskyed kyang zhi sla/ bad kun bskyed na mtshan nyid chos mthun gyi dbang gis zhi dka' bas byis pa bad kun gyi mi yin/12 rlung nad dbyar dus dgong dang tho rangs ldang ba'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ dbyar dus rlung ldang ba ni de dus tsha ba che yang char gyi bsil bas rlung ldang ba/ tho rangs rlung ldang ba ni nyin par ro drug gi zas skom gang zos pa de tho rangs kyi dus su 'ju zin pas bcud zad de rlung ldang ba yin/nyi ma shar dus sa gzhi drod che ba dang zla ba shar dus sa gzhi bsil bas rlung yang bsil bas rlung nad dgong dus ldang ba yin/12 ci zhig la 'tsho ba gsum zad zer/lan/ 'tsho ba gsum zad ces pa ni rang gi khams 'tsho ba'i rgyu tshe'i 'phen pa dang / sngon bsags las kyi lhag ma/ bsod nams kyi mthu gsum po zad pa la bya zhing / gzhan da dung phyi'i zungs sha zad pa dang / nang gi zungs zas zad pa/ srog gi zungs rtsa zad pa bya ba'ang yod/14 'du ba gshed du babs zhes pa'i go don ci yin/lan/ nad tsha grang gnyis ka dus gcig tu 'dom pas tsha ba'i bcos byas na grang ba'i gshed du babs pa dang / grang ba'i bcos byas na tsha ba'i

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 41gshed du babs pa ste gnyen po mi len pa la bya/15 nad pa'i lce la bltas nas nad brtag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ bad kun myong byed lce rang la gnas shing / rlung khyab byed dang mkhris pa sgrub byed gnyis snying la gnas na'ang snying gi me tog lce yin pas nyes pa gsum ga lce la 'dus pa'i don gyis red/16 mi 'da'i bcos thabs dgu zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ nyes gsum gyi nad khong du gnas pa dag phyir sbyong bar byed pa'i bcos thabs dgu'i bsdus ming ste/ rlung nad 'jam rtsi las mi 'da' ba/ de la sle 'jam bkru 'jam bkru ma slen te gsum/ mkhris nad bshal las mi 'da' ba/ de la spyi bshal sgos bshal drag bshal 'jam bshal te bzhi/ bad kun gyi nad skyugs las mi 'da' ba/ de la drag skyugs 'jam skyugs gnyis te bsdoms pas dgu'o/ /17 rtsa rgyad spyi don rnams dpag bsam ljon shing gi tshul du bstan pa'i dge mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'chad bya'i gzhung don rnams rtsa ba dang sdong bo dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu bcas dpag bsam ljon shing gi sdong po'i gzugs su bkod na nang don cha tshang thad kur rtogs sla zhing /don 'dus pa/ rten 'brel legs pa bcas kyi dge mtshan ldan/1〈 rtsa rgyud kyi sdong 'grems 'jog skabs me rtag gnyis dang 'bras

42 bod kyi gsorig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bu gsum po gang la 'jog dgos/lan/ rnam par ma gyur pa'i lus mi na bar gnas shing / rnam par gyur pa'i lus na ba de brtag thabs kyis legs par brtags shing / zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi tshul bzhin du bston nas gsos pas zug rngu las grol te nad med bde thang du gnas tshe/ nad med pa'i me tog dang tshe ring ba'i me tog gnyis rnam par rgyas shing / de gnyis la 'bras bu chos nor bde ba gsum 'byung ba de don dam par lus zungs kyi lo ma'i steng du 'jog dgos la/deng sang rnam par ma gyur pa'i sdong bo'i rtser 'jog pa ni ri mo mdzes mdzes byed pa'i ched yin par bshad/19 nad gzhi dang nad rtags/ gnod bya dang gnod byed bcas dbar gyi 'brel ba' ltar yin nam/lan/ nad gzhi dang nad rtags bar gyi 'brel ba ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba yin la/ gnod bya dang gnod byed bar gyi 'brel ba ni rten dang brten pa'i 'brel bar grub pa'o/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ grub pa lus/1 mi'i lusarten 'di nyid 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang nas mchog gam gtso bo yin pa'i mtshan gang yin name/lan/ las kyi sar skyes shing / khams drug dang ldan zhing dam pa'i chos

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 43la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor tshang ba'i rdo rje'i mi lus ni lha la sogs 'gro ba gzhan rnams kyis bsngags shing smon pa'i gnas yin pa ma zad/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas nges pas 'gro ba rigs drug gi gtso bor gyur/2 mngal chags pa'irgyu gtso bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ pha ma gnyis kyi khams dkar dmar lhan du 'dus pa la bar do'i rnam par shes pa zhugs pa ste/ khu khrag sems gsum bcas tshogs pa ni mngal chags pa'i rgyu'o/ /2 las ma 'joms zhes pa'i go dona' ltar yin nam/lan/ las ma 'dzoms zhes pa ni pha ma'i bson nams dang / bar ma do'ibasod nams che chung bar gyi 'brel ba dang phan tshun 'phrad pa'i skal ba yod med la go dgos/4 lus chags tshul gyi le'ur pho mo 'gyur tshul gyi skabs su gcig gsum lnga bdun dgu la bur 'gyur te zhes dang / khu ba mang ba bu ru skye 'gyur gyi zhes rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis bstan pa las dbang btsan shos gang yin nam/ci'i phyir/lan/ gcig gsum lnga bdun dgu la bur 'gyur te zhes pa ni dang po lus chags pa'i skabs su pha ma gnyis dga' bar 'jug pa'i tshes grangs la gzhigs nas rten 'brel gyi dbang du gsungs pa dang / khu ba mang ba bu ru skye

44 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'gyur gyi zhes pa 'di ni lus chags pa'i rgyu dngos la bltas nas gsungs pa yin pas 'og ma 'di dbang btsan te/ rgyu las 'bras bu mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /5 mngal chags 'phel pa'i rgyu ni lte ba ste zhes pa'i lte ba ni mngal gnas 'phel pa'i dngosayin nam/lan/ ma yin te/ rgyu dngos ni ma'i kha zas las byung ba'i bcud chen po de yin la/ bcud chen po de rgyun chad med par lte bar brgyud nas mngal gnas kyi zungs stobs rim gyis 'phel par byed pas na/ 'dir lte ba ni ma'i kha zas kyi bcud rgyu ba'i lam mam grogs byed pa'i rtsa sbubs yin pa'i cha nas rgyu lta bur bzhag pa yin/6 te ba bsgyur ba'i dus nam yin pa dang / lte bskur skabs kyi nyi ma zla ba'i dngas ma zhes pa de gang dang gang la go dgos/lan/ mngal chags bdun phrag gsum pa'i dus la 'bad pas lte ba bsgyur dgos shing / lte ba sman gyis bsgyur thabs la rgyud las/ nyi ma zla ba'i dwangs ma bza' ba dang / / zhes pa'i nyi zla'i dwangs ma 'di la bzhed tshul 'ga' mchis pa las mchog ni nyi ma'i dwangs ma grong ba'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo'i mngal khrag dang / de bzhin zla ba'i dwangs ma pho'i sa bon gnyis cha mnyam byas nas bu ram dang bsres te bza' bar bya/ gal te de ltar ma 'dzoms na sman gzhan gyis kyang tshab rung ste/ sum ston ye shes gzungs kyis

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 45nyi ma'i dwangs ma star bu dang zla ba'i dwangs ma rgun 'brum gnyis cha mnyam za dgos par gsungs shing 'di'i khungs gtugs sa ni bdud rtsi bum pa yin pa dang / zur mkhar bas nyi ma'i dwangs ma lhang tsher dmar po dang zla ba'i dwangs ma dngul chu btso bkru sbyangs gsum byas pa de yin par bzhed pa ni dus kyi 'khor lo dang sgo bstun pa/ gzhan yang rig byed kyi gtam rgyud las nyi ma'i dwangs ma brag zhun dang zla ba'i dwangs ma cong zhi gnyis sbrang rtsi dang bu ram la sbyar dgos zhes bzhed srol yang mchis so/ /7 ma ning rigs lnga bo de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ mtshan med ma ning dang / mtshan gnyis ma ning / 'gyur ba ma ning / nyams pa ma ning / phrag dog ma ning bcas lnga'o/ // dku zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di don gang dang gang la 'jug gam/lan/ dku ni skabs thob kyi don mang po la 'jug pa'i brda rnying zhig yin te/ de'u dmar bas/ dku ni dpyi dang gsus pa dang / / dri mi zhim dang mchi ma 'dzag / bsam se'am bu snod bcas la 'jug / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /kha mngal gnas rim bzhin 'phel pa'i gnas skabs gsum gyi mtshams 'byed tshula' ltar yin/ de ltar dbye ba'i mtshan ci/lan/ zla ba gnyis pa bdun phrag lnga ba nas dgu ba'i bar ni nya'i gnas skabs yin la/ skabs 'dir srog pa rtsa'i nus pas mngal gnas kyi phyi'i

46 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gzugs dbyibs tsam dkyus gcig tu chags pa las sbrum bu'i gzugs dbyibs 'ba' zhig ma yin zhing / sbrum bu dang cha 'dra ba'i khyad chos gang yang mi mngon par mtshon byed srog chags nya'i gzugs lta bur 'gyur bas nya'iganas skabs zhes brjod/ rus sbal gyi gnas skabs ni zla ba gsum pa bdun phrag bcu ba nas zla ba bzhi ba bdun phrag bcu bdun gyi bar yin la/skabs 'dir mngal gnas kyi yan lag lnga po'i gzugs dbyibs chags nas rus rkang rnams cung zad sra mkhregs kyi rang bzhin du 'phel 'gyur byung ste phyi nas bltas na rul sbal gyi rnam pa dang 'dra bas rus sbal gyi gnas skabs zhes brjod/ phag gi gnas skabs ni zla ba lnga ba bdun phrag bco brgyad nas zla ba dgu ba bdun phrag so lnga'i bar dang / skabs 'di rnams su mngal gnas kyi dbang bo rnams gsal zhing sha tshil pags pa sogs rgyas nas cung zad tsho che ba'am brgyags pa'i tshul dod pa dang / skra dang ba spu gzengs pa/ de min mi gtsang ba'i 'go chu sogs 'thung phyir phag gi gnas skabs zhes brjod do/ /10 bud med rnams la mngal ldan pa'i skabs su zla mtshan mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ gnas skabs de rnams su ma'i kha zas kyi bcud rnams rim bzhin zungs su smin pa'i tha ma bcud chen po de mngal gnas kyi lus gso skyed byed pa'i nyer len gyi rgyur gyur stabs bsam se'ur bsags pa'i skal ba ha cang phra bas bud med gang mngal dang ldan pa'i skabs su zla mtshan mi 'byung

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 47ngo /11 sprum bu btsa' bar nye ba'i skabs der skyo ba'i 'du shes lnga 'byung ba ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ ma'i mngal gyi sbrum bu 'phel nas zla ba dgu ba bdun phrag so drug sogs lon tshe de nyid la mngal nang mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes dang / dri mi zhim pa'i 'du shes/ btson rwa lta bu'i 'du shes/ mun nag gi 'du shes/ mngon par mi dga' ba'i 'du shes sogs 'byung ba la bya'o/ /12 skye gnas mi mthun pa dang dbang bo skyon can 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mi la skye gnas mi mthun pa sha thum lta bu dang / skye gnas mthun yang mi'u thung dang zha long sogs gzugs mi sdug pa dang dbang bo skyon can sogs 'byung ba ni pha ma'i khu khrag la rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis sbags pa'am/ 'byung ba lnga bo'i cha shas 'dzoms pa tsam las 'thung chu byung med pa/ yang na mngal ldan pa'i skabs su sbrum mas zas spyod sman dpyad sogs kyi spang blang rnams nyams len yag po ma byas par bab col du bsten pa/sngon las bcas las 'gyur ba yin/12 bshad rgyud du bud med zla mtshan bcu gnyis lon nas 'dzag ces pa dang / zhang bod gso rig dga' ston du bud med zla mtshan bcu gsum lon nas 'dzag ces pa gnyis la nang 'gal yod dam/

48 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ 'di'i thad la gzhung 'grel kha shas su bcu gsum zhes pa ni sems can de ma'i mngal du chags pa nas bzung lo bcu gsum dang / bcu gnyis zhes pa ni phru gu skyes pa nas rtsis pa yin zhes gsungs kyang / kho mo'i bsam par de gnyis gang yin yang tha mal rgyun ldan gyi gras yin par snang /'on te nang gses zhib phra'i dbye bar 'jug dgos tshe lo bcu gsum zhes pa ni bod rang gi yul dus dang 'tshams par gsungs pa ste/ kha ba can gyi mtho sgang gi yul gru 'di'i sa bab dang gnam gshes sogs shin tu bsil bas nang gi rtsa rlung thig le yi stobs rdzogs pa cung zad dal ba dang / lo bcu gnyis zhes pa ni snying po bsdus pa sogs rgya gzhung dag gi rjes su bsnyegs nas rgya gar gyi yul dus dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas gsungs par mngon/14 bshad da chags tshul le'ur zla mtshan chos khu ri pong khrag 'dra ba zhes dngan ma yi zla mtshan sha khrag don snod skyed ces gsungs pa'i bla mtshan de gnyis la go ba' ltar len dgos/lan/ dang po de mthong chos su gyur pa'i zla mtshan la go dgos pa dang /gnyis pa ni rgyu las 'bras bu skyed tshul ston pa'i skabs yin pas gnas bab de'i zla mtshan zhes pa ni zla ba re re'i dus tshigs ltar mngal kha 'byed pa'i dus sam mngal len pa'i dus la bsam bse'u las thon pa'i mngal 'dzin gyi sa bon khams dmar po kho na nyid yin mod/ khams dang zla mtshan gnyis ngo bo gzhi mthun gyi sgo nas de gnyis ga'i thun mong gi gdags gzhi la zla mtshan

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 49zhes btags pa yin/15 bshadargyud chags tshul gyi le'ur sbu gu btsa' thabs la tshig rkang gnyis tsam las bstan med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ chags tshul le'u'i mjug tu/ bud med btsa' myong gis skor btsa' bar bya/ / srog bral 'dra ba'i nad sos tshas kyis gso/ / zhes tshig rkang gnyis tsam ma gtogs phru gu skye bsu bya ba'i cho ga dngos su ma gsungs pa ni/ le'u 'di ni ma'i mngal du phru gu chags nas 'phel pa'i tshul ston pa'i skabs yin gshes btsa' thabs rgyas par ma bstan pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na skabs de dus kyi tshe rig 'dzin mkhan rnams phal cher grwa ser yin gshes rang re'i gso dbyad kyi gzhung rnams su bud med lus kyi gnas lugs dang phru gu btsa' thabs sogs mdor bsdus tsam las zhib phra'i dbye 'byed gsal bo med pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags/16 'dra dbe phung bo'i gnas lugs bstan pa'i dgos pa ci yin nam/lan/ mi'i lus kyi cha shas so so'i gzugs dbyibs dang / gnas yul/ngo bo'am nus pa/ phan tshun dbar gyi 'brel ba dang gnyan pa'i gnad che chung gi bye brag bcas mdor na phung bo'i gnas lugs gsal bor shes pa'i ched du 'dra dpe bstan pa yin/17 bshadargyudakyi don snod 'dra dpe dang man rgyad kyi don snod 'dra

50 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/dpe gnyis0 nye bag ci yin nam/lan/ bshad rgyud kyi don snod 'dra dpe ni gtso bo byed las dang gnyan che chung la bltas nas dngos po'i ngo bo mtshon byed bstan pa dang / man rgyud byang khog rma gso skabs kyi 'dra dpe ni gtso bo don snod kyi dbyibs dang gnas stangs dngos la bltas nas dngos po'i dbyibs dang gnas mtshon byed bstan pa yin/1〈 gnad ces pa'i go donaji ltar yin nam/lan/ snying po bsdus par/ sha rgyus dus pa rtsa chen dang / / rtsa dang tshigs ni 'dus sa ru/ / gnad ces bya ste des na der/ / srog ni lhag par gnas pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar chu rgyus dang rtsa tshigs rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i gnas la gnad ces bya/19 mi lus gcig mtshungs yin yang dus grangs bgrang skabs bod lugs su dus dum sum brgya drug cu dang / deng rabs pas nyis brgya dang drug ces mi 'dra ba gnyis 'byung ba'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ bod lugs kyis rus dum bgrang skabs thog mar mngal chags skabs su ji ltar chags yod pa de ltar bgrangs pa dang / de min lha ru rtse lta bu rus pa snyi mo'i rigs dang / sen mo dang so lta bu rus pa'i snyigs ma dang rus phran dag kyang grangs su bgrangs yod/ deng rabs gso rig gis gnas skabs kyi gnas lugs la gzhigs nas rus pa gtso bo'i gras dang / sra mo'i

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 51rigs/ mngon sum can sogs ma gtogs bgrang med pas gzhung de gnyis kyi rus grangs la mang nyung shor ba de ltar lags/20 so grangs sum cu rtsa gnyis po'i khyad chos mi 'dra ba la bltas nas dbye tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ smra byed mdun so brgyad dang / mdzes byed mche ba bzhi/ gcod par byed pa'i 'gram so bcu drug mtha' bzhi'i so chung bzhi bcas so/ /21 chu ba bcu drug po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ 'di la lugs gnyis yod de gong sman pa'i stong thun nyi 'od rab gsal las/ chu ba bcu drug ngos 'dzin ni/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i lugs gcig dang / / ro bkra 'phrul lde'i lugs dang gnyis/ / dang po yan lag brgyad pa'i lugs/ / ske la ltag chu mgrin chu bzhi/ / lag par gru chu mkhrig chu bzhi/ / rkang bar sgyid chu rting chu bzhi/ / byang khog sgal chu phyi nang bzhi/ / bcas rnams yongs dril bcu drug go / gnyis pa ro bkra 'phrul lde'i lugs/ / ske la ltag pa'i chu leb gnyis/ / lag par gru chu mkhrig chu bzhi/ / rkang bar sgyid chu rting chu bzhi/ / ngar gdong chu ba gnyis bcas drug/ byang khog skal 'dabs chu ba bzhi/ / yongs su dril bas bcu drug go /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /22 chu ba dang rgyas pa'i byed las dang khyad par ci yin nam/lan/ byed las ni chu rgyus kyis sha tshigs rnams 'dzin par byed pa dang /

52 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/zhib tu dbye na chu bas tshigs rnams 'dzin par byed cing rgyus pas sha rnams 'dzin par byed de/ pod dmar las/ mdor na sha dang rus pa rnams/ /'thor bar dogs nas dkris pa yin/ / zhes pa ltar dang / khyad par ni chu ba dang rgyus pa gnyis che chung gi dbang du byas na rags pa chu ba dang phra ba rgyus pa yin la/ gnas kyi dbang du byas na chu ba phal cher rgyab dang rgyus pa phal cher mdun na gnas pa yin/22 rmo ba ma lnga dang bu lnga zhes pa gang la bltas nas btags pa dang /de dag gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ glo ba ma lnga dang bu lnga zhes pa ni gnas sa mdun rgyab dang gtos che chung la bltas nas btags pa ste/ byang khog rgyab ngos su gnas shing gtos che ba la glo ba ma zhes dang / byang khog mdun ngos su gnas shing gtos chung ba la glo ba bu zhes bshad/ ma lnga ni stag mgo sgang rtsibs gsham dang zags sna lnga/bu lnga ni/ mdzo sna dang ni bya skab thugs khab dang / / rte mig dgra lce bu lnga snying la bskor/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /24 ril shubs dkar nag ces pa gang la go dgos/ ming de ltar btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ tshil shubs dkar nag ces pa gzhang dkar nag la go dgos shing de la sor phyed dang lnga yod/ de ltar zer don ni gzhang dkar po la tshil shas che ba dang / gzhang nag po la tshil shas chung bas yin/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 5325 mchin dri dkar nag ces pa gang la bltas nas bshad pa yin/lan/ de ni chu rgyus kyi mang nyung la bltas nas dbye ba yin te/ chu rgyus kyi shas che ba'am de'i cha mang du yod pa'i yul der mchin dri dkar po zhes brjod pa dang / chu rgyus med pa'am 'brel chung ba dang sha mang du yod pa'i yul der mchin dri nag po zhes tha snyad mdzad pa yin/26 zang gzhung dkar nag mtshams zhes pa de gang la go dgos/lan/ 'di la lugs gnyis mchis te/ pod dmar du snying sha dmar po dang glo ba dkar po gnyis 'doms pa'i mtshams yin par bshad pa dang /gnad kyi lde mig tu snying sha dkar nag gnyis kyi mtshams yin par gsungs/gsang 'dir me gdab pa'i phan nus la bltas na phyi ma 'di la bden shas che bar snang /27 byang khog yul thig gdab skabs lus kyi sdod lugs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ khad mnyam stan la dkyil dkrung legs byas te/ / sgal tshigs bsrangs la mgrin pa en tsam bkug / dpung ba phyir gdeng lag pas pus mor bkab/ / ces pa ltar 'dug dgos/2/ byangakhog yul thig gi dngos yod rin thang ci yin nam/lan/ de'u dmar bas/ byang khog phyi nas thig gdabs pas/ / nang gi don snod yul gsang rnams/ / gsal zhing rjen par ston pa la/ / byang

54 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/khog yul thig ces su bshad/ / ces pa ltar byang khog tu sa bgos thig len byed pa'i thabs shes la brten nas byang khog nang lkog gyur du gnas pa'i don lnga snod drug po so so'i gnas yul gsal bar byed pa de'o/ /29 rus pa po mo ma ning gsum la khyad chos ci 'dra yod/lan/ pho rus kyi khyad chos ni lha ba chung la mkhregs shing gdung mthug pa dang / mo rus srab la mnyen pa/ ma ning gi rus par lha ba che la gsob pa bcas kyi khyad chos mngon/20 byangakhog yul thig skabs blang rtse rgyan du bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gong sman pa'i dris lan rab gsal me long las/ byang khog yul thig 'chad pa'i skabs/ / snying rtse gyen du bstan pa ni/ / kun rdzob blo yi snang ngor dang / / bstun nas rten 'brel dbang du gsungs/ / gzhan du pho mo khyad med par/ / snying rtse lus kyi thur du gtad/ / ces pa las 'bus so/ /21 long ga'i gnas stangs la bltas nas khrag long dang rtsam long grin long zhes ming btags pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ 'di la bzhed tshul gnyis te/ gcig ni khrag long zhes don ni lus kyi g.yas na gnas pa'i long ga'i dum bu de khrag gi rten mchin pa dang khad nye bas khrag long dang / tsam long ni dbus kyi dum bu de zas skom myag bzhu byed pa'i pho ba dang khad nye bas tsam long / srin long ni lus kyi g.yon gyi

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 55dum bu de'i yar sne tsam long dang mar sne gnye mar 'brel bas srin bu mang po'i rten gnas yin pas srin long zhes ming gi tha snyad btags zer/cig shos ni long la khrag long dang tsam long srin long zhes dbye don ni gtso bo khong nang du rgyu ba'i kha zas kyi mdog dang dbyibs la bltas nas btags pa ste/ thog mar rgyu ba'i lus g.yas gzhogs kyi long nang gi zas mdog khrag ltar dmar smug yin pas khrag long dang / de nas lus kyi dbus su rgyu skabs rtsam pa'i mdog ltar skya bor 'gyur bas rtsam long / phyis su lus kyi g.yon gzhogs kyi long gar rgyu skabs zas snyigs rnams srin bu lta bu rdog po 'byung bas srin long zhes btags par bshad/22 chil gnad brgyad po gang dang gang yin pa dang / rmen bu la chil gnad zer dgos don ci/lan/ tshil gnad brgyad po ni rmen bu mgo sngon gnyis dang / smug po gnyis/ dkar po gnyis/ sbrul mgo gdengs pa gnyis bcas yin/ lus kyi chen bu'i gnad brgyad la tshil gnad zer don ni rmen bu ni lus zungs bdun gyi ya gyal tshil gyi snyigs ma yin stabs der tshil gnad ces brjod pa yin/zhug pa chos bzang gis/ rmen bu tshil snyigs las byung bas/ / de yi gnad la tshil gnad brjod/ / ces pa'i lung gis sgrub nus so/ /22 don gnad bcu gsum po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ gnad kyi lde mig las/ don gnad bcu gsum ni/ snying dang

56 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/srog rtsa 'brel mtshams kyi sha nag po dang / glo ba'i bu/ mchin pa'i mtsho'am rtsi/ mcher ba'i cha ga mkhal ma'i rtsi/ pho ba'i rdzims/ mkhris pa'i rtsi pags/ rgyu ma'i stod/ long stod lu gu mgo gnye ma/ gzhang nag po/ lhang pa'ikha/ bsam bse'u bcas so/ / zhes pa ltar dang / zhib tu shes par 'dod na man rgyud byang khog gi le'ur gzigs/24 don lnga'i byed lasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ pod dmar las/ lus kyi gtso bo dwangs ma'i rten/ / snying sogs lnga bo bshad par bya/ / snying ni me khams sems kyi rten/ / bdag 'dzin dran pa gsal bar byed/ / glo ba lcags khams dbugs kyi rten/ /'byin dang rngub pa'i don rnams byed/ / mchin pa shing khams khrag gi rten/ / khrag sogs dwangs ma 'phel bar byed/ / mcher ba sa khams dwangs ma'i rten/ / dngas ma 'phel dang zas 'ju byed/ / mkhal ma chu khams chu yi rten/ / dri chu 'byin sdom las byed do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /25 don lnga bo khug ma lnga la sbyar tshul yod pa de' ltar yin nam/lan/ zhang sman nag pos/ snying ni rlung gi khug ma/ glo ba lud pa'i khug ma/ mchin pa khrag gi khug ma/ mcher ba shig gi khug ma/ mkhal ma chu yi khug ma/ / zhes so/ /24 snod drug so so'i byed lasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ pod dmar las/ pho ba sa khams mcher bar 'brel/ / zas/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 57skom myag cing 'drul ba'i snod/ / rgyu ma me khams snying dang 'brel/ / zas 'ju dwangs snyigs byed pa'i snod/ / long ga rlung khams glo bar 'brel/ /rlung snyigs zas ro gnas pa'i snod/ / sgang pa chu khams mkhal mar 'brel/ / lus kyi dri chu gsog pa'i snod/ / snod mkhris shing khams mchin par 'brel/ / khrag snyigs 'ju byed gnas pa'i snod/ / khams kun 'dus pa bsam bse'u ni/ / thun mong phyir na don kun 'brel/ / pho mo'i sa bon 'byung ba'i snod/ / bu snod gsang sgro 'di'i dum bu/ / yin phyir snod drug gras su 'dod/ / ces pa las 'khums so/ / 27 gong sman pa'i pod dmar du gsungs pa'i don snod sogs kyi mcho bcu gnyis po de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ klad pa rtsa dkar gyi mtsho/ snying rtsa nag gi mtsho/ glo ba dbugs kyi mtsho/ mchin pa khrag gi mtsho/ mcher ba men bu'i mtsho/ mkhal ma chu'i mtsho/ pho ba bad kun gyi mtsho/ rgyu ma mkhris khu'i mtsho/ long dri chen gyi mtsho/sgang pa dri chu'i mtsho/ snod mkhris drod kyi mtsho/ bsam bse'u sa bon gyi mtsho/de dag la mtsho bcu gnyis bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di yin/2ra sgal chigs0 skye lugs ltar yin nam/lan/ mjing tshigs dang rked tshigs mdun ngos su gug pa dang / sgal tshigs rgyab ngos su gug pa'i tshul du gnas/29 nang rtsa dar gyi dpyangs thag bcu gsum po gang gang yin nam/

58 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ nang rtsa dar gyi dpyangs thag bcu gsum ste/ / klad pa'i rje zhabs las byung ske'i nang brgyud/ / rlung gi rtsa bzhi snying dang rgyu mar 'brel/ / mkhris pa'i rtsa bzhi glo long mchin mkhris 'brel/ / bad kun rtsa bzhi pho mcher mkhal lhang 'brel/ / 'dus pa'i rtsa gcig bsam bse'u 'brel ba yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /40 chu rtsa drug gi rgyas tshul rags tsam dang de dag gi ming thogs chul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ chu rtsa drug po ni klad pa las gyes pa'i dbang rtsa yin te/ chu rtsa sbu gu can gnyis ltag pa'i sdud sgo nas phyir thon te rkang mthil du rgyu bar byed pa dang / chu rtsa 'ja' byed gnyis ltag zur spu 'khyil thad nas phyir thon te lag pa'i mtheb mo dang 'brel/ chu rtsa rat+na gnyis rna shal 'og tu thon te lag pa'i srin mtheb dang 'brel/de yang chu rtsa sbu gu can zhes pa ni rtsa 'di'i byed las gtso bo ni chu khams rgyu ba'i rtsa spu gu can rnams 'dzin par byed pa'i cha nas ming de ltar btags pa las rtsa 'di'i nang sbubs stong pa yin pa'i cha nas ma yin no/ / 'ja' byed ces pa ni rtsa 'di'i byed las nyams na 'ja' ba ste yan lag rnams brkyang bskum 'degs 'jog gi bya ba dang bral zhing tshor ba nyams nas 'ja' bar byed pas na ming de ltar btags/ rat+na ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin la bod skad du bsgyur na ngo mtshar ba'i rgyu la rin po che zhes 'gyur ba ltar skabs

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 59'dir rtsa 'di la skyon byung na ngo mtshar ba'i nad rtags mi 'dra ba ston par byed pas na rat+na zhes bshad pa yin no/ /41 srog 'dzin rlung gi gnas la rgyud las khyu por gnas zhes pa dang /zla rgyal las lte bar gnas zhes pa gnyis 'gal lam/lan/ mi 'gal te/ rgyud las khyad par srog 'dzin rlung de spyi bo gnas zhes pa ni srog rtsa'i rtse mo gnas sa la dgongs nas gsungs pa dang / zla rgyal las lte bar gnas zhes pa ni srog rtsa'i mar sne gnas sa la bltas nas gsungs pa yin/42 gtso po'i me drod dang 'khor gyi me drod la ji ltar ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ 'di la bzhed tshul gnyis mchis te/ gcig ni mkhris pa 'ju byed la gtso bo'i me drod dang / rlung me mnyam dang bad kun myag byed gnyis la 'khor gyi me drod zer ba dang / cig shos ni pho bar gnas pa'i bad mkhris rlung gi me drod rnam gsum la gtso bo'i me drod dang / lus zungs so sor gnas pa'i me drod rnam gsum gyi cha la 'khor gyi me drod zer/42 rlung dang bad gan gnyis grang ba yin yang de gnyis me drod rnam gsum gyi gras su 'jog don ci yin/lan/ bad kun myag byed dang rlung me mnyam gnyis spyir grang ba'i rang bzhin can yin yang skabs 'dir de gnyis kyis mkhris pa 'ju byed dang lhan

60 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/du me dang mthun pa'i las byed pas me drod gsum zhes gsungs pa las de gnyis kyi ngo bo me dngos ma yin no/ /44 gnod bya dang gnod byed sogs kyi ldang tshad bstan don ci dang /ldang tshad de dag gang zag ji lta bu zhig la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/lan/ ldang tshad de dag ni tha mal gyi gnas lugs shes pa'i ched du na tshod rgan gzhon dang gzugs che chung tsho rid sogs spyir btang ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin/45 bshadargyud du mkhris pa'i ldang tshad rang gi gsang sgro gang zhes pa 'dini skyes pa la gzhigs pa yin pas bud med kyi mkhris pa'i ldang tshad dang snod mkhris0 ldang tshad ci tsam yin/lan/ bshad rgyud du bstan pa'i mkhris pa'i ldang tshad skyes par dngos bstan du gsungs kyang shugs bstan du bud med dang snod mkhris kyi ldang tshad kyang de dang cha mthun tsam yin pa rig pas shes par bya dgos te/ dris lan nyin byed snang ba las/ bshad rgyud las/ mkhris pa'i ldang tshad rang gi gsang sgro gang / / zhes gsungs pa ni nyes pa'i mkhris pa go dgos pa gor ma chag ste/nyes pa gsum so so'i ldang tshad bstan pa'i skabs yin pas so/ / 'on kyang snod mkhris kyi ldang tshad kyang 'di las mi 'da' ste/ nyes pa'i mkhris pa'i gzhi'am rten ni snod kyi mkhris pa yin pas so/ / de bzhin gzhal bya'i dngos po yang mkhris khu yin te/ snod mkhris kyi khu ba ni tsha ba'i rten yin pa'i phyir

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 61ro/ / zhes gsungs/ 46 gnod bya bcu las dwangs ma dngarkang gi ldang tshad ci tsam yin/lan/ rkang ni snyim pa phyed dang dwangs ma ni dgu yin par bshad/47 nyes gsum gyi gnas sa la drung smad na gnas pa dang mkhris pa bar na gnas pa/ bdakan stod du gnas pa'irgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ 'di ni phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thog mar chags pa'i tshul dang shin tu mtshungs te/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thog mar chags skabs ches 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags pa dang / de'i steng du me yi dkyil 'khor chags pa/de'i steng du sa chu'i dkyil 'khor chags tshul mngon pa mdzod rtsa 'grel rnams su gsungs/ ji skad du/ phyi rol ji bzhin nang de bzhin zhes pa ltar phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can ngo bo bdag gcig tu 'brel phyir de gnyis chos mtshungs te/ yang g.yo can gyi rlung lus kyi smad du gnas pa dang / mkhris pa ste me'i rang bzhin can de bar na gnas pa/ bad kun sa chu'i rang bzhin can de stod na gnas pa yin/4/ rlung mkhris bdakan gsum grangs dang go rim ji ltar grub bam/lan/ rgyu 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum du nges pa dang / ngo bo btang snyoms tsha bsil gsum du nges pa/ dpe dbang bo snga rgol phyi rgol gsum du nges pa/ 'bras bu rnam par gyur pa'i nyes gsum dang / gnyen po sa sman dang chu sman me sman gsum du nges so/ /

62 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/49 mi lam gyi dbye ba dang 'bras bu 'byung tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ mthong thos myong dang gsol ba btab pa dang / /grub pa nad las byung dang rnam pa drug / mtshan stod rmi lam brjed ngas 'bras bu med/ / tho rangs mthong dang gsal na 'bras bu 'byin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /50 shin tu nye ba'i 'chi ltas la 'byung ba lnga dang dbang bo lnga'i thum rima' ltar yin nam/lan/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha' lnga bo rim bzhin snga ma rnams phyi mar thum pa ste/ sa nus chu la thum pa dang / chu nus me la thum pa/ me nus rlung / rlung nus mkha' la thum nas lus khams su gnas pa'i 'byung ba'i nus pa phra rags rnams rim gyis nyams nas mthar phyi dbugs chad pa dang /dbang bo mig rna sna lce reg bya lnga bo yang rim bzhin snga ma rnams nyams nas phyi mar thum te tshor ba med par gyur cing lus sems gnyis so sor bral nas 'chi bar gyur to/ /sa bcad gsum pa/ 'phel 'grib nad/1 nadakyi ringargu dang nyergyu dag gi 'brel ba' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu de dag gcig gi nyer len gcig gis byed pa'am gcig gi rten gcig gis byed par bltas nas ring rgyu dang nye rgyu ru bzhag pa dang / de

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 63yang ma rig pa ni nad thams cad kyi rgyu'i rten yin pas spyi'i rgyu'am ring rgyur bzhag pa yin la/ de las bskyed pa'i 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum ni rlung mkhris bad kun gsum skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin phyir khyad par gyi rgyur bzhag rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung mkhris bad kun gsum ni rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i skad cig la 'phel zad 'khrugs te nad du 'gyur bas na nad kyi ngo bo'am nye rgyur bzhag pa yin/ de bas spyi'i rgyu ni rtsa ba lta bu dang / khyad par gyi rgyu ni yal 'dab lta bu/ nye rgyu ni 'bras bu'i tshul du 'brel zhing gnas pa'o/ /2 bshadargud du nad rnamasakun gyi nig rig pa yin par bshadapa dang / yongs gtad du gso bya'i nadaskrung 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed ches nad kyi rgyu la 'byung ba bzhi bzhag yod pas de gnyis nang 'gal mayin nam/lan/ mi 'gal te/ nad kyi rgyur ma rig pa bzhag pa ni ring ba'i rgyu la dgongs nas gsungs pa dang / 'byung ba bzhi yin par bshad pa ni 'byung ba sa chu me rlung bzhi dang rlung(rlung)mkhris(me)bad kun(sa chu)gsum phan tshun mtshan nyid mthun pas nye ba'i rgyu la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin no/ /2 bshadargyudakyi le'u dgu bar nad kyi rkyen ni gsum yin par bshad pa dngan man da rnams su rkyen bzhi yin par bshad pa la nang 'gal yod dam/ rgya mtshan ci/lan/ bshad rgyud le'u dgu bar skye mched gsog ldang slong rkyen gsum nad kyi rkyen gsum yin par bshad pa ni/ gnas 'di ni nad kyi rnam pa

64 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/yongs rdzogs ston pa'i gnas yin stabs nad kyi rkyen yang spyi'i sgo nas brjod pa dang / man rgyud rnams su dus gdon zas spyod bzhi nad kyi rkyen du bzhag pa ni nad so so'i bye brag gi rkyen bstan pa yin pas skye mched sogs las stobs che zhing 'phral du nad slong bar byed pas na dbang btsan shos de yin/de'i phyir rkyen gsum dang rkyen bzhi phan tshun nang 'gal du mi 'gro ste rkyen de gnyis po'i dbar spyi dang bye brag gi 'brel bar grub pa'i phyir ro/ /4 rkyen bzhi po nyes par phog kyang des lus zungs nyen par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gnod bya bcu dang nyes pa gsum rten dang brten pa'i tshul du 'brel ba'am ngo bo bdag nyid gcig tu 'brel ba'i phyir rkyen bzhi'i byed pa la brten nas nyes pa 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum du gyur na gnod bya bcu la'ang gnod par byed/5 spyir dngarkyen zhes pa'i nges chig ci yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni bskyed gzhi'i rten nam sa bon dang / rkyen ni skyed byed dam bsgyur byed kyi grogs la bya/6 'phel zad 'khrugs pa gsum las 'khrugs zhes pa ci 'dra zhig la go dgos/lan/ gnod bya dang gnod byed kyi mtshan nyid gang rung zhig skyed cing 'phel pa de rang gnas su ma tshud par gzhan gnas la slebs te/ mtshan nyid
