rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 65mthun pa rnams lhan cig tu stobs can du gyur te de'i ldog phyogs su gyur pa'i mtshan nyid rnams 'joms par byed pa dang / stobs mtshungs pa'i mtshan nyid mi mthun pa rnams phan tshun 'thab pa la go dgos/ 7 gnod bya bcu la 'khrugs pa yod dam med/ rgyu mtshan riyin/lan/ bshad rgyud nad kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'ur tshig bsdus te gnod bya'i 'phel zad gnyis ma gtogs 'khrugs rtags dngos su ma gsungs kyang gnod bya la'ang 'khrugs pa yod pa lung rigs gnyis kyi sgo nas sgrub nus te/ mes zhal las/ 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum po de yang rlung la sogs pa'i nad dang / dwangs ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs dang / bshang gci la sogs pa'i dri ma dang rnam pa gsum po kho na la 'byung bar 'gyur te/ zhes gsal bar gsungs 'dug cing / gzhan yang 'phel pa dang 'khrugs pa gnyis rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul du gnas pa ste/ rgyu gnod bya bcu'i khams rgyun ldan gyi ldang tshad las mang du 'phel na da gzod mtshan nyid phan tshun 'khrugs par 'gyur nges shing / gal te gnod bya la 'phel pa yod tshe de dag tshad nges can la slebs na 'khrugs pa tan tan du 'byung rgyu ni dngos po'i chos nyid yin pas so/ // dwangs ma 'phel na bad gan dang 'dra ba'i rtags 'byung ba'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ dwangs ma dang bad kun gnyis rten dang brten pa'i tshul du

66 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gnas phyir de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid mthun pas rten dwangs ma 'phel na me drod nyams pa la sogs bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags 'byung ba yin/1 rlung zad pa'i rtags su bad gan 'phel rtags 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ rlung gi yang g.yo'i cha nyams na bad kun sa chu rang bzhin gyi lci brtan gyi cha 'phel pa ste/ gcig zad pa dang mtshungs ldan du cig shos mi mthun phyogs 'phel pa ni dngos po'i chos nyid yin pas so/ /10 mkhris pa 'khrugs pa'i rtags su rtsa rgyud phra grims mgyogs pa dang / chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che ba/ mgo na ba bcas 'byung ba'i mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid rno ba dang bsdongs pas rtsa rgyud phra grims mgyogs par 'phar ba dang / tsha ba lus khams la khyab nas khrag mkhris rgyas shing tsha ba'i rten snod mkhris yin pas chu mdog dmar ser dang / tsha ba'i drod kyis lus zungs 'dul bas dri ma dugs shing rlangs pa che/ me'i rang bzhin gyen du 'bar bas mgo bo na ba bcas pa'i rtags 'byung ba yin no/ /11 bdakan 'khrugs na kha zas 'ju stobs chung ba'i mtshan ci/lan/ gtso bo be snabs 'byar bag can de 'phel nas pho ba'i me drod kyis 'ju dka' ba dang / bad kun gyi mtshan nyid bsil ba'i cha 'phel nas grang ba'i stobs cher rgyas te pho ba'i me drod bsad pas red/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 6712 rkang zad pa'irtags su mgo 'khor ba'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ klad pa lus zungs bdun las rkang du gtogs shing / rkang dang klad pa'i ngo bo bdag gcig yin pas rkang zad na klad pa'i zungs bcud kyang nyams nas mgo 'khor ba yin/12 rus pa zad pa'irtags su skya 'byi zhing so dang sen mo phyung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skra dang so sen mo bcas ni lus zungs bdun gyi ya gyal rus pa'i snyigs ma yin pas red/14 ci 'dra zhig la mdangs zer ram/ mdangs nyams pa'i rtags ci yin/lan/ mdangs zhes pa ni lus zungs bdun gyi mtha' ma khu ba'i mthar phyin pa'am khu ba'i yang khu ste/ lus kyi gzi brjid dang bkrag mdangs sogs kyi rten byed cing snying la gnas pa'i dwangs ma'i ming yin la/ de nyid nyams pa'i rtags ni mdangs gnas pa'i snying gi rtsa stong bar gyur pa der rlung zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis glo bur du dngangs pa dang / lus rid pa/ rtag tu snying mi dga' ba dang nyam stobs chung la gzi brjid nyams pa bcas kyi rtags 'byung /15 rlung mkhris dang bad mkhris/ bad rlung bcas kyi thun mong gi gnas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rlung mkhris gnyis kyi thun mong gi gnas ni pags pa dang / bad

68 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/mkhris gnyis kyi thun mong gi gnas ni dwangs ma/ bad rlung gnyis kyi thun mong gi gnas ni dus tshigs so/ / 16 nad rigs thams cad 'jug sgo drug tu rim par 'jug nges sam/ rgyu mtshan ci/ lan/ nad kyi ngo bo dang ldang ba'i gnas sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis nad la la phyi nas nang la 'jug pa dang / la la nang nas phyi la 'jug pa'i phyir nad yod do cog phyi pags la grams nas nang snod du lhung ba ste 'jug sgo drug la rim pas 'jug pa dang / yang na 'jug sgo drug tshang bar 'jug dgos pa'i nges pa med mod/ spyir btang nad rnams thog mar pags pa dang shabar du rtsa dang rus pa/ tha mar don dang snod du rim gyis 'jug pa shas che bas rtsa rgyud sogs su 'jug sgo drug tu rim pas 'jug par gsungs pa dang /khyad par 'jug sgo drug ni gtso bo nad gzhi tsha ba can nam 'gos khyab rang bzhin can gyi rims nad phog tshul la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin te/ rin chen sprin gyi lding khang las/ nad rigs thams cad pags grams sogs/ /sgo drug rim bzhin 'jug tshul yang / / spyi yi dbang du byas nas gsungs/ /dper na tsha ba'i nad phal cher/ / lugs 'byung dbang du 'jug 'gyur kyang / / bye brag bad nad lta bu ni/ / thog mar pho ba'i gnas la 'jug /de nas rim pas rnying 'gyur tshe/ / lugs ldog phyi ru 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin tsha grang spyi rtsa drug / go ldog 'byung ba shes par bya/ / zhes dang /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 69legs bshad smra ba'i mchog thob las/ nad de dag gi 'jug sgo ni sha la rgyas shing pags la grams pa dang / la la rtsa ru rgyu zhing rus la zhen pa dang / la la don la 'bab cing snod du lhung bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa las 'thus snyam/17 ldan pa'i nad dang bla gnyan nad gnyisaspyi khyad par ci yin nam/lan/ ldan pa'i nad ces pa ni nad rkyang pa gnyis ldan pa ste/ rlung mkhris bad kun gang rung gnyis re 'dres pa'i nad yin zhing / bla gnyan gyi nad ces pa ni sngar yod pa'i nad kyi steng du nad gzhan zhig zhugs pa ste nad gnyis ka mnyam du byung ba ma yin pa/ ldan pa'i nad ni bla gnyan gyi nad ma yin zhing / bla gnyan gyi nad ni ldan pa'i nad yin par khyab/18 nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la gzhan dbang sngon las sogs kyi sgonas bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / nyes pa rigs gnas sogs kyi sgo nas bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhes 'dren lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa de gnyis dbar gyi 'brel ba' ltar yin nam/lan/ de gnyis ni spyi dang bye brag gi 'brel bar grub ste/ gang lags she na/ gzhan dbang sngon las dang / yongs grub tshe'i nad/ kun brtags gdon nad/ ltar snang 'phral gyi nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bo ni nad rigs yod tshad la gzhigs te spyi'i sgo nas gsungs pa dang / nyes pa dang / gtso bo/rigs/ gnas kyi nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bo ni sman pas gso yul dngos la gzhigs nas nad kyi rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags bcos sogs man rgyud du bye brag phra

70 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/zhib tu dngos su bstan pas so/ /sa bcad bzhi pa/ tha mal nad med/1 rgyun spyod dang dus spyod sogs bstan pa'i dgos pa ci yin nam/lan/ nam rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i nang lus sems la phan pa'i spyod lam ji ltar spyod pa dang mi phan pa'i spyod lam ji ltar spang dgos pa'i thabs shes ched rgyun spyod bstan pa dang / dbyar dgun ston dpyid sogs dus tshigs bzhi'am drug gi nam zla dro grang mi mtshungs pa las lus kyi khams kyang gcig tu mi gnas par 'gyur ldog 'byung srid pas dus tshigs so so'i khyad chos dang mthun pa'i zas spyod bsten thabs su dus spyod bstan pa/ nam rgyun ma yin par nam dgos kyi dus su spyod dgos pa'i gnas skabs kyi don bsgrub par byed pa'i spyod lam phran tshegs rigs ston pa gnas skabs kyi spyod lam bcas gsum ni nad med kyi dbang du bstan pa yin/2 rgya bur ba'i nad lnga bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ glo bur te gnas dus nges med gar yang 'byung srid cing / tshe srog la myur du gnod pa'am 'phrog par byed pa'i nad gag pa dang / pho loganywa log lhog pa/ sna khrag mang du shor ba bcas lnga'o/ /2 mi dge ba bcu po gang gang yin/lan/ rtsa bar/ srog gcod rku dang log par g.yem pa dang / / rdzun

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 71dang ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub dbyen sbyor dang / / brnabs sems gnod sems lta ba phyin ci log / sdig pa'i las bcu lus ngag yid kyis spang / / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /4 dus drug po'i lus stobs che chung gi go rima' ltar yin nam/lan/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang zhes pa ltar phyi'i nyi ma lho byang gi bgrod gnyis kyi 'gyur ba'i dbang gis nang gi 'byung ba'i stobs kyang 'phel 'bribyas te/ mi rnams kyi lus stobs dgun stod dang dgun smad gnyis la stobs che ba dang / pos ka dang dbyar gyi dus su stobs chung ba/ ston kha dang dpyid kyi dus su stobs 'bring du 'gyur ba yin/5 zas skom gyi sgror ba mkhas pa gces dgos pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ spyir zas skom gyi sbyor ba ni lus can rnams kyi srog 'tsho ba'i rgyu gtso bo zhig yin gshes/ zas skom gyi phan gnod legs par brtags nas longs spyad na lus dang srog la nye bar phan pas yun ring du 'tsho ba dang /bab col du zos shing 'thung na dman lhag log pa gang rung du gyur nas nad skyed pa ma zad srog kyang 'joms nges pas der mkhas pa zhig shin tu gces dgos/6 sha rigs n+de brgyad po gang dang gang yin nam/ lan/ khron gyis rko ba'i sde dang / mchu yis rko ba'i sde/ ri dwags kyi sde/gcan gzan gyi sde/ rtsal mthus za ba'i sde/ mi yis bdag byed pa'i sde/

72 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/khung du gnas pa'i sde/ rlan la gnas pa'i sde bcas so/ /7 yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu la khyad chos gang dang gang 'dzoms dgos/lan/ bsil ba dang / 'jam pa/ yang ba/ zhim pa/ dwangs pa/ dri ma med pa/ 'thung na lto ba dang mgrin pa la mi gnod pa bcas legs pa'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan dgos// byas sgo nga dang nya yi sha lta bu zas skom mi 'phrod pa'i rigs lhan du zosaskrung mi gnod pa'i mtshan ci yin/lan/ de ni rgyud las/ rtsol bcas snum bsten drod che dar la bab/ /stobs ldan goms par zos la gnod mi 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa tsam las 'thus snyam/9 zas chod legs par zin na dge mtshan ci yod dam/lan/ rtsa bar/ nyes pa lam min mi 'gro me drod 'bar/ / lus yang dang ga bde la dbang bo gsal/ / stobs che bshang gci 'og rlung bde bar rgyu/ / zas tshod legs par zin las 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /10 skyes pa ro tsa'i gtso bo dang bud med ro tsa'i yan lag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skyes pa ni ro tsa ba ste rigs rgyud spel ba'i rten gtso bo yin la/skyes pas 'dod pa tshul bzhin spyod par ma nus na rigs rgyud spel ba'i don mi

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 73'grub cing / bud med kyis skyes pa'i sa bon 'dzin zhing bu tsha rigs rgyud spel ba'i gzhir 'gyur ba zhig byed nus pa yin gyi pha'i rabs rgyud bu mos mi zin pas ro tsa'i yan lag du bzhag pa yin no/ /sa bcad lnga pa/ cha byad dpyad/1 cha byad rigs lnga bo gang gang yin pa dang nang gses zug chu brtag pa'i cha byad la dbye ba du yod dam/lan/ cha dpyad rigs lnga ni zug rngu brtag pa'i cha byad dang / zug rngu 'byin pa skam pa'i cha byad/ sha 'dral zhing khrag dbyung ba'i gtsags bu'i cha byad/ dbug par byed pa'i thur ma'i cha byad/ phran bu sna tshogs pa'i cha byad bcas lnga'o/ / dang po zug rngu brtag pa'i cha byad la mgo bo'i rus chag brtag pa'i cha byad dang / yan lag gi zug rngu brtag pa'i cha byad/ rnag brtag pa'i cha byad/ gzhang 'brum brtag pa'i cha byad bcas bzhi yod do/ /2 gtaratso don bdun gyi rgyas gzhi'i rtsa gang yin nam/lan/ srog rtsa dkar nag gnyis las nag po dang / nag po de las gyes pa'i sha khrag 'phel byed kyi rtsa chen nyer bzhi ni gtar rtsa'i gyes gzhi yin no/ /2 gtar rtsa don bdun gyi grangs 'dren skabs mgo ske dang rkang lag sbubs bcas la grangs ci tsam yod dam/

74 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ mgo skor nyer gcig dang / lag par sum cu so bzhi/ rkang bar bco brgyad/ sbubs la bzhi bcas so /4 mdor na lus kyi stod smad bar gsum gyi nad la gtar dmigs gang dang gang spyod dgos/lan/ lus stod kyi nad rnams la rtse chung dang sgang rtsa gtar rgyu dang /lus smad kyi nad rnams la long rtsa dang byin gzhug gnyis/ bar gyi nad la snod ka dang ru thung gtar dgos/ /5 mchog gsang gi 'jal tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ mtshog gsang la 'jal tshul mi 'dra ba gsum yod de/ gcig ni sna rtse nas yar la rang sor bcu gnyis bcal ba'i mtshams dang / gcig ni skra mtshams nas gyen la sor bzhi bcal ba'i mtshams/ cig shos ni smin mtshams nas gyen du sor brgyad 'jal ba'i tshad yin mod/ mi so so'i skra mtshams la mtho dma' shin tu che phyir gnyis pa ltar bcal na gsang du khel dka' bas dang po dang gsum pa ltar bcal na legs par 'dod/6 zungs khrag yin yang gtar dgos pa'i nad gsum ni gang gang yin nam/lan/ don gzer dang / khrag gzer/ 'ol ka bsgyur ba gsum la zungs khrag yin yang dbyung dgos/7 gnyan tshad dang zungs zad tshad pa gnyis tsha ba'i nad yin yang

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 75gtar mi rung ba'i mtshan gang yin/lan/ be bum nag po las/ gnyan gyi rigs la gtar ba na/ / lhog thabs spangs shing don la 'chor/ / zungs zad shed med gtar gyur na/ /de srog gshin rjes 'khrid par byed/ / ces gsungs pa las 'thus snyam// dpyad0 nang nas mchog tu rgyur pa gtar ga yin pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gtar gas nad rgyu dang bcas pa dngos su lus kyi phyir 'byin pas red/kha mgo yi gtar rtsa gser mdung dang dngul mdung gnyis kyi ming ji ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ dpral rtsa dang gser mdung dngul mdung ni don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ dpral rtsa g.yas pa snod mkhris rgyas pas gser mdog ltar mngon pas gser mdung dang / g.yon pa bad mkhris kyi mdog ltar dkar po yin pas dngul mdung zer/10 gtar rtsa kha shas la ming gi rnam grangs gnyis re yod pa de dag gang dang gang yinanam/lan/ shel dkar me long las/ skyor gong khyor gong gnyis don gcigabyin skyog dang byin cog don gcig a so zhes dang snod ka don gcig gru mgo dang drug mgo gnyis kyang don gcig mur gong 'phar rtsa ltag ral gnyis don gcig ces pa 'di dag go /

76 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/11 min 'byed kyi thang ma btang bar khrag gtar che nyen skyon gang dang ci yod/lan/ khrag gtar ba'i sngun la gdus thang nad gzhi dang bstun nas ma btang bar gtar na nad khrag mi thon la zungs khrag 'chor zhing rlung skye ba/tshad ro lus pa bcas pa'i nyes skyon dag 'byung ngo / /12 khrag gtar skabs khrag mi thon pa'i rgyu bcu po de dag gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ dang po lus grang mtshon rtul 'grangs drags byed/ / gdon dang 'grul sna kha chung pags pa 'chus/ / bsnyal ma thog gtar gtar ma thog tu glod/ / de dag khrag mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /rgyu bcu spangs na gtar ga brdugs dogs med/ / ces gsungs pa 'di'o/ /12 gtar ga phyis pa dang me btsa' snga na skyon ci yod/lan/ zhang sman nag pos/ gtar ga phyis na nad khrag lus la zhen/ /me btsa' sngas na nad ro btson du lus/ / de'i phyir ma snga ma phyi bya ra gces/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /14 mdor na me btsa' gdab rung ba'i nad gzhi gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ mdor na bad kun dang rlung las gyur pa'i grang ba'i nad rigs

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 77kun dang / khyad par du rtsa dkar gyi nad dang chu ser gyi nad thams cad me btsas bsregs pa bsngags/15 me btsa'i skabs yan stong chigs pa dang po rlung gi gsang dang /gnyis pa mkhris gsang / gsum pa bdakan gsang du bzhag pa'ir+gha mtshan ci/lan/ rtsa dkar gyi gzhi rten klad pa yin pa dang / de la gtso bo rlung rgyu bas 'di klad pa la khad nye bas dang po rlung bzhag mkhris pa'i rten gtso bo mchin pa dang snod mkhris yin zhing de gnyis bar na gnas pas mkhris pa gnyis par bzhag bad kun grang ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas ma zhu ba la grang ba 'byung / pho ba dang khan nye bas gsum par bzhag pa yin no/ /16 rgyab gsang nyi shu la me gdab skabs byang zur gnyis kyi khyad par ci yin nam/lan/ an stong tshigs pa dang po ngos 'dzin tshul byang zur gnyis kyi 'dod tshul cung zad mi 'dra bas me btsa' 'jog skabs kyang he bag cung tsam yod de/ byang lugs rnams kyis sgal tshigs kyi mkhar mtshams rus 'bur 'og gi nyag nyag po de la 'jog pa dang / zur lugs rnams kyis sgal tshigs mkhar gyi rus pa 'bur po'i steng du 'jog srol mchis/ yin yang de gnyis kyi phan nus gcig mtshungs yin/17 dbang bo'i sgo dang pho mo'i srid rtsar me btsa' gdab mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/

78 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ dbang bo'i sgor me gdab na mthong thos sogs kyi dbang bo'i rten gtso bo'i byed las nyams nges shing / srid rtsa ni sa bon dkar dmar ram khams dkar dmar rgyu ba'i gnas yin phyir der me gdab na rigs rgyud spel mi thub pas red/1〈 me btsa' la btso bsreg bsro bsdig ches gdab thabs bzhi yod pa de dag gi tshad gzhi' ltar yin nam/lan/ me btsa' btso ba zhes pa ni me btsa' snga ma bzhag pa'i rma rnams gsos rjes phyi ma rim bzhin lan grangs nyi shu'i bar du bzhag pa la bya/ me btsa' bsreg pa ni me btsa' snga ma gsos rjes phyi ma rim bzhin lan grangs bco lnga tsam gdab pa/ bsro ba ni lan grangs lnga'am bdun gong bzhin gdab pa la bya/ bsdig pa ni me btsa' lan grangs gcig las ma bzhag pa dngangs pa tsam la bya'o/ /19 me btsa' 'byar bar byed pa'i man ngag gsum ni gang gang yin nam/lan/ gong sman pas/ mar nag rgyungs pa sgog pa rnam pa gsum/ /me btsa'i dam rtsi byed pa'i man ngag yin/ / zhes pa ltar mar nag dang /rgyungs pa/ sgog pa bcas gsum mo/ /2༷ gnas0 dbang du byas na lus kyi stod mad la me gdab skabs do snang byed dgos sa ci yod/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 79lan/ lus stod ni me khams yin pas spyir btang me btsa' ma tshos par bsreg dgos shing / lus smad ni chu khams yin pas tshos par bsreg chog21 snod la zas zos rjes me gdab mi rung ba'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ zas zos ma thag pa'i rjes su pho ba sogs rgyas pas me dmigs 'gyur 'gro bas red/22 me dang sngags kyi rigs spang dgos pa'i nad tshang bzhi bo'i gnas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ ske stong ca ra khung nas gyen du tshon phyed bcal ba nad tshang 'go ma dang / de nas gyen du tshon phyed bcal ba nad tshang bar ma/ ol mdud kyi 'go ni nad tshang chen mo/ de nas gyen du tshon phyed bcal na nad tshang gong ma'o/ /22 'dus so che 'bring chung gsum po gang dang gangayin nam/lan/ klag pa'i kun shes las/ spyi gtsug ni sha rus rtsa klad thams cad 'dus pas 'dus so chen po dang / mtshogs ma ni sha dang rus pa 'dus pas 'dus so chung ba/ ltag sgo ni sha rus rtsa gsum 'dus pas 'dus so bar ma/zhes spyi gtsug dang / mtshogs ma/ ltag pa'i sdud sgo gsum la 'dus so gsum mam sdud sgo gsum zer/24 sdud sgo bzhi zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ 'di la lugs gnyis te/ gcig ni ltag pa'i sdud sgo dang /

80 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/smin mtshams/ rna ltag skra mtshams gnyis bcas bzhi'i ming dang / cig thos ni spyi gtsug nas mdun rgyab gnyis dang g.yas g.yon gnyis su sor drug re bcal ba'i gnas su bzhed/25 dpyad lnga'i dgos pa dang khyad chos ci yin nam/lan/ tsha ba'i nad kyi ro ma phyir dbyung ba la gtar dang / grang ba'i nad kyi stobs gzhom par byed pa la me btsa'/ ldan 'dus bad kun shas cher sel ba la dugs/ ldan 'dus mkhris pa shas cher sel ba la lums/ ldan 'dusatwang nad shas cher sel ba la byug pa/ 'di rnams gnas skabs kyi sgo nas 'brel/26 stor gyi me btsa' ji ltar sbyar dgos shing hor me yi gsang dmigs gang gang yin/ hor me ni me btsa' yin nam/lan/ spyir go stod snum ldan dang dkar gong srin can nas tsam brdungs te phying bar dril dgos mod/ deng sang go stod dang dzā ti gnyis kyi phye ma seng ras su btums pa 'bri mar rnying ba'i nang btsos nas drod dang ldan par byas te spyi gtsug dang / ltag pa'i sdud sgo/ mtshogs ma/ dkar nag mtshams/ tshigs pa dang po/ drug pa/ bdun pa/ rkang lag gi mthil bzhi sogs rlung gsang rnams la bdug bzhin yod/ 'di la hor me zer yang dugs kyi khongs su gtogs/27 lums0 phan yon ci yin nam/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 81lan/ lums kyis lus la tsha ba'i nad kyi rlangs pa khyab pa dang /mkhris pa'i dwangs ma chu ser 'phel nas tshigs dmigs dang sha pags su rgyas pa rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'don pa dang / gzhan yang rlung 'dul ba dang / khrag rlung gi rgyu lam khegs nas sha rus skrangs pa rtsa nas 'joms pa lus kyi zungs zad nas skem por gyur pa rnams slar sha rgyas pa bcas byed thub/ 2/ gnasakyi sgo nas lums mi rung ba gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ mig dang mkhur tshos dreg bzhi rlig pa dang / / lto ba snying ga'i gnas su lums mi rung / / zhes pa ltar yin/29 bdud rtsi lnga lums0 khyad chos ci yin nam/lan/ de'u dmar bas/ ba lu mi yi bdud rtsis pags mnyen byed/ /shug pa lha yi bdud rtsi yon tan mang / / mtshe sdum btsan gyi bdud rtsis lus zungs brtas/ / 'om bu klu yi bdud rtsis rus dug 'byin/ / mkhan skya sde brgyad bdud rtsis 'byung ba snyoms/ / zhes gsungs pa las 'khums/2'a dreg nad tsha 'brab byed pa la dugs gang brgyab na zug gtsog nges pa yin nam/lan/ dreg nad kyis tsha shar rgyag pa la sle tres phye ma dang ba'i lci ba mnyam du bsres nas grang dugs brgyab na zug gzer myur tu gcog nges/21 byug pa mi rung ba'i nad gzhi gang dag yin nam/lan/ ma zhu brla rengs dbyig dug yi ga 'chus/ / dmu rdzing bad kun

82 gso rig skor gyi dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/nad la snam byug spang / / zhes rgyud las gsungs/22 rlung nad brla rengs la byug pa spang dgos don ci/lan/ brla rengs kyi nad ni rten dang brten par gnas pa'i bad gan dang tshil 'phel ba las byung bas na der snum 'chos spangs nas rtsub bcos bsten dgos/22 dpyad lnga'i log gnon du thur ma 'jog dgos don ci yin/lan/ de yang gso dpyad gzhan rdugs pa dang / nad rlangs 'khyims pa/ skran bsheg pa/ rnag khrag dmu chu sogs thad kur 'byin 'joms byed pa la gtar bsreg dugs lums byug pa lnga las thur ma mchog tu gyur pas de dag gi log gnon du thur ma bzhag pa yin no/ /24 thur ma'i phanayon ci yinanam/lan/ rgyud las/ thur ma'i phan yon rlung kha gnon pa dang / / grang ba'i drod skyed skran bshig ma zhu 'ju/ / rlangs pa 'khyims pa gseng zhing sha bem gseng / / rnag khrag chu ser dpu chu phyir la 'byin/ / de dag thur ma byas pa'i phan yon yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sa bcad drug pa/ ngos bzung rtags/1 bshad rgyud le'u bcu gnyis par nad stobs yul dus rang bzhin na chod dang zhes bdun bstan pa dang / bshadargyud le'u nyer bzhi bar brtag

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 83sgo yul dus rang bzhin na chod dang zhes bdun du bstan pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ le'u bcu gnyis par yul dus sogs bdun bstan pa ni nad stobs che chung gi dbye ba 'byed pa dang / le'u nyer bzhi bar yul dus sogs bdun bstan pa ni nad gzhi kyang ba ldan 'dus kyi dbye ba 'byed pa'i ched yin/2 ngan g.yo skyon brtag bstan pa'i dgos pa ci yin nam/lan/ brtag thabs 'di thad kur bltas na sman pa'i mtshan snyan grags dang / zas nor longs spyod sogs rgyas pa'i ched du mthong srid kyang /dmigs yul nyag cig ni nad gzhi 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin thub pa dang /de la brten nas bcos thabs kyi gnyen po gnad khel du bsten nas gso bya'i nad de bcos thub pa'i ched kho na yin/ gal te de ltar min na bshad rgyud sman pa'i le'ur bstan pa'i sman pa'i kun spyod dang 'gal ba'i nyes skyon yod/2 ngan g.yo skyon gyi sgo nas brtag thabs brgyad po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ nad rnams kyi mtshan nyid ji ltar yin pa shes par bya ba dang /mtshang 'bru ba'i sgo nas nad gang yin pa brtag pa/ de dus bsring ba/ sngar rjes bcad pa/ bcud la bor ba/ kha bcing ba/ spo la gdon pa/ thabs 'og tu gzhug pa ste thabs tshul rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas brtag par bya dgos/ /4 sman pa'i sgo nas gso sla ba la charkyen gang dag tshang dgos/

84 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ rgyud las/ sman pa mkhas pa'i stegs la 'dzegs pa dang / /gzhung gi don shes las rnams mthong zhing gtsang / / zhes pa 'di'o/ /5 khrag skyan rnying pa gso sla ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ khrag skran rnying pa yin na der smin byed dang bzhu byed mi dgos pas thad kur sbyang na sel nus te/ rgyud las/ gsar dus chags mod mchin pa lta bu gnyan/ / rnyings shing rul nas gso ba sla ba yin/ / zhes gsungs pas 'thus snyam/6 mi'i lus0 rtsa 'phar bar byed pa'i gang yin nam/lan/ 'di'i bad la stong thun nyi 'od rab gsal las/ snying la gnas pa'i khyab byed kyis/ / las rnams spyi dang khyad par du/ / snying gi bu ga 'byed zum byed/ / ji ltar sbud pas rlung sbud bzhin/ / khrag rnams bu ga rnams su gtor/ / de tshe lus kyi bye brag gi / rtsa yang lhan gcig 'phar bar byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar snying la gnas pa'i khyab byed rlung gi byed las la brten nas snying gi bu ga 'byed 'dzum byas tshe de dang 'brel ba'i rtsa rnams kyang 'gul zhing 'phar bar byed do/ /7 rtsa rgyud le'u bzhi bar mkhris pa'i rtsa ni mgyogs rgyas grims par 'phar zhes dang / phyi rgyud rtsa mdo'i le'ur mkhris pa'i rtsa ni phra la grims par 'phar zhes pa gnyis 'gal lam/ ci'i phyir/lan/ de gnyis mi 'gal te/ rtsa rgyud skabs kyi mkhris rtsa 'di ni nyes

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 85pa'i mkhris pa la dgongs pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud ni nad mdor bstan skabs yin pas so/ / phyi rgyud rtsa mdo'i skabs kyi mkhris rtsa 'di ni snod kyi mkhris pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin te/ tsha ba'i rtsa 'og nas rigs sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pas so/ /ra bdagan sprug po'i rtsa sbom la khengs ging gan rtsa zhar ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ khrag ngan zungs su ma smin par rtsa sbubs su rgyug pas rtsa rgyud sbom la nang khengs pa can 'byung ba dang / nad 'bab sa gtso bo pho mchin gnyis yin pas kun rtsa gnyis zhar ba ste mi gsal bar 'phar/9 rnag gi rtsa 'dar ba dang yang na tsha la spun par 'phar ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rnag gi rtsa ba chu ser yin pas rtsa rgyud 'dar ba dang / yang na tsha ba'i drod kyis lus zungs 'drul nas rnag pas tsha ba'i rtsa ltar spun pa can 'phar ba yin no/ /10 khag lus zungs yin yang nad du bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ khrag de rnam par ma gyur na lus brlan zhing srog 'tsho ba'i rten byed pas lus zungs yin mod/ gal te rkyen dang phrad nas rnam par gyur na tsha bar 'gyur zhing nad gzhi mkhris pa'i rten byed pa ma zad lus srog 'joms pa'i rgyu'ang yin pas nad du bzhag pa yin/

86 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/11 rtsa'i nor 'phrang drug po'i bsal thabs ltar yin nam/lan/ lag len gsal byed las/ khrag rtsa rlung rtsa rkyal bar mtshungs na yang / / rlung rtsa stong la khrag rtsa 'bur 'dril rgyas/ / rgyas tshad stongs tshad rgyug par mtshungs na yang / / rgyas tshad drag grims stongs tshad mnan mi bzod/ / bad kun khrag rgan bying bar mtshungs na yang / / bad kun gud bul khrag rgan grims la mkhrang / / zheng gsungs pa ltar yin/12 rtsa la sdod 'bab pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ khyab byed rlung gis byed las tshul bzhin byed ma thub par rtsa'i 'phar 'phro chad nas skabs skabs su mi 'phar bar sdod pa yin/12 'chi rtsarkang ba'i bol la brtag dgos pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ byang ba bkra shes dpal bzang gis/ chags pa'i thog ma lte ba ste/ / de nas rim bzhin mtha' la gyes/ / 'chi tshe mtha' nas rlung khrag sdud/ / de nas dbus kyi snying nyid nyams/ / zhes gsungs pa'i lung gis sgrub nus so/ /14 rtsa brtag skabs pho rtsa g.yon dang mo rtsa g.yas su brtag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skyes pa'i snying gi yid 'jug bu ga'i rtsa'i rtse mo lus kyi g.yon ngos su kha gtad nas gnas pa dang / bud med kyi snying gi yid 'jug bu ga'i rtsa'i rtse mo lus kyi g.yas ngos su kha gtad nas gnas par dgongs nas gsungs pa

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 87yin te/ gong sman pa'i dris lan rab gsal me long las/ phyi rgyud rtsa mdo gsungs pa'i skabs/ / snying rtsa pho g.yon mo g.yas su/ / gsungs pa snying gi yid 'jug gi / rtsa yi rtse mo thabs shes dbang / / pho g.yon mo g.yas bstan phyogs kyi/ / rlung khrag de'i phyogs bzhur ba la/ / dgongs nas de ltar gsungs pa las/ / gzhan pa pho mo go ldog pa'i/ / snying gi gnas stangs dbye ba med/ / ces gsungs so/ /15 rtsa brtag skabs sor mo'i yar zur la don lnga dang mar zur la snod drug gi tha snyad sbyar dgos don ci yin nam/lan/ don lnga bo ni rlung khrag gi dwangs ma'i rten yin pas de dag gi rtsa sor mo'i yar zur du bzhag pa dang / snod drug ni lus zungs dri ma bcas kyi snyigs ma gsog pa'i snod yin phyir sor mo'i mar zur du bzhag pa ste/ byang ba bkra shis dpal bzang gis/ sor mo'i yar zur don lnga dang / / mar zur snod drug bzhag pa ni/ / lus kyi dwangs ma gnas pa'i don/ / gtso bo yin phyir yar zur bkod/ / 'byung lnga'i zas snyigs gsog pa'i snod/ /phal ba yin phyir mar zur bkod/ / de yang rang rang khams mthun pa'i/ /snod rnams don gyi rjes su 'brang / / zhes gsungs pa las 'khums so/ /16 sbrum ma'i mkhal rtsa g.yas pa drag na bu pho dang g.yon pa drag na bu mo yin pa'irgyumatshan ci yin nam/lan/ de ni ro rkyang gnyis kyi gnas phyogs dang thabs shes dbang gis

88 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/ma yin par pho mo'i chags sdang dbang gis yin te/ gnad kyi lde mig las/sbrum mar mngal gnas bu yin na ma'i lus g.yas ngos su gnas pa dang / bu mo yin na ma'i lus g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir thabs shes dang ro rkyang dbang du byas na skyes pa g.yon dang / bud med g.yas su gnas dgos kyang skabs 'dir pho mo'i chags sdang dbang gis de ltar go ldog ste chags pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs/ des na mngal gnas bu pho yin na mkhal rtsa g.yas pa drag pa dang / bu mo yin na mkhal rtsa g.yon pa drag pa'i lung rigs kyi khungs ngo ma de 'di la gtugs snang /17 tha mal rten gyi rtsa rgyud rnam gsum la po rtsa mo rtsa byang chub sems rtsa zhes ming btags pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ rten pho mo so po'i gzugs dang / skad gdangs/ 'gros sogs la gzhigs nas rtsa la'ang phra sbom dang myur bul sogs mtshan nyid 'dra mthun sbyar nas ming de ltar mdzad pa yin te/ gong sman pa'i rtsa'i stong thun las/pho dang mo dang byang sems kyi/ / gzugs dang skad dang 'gros la sogs/ /nyes gsum rkyang ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ / rtsa yi phra sbom myur bul sogs/ /mtshan nyid 'dra mthun dbang du sbyar/ / zhes gsungs/1/ mi'i lus na gnas pa'i bla zhes pa de ci 'dra zhig la go dgos/lan/ bla ni tshe srog gi rten du gyur pa'i dwangs ma'i rlung dang / thig le/rnam shes bcas lhan gcig tu 'grogs pa'i cha de la bya zhing / bla dang tshe srog

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 89gsum spyi'i dbang du byas na gcig lta bu yin yang / phra zhib byas na kha kha yin te/ dper na tshe ni mar lta bu dang / srog ni mar me yi mchod sdong lta bu/ bla ni mar me yi 'od lta bu yin par bshad/19 ja mtshar rtsa'i go don ci yin nam/lan/ byang ba bkra shes dpal bzang gis/ mo rtsis pra la ma brten par/ / rang bzhin snga phyi'i bya ba kun/ / lkog tu gyur pa bde blag tu/ /rtogs phyir ngo mtshar rtsa zhes bya/ / zhes so/ /20 ngo mtshar rtsa bdun nad med mi la blta zhes pa'i nad med dang nad can gyi tshad de' ltar yin nam/lan/ 'di'i thad la rje g.yu thog pas/ dang po nad kyi byung tshul ni/ /'byung ba bzhi bo cha mi snyoms/ / de la brten nas nyes gsum 'khrugs/ /nyes gsum 'khrugs pas nad can 'gyur/ / dang po 'byung bzhi cha snyoms na/ / nyes gsum 'khrugs pa ga la srid/ / nyes gsum ma 'khrugs nad mi 'gyur/ / nad can nad med ngos 'dzin yin/ / zhes dang / so so'i skye bo gzhir bzhag na/ / ma rig nad bral yod ma yin/ / ring rgyu'i dbang byas nad bral med/ / nye rgyu'i dbang byas nad bral yod/ / des na drang srong mkhas rnams kyis/ / ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gsungs pa yang / / nye rgyu'i dbang du byas nas gsungs/ / ring rgyu'i dbang du byas pa med/ / ces gsungs pa ltar yin/

90 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/21 ma bu dgra grogs kyi skabs su khyo ga chung ma'i grogs dang / chung ma khro ga'i dgra ru brtsi dgos don ci yin/lan/ ji skad du/ khu ba bu sbyin phyir na grogs/ / thig le zungs 'phrog phyir na dgra/ / zhes pa ltar dang / khyo ga ni chung mas longs su spyad bya yin pas chung ma'i grogs su brtsi dgos pa dang / chung ma ni khyo ga 'joms byed kyi gshed yin pas khyo ga'i dgra ru brtsi dgos/22 khyug na rtsa stod zhan pa dang 'khru na rtsa smad zhan pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skyug na rtsa stod zhan don ni pho ba'i yan lus stod kyi zungs stobs shor ba dang / 'khru na rtsa smad zhan pa ni lte ba'i man lus smad kyi zungs stobs shor bas yin te/ gong sman pa'i rtsa'i stong thun las/ skyug na tshon rtsa gnyis po zhan/ / ci phyir zhe na stod zungs shor/ / 'khru na chag rtsa gnyis po zhan/ / ci phyir zhe na smad zungs shor/ / zhes so/ /22 mthong ba me long chu la sngon 'gro dang blta dus sogs sa bcad brgyad kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i dge mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ 'di'i thad la gnad kyi lde mig las/ sngon 'gro bstan pas nad chu rtogs/ blta dus bstan pas chu yi rang mtshan rtogs/ snod kyi khyad par bstan pas chu yi rang mdog mthong / gyur tshul bstan pas chu yi rang bzhin shes/ nad med kyi chu bstan pas nad can zhar la rtogs/ nad chu bstan pas nad spyi dang bye brag gi mtshan nyid shes/ 'chi chu bstan pas nad gso

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 91ba'i spang blang gi shan shes/ gdon chu bstan pas kun brtags dang yongs grub nad kyi bcos thabs rtogs/ zhes gsungs pa las 'khums so/ /24 chu brtag pa'i sngon 'gro'i skabs gso bya skom par mi sdad cing nyal po dang gnyid chag pa spang dgos don ci/lan/ kha skom par bsdad na lus kyi chu khams bri nas dri chu ska bar gyur te khrag mkhris kyi chu dang 'khrul sla zhing / nyal po spyad na gnod bya dang gnod byed 'khrugs pa dang / gnyid chag na lus stobs 'joms shing rlung 'phel pas de dag spang dgos/25 chu la brtag pa'i dus gsum dang brtag tshul dgu bo gang dag yin nam/lan/ rgyud du/ dus gsum tshan de ngad yal grang ba gsum/ / tshan de'i dus su mdog rlangs dri me tog / ngad yal dus su ku ya spris ma brtag / grangs nas ldog dus ldog tshul log rjes brtag / ces pa 'di dgu'o/ /26 dri chu'i 'khrul so rigs lnga bo ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ ltar snang gi 'khrul so dang / ldog dus kyi 'khrul so/ me tog gi 'khrul so/ spris ma'i 'khrul so/ kha dog gi 'khrul so bcas lags/27 ltar snang gi 'khrul soji ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ kha dog dkar sngo ku ya mthug pa'i chu/ / ltar snang

92 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/grang yang gting na tshad pa yod/ / dmar ser dri chung ku ya med pa ni/ /ltar snang tsha yang ngo bo grang ba yin/ / zhes so/ /2/ rlung gi chu mdog sngo po dang mkhris pa'i chu mdog dmar ser/bad gan gyi chu mdog dkar po yin pa'agyu mtshan ci/lan/ rlung gi dri chu sngo po yin don ni/ rlung ni lus kyi zungs bcud nyams pa las byung bas na rang mdog mngon pa dang / khrag mkhris rgyas pa dang snod kyi mkhris pa ni tsha ba thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin pas mkhris pa'i chu mdog dmar ser yin/ bad kun ni pho ba'i me drod nyams pa las byung zhing khrag mkhris kyi sdong zla med pas rang mdog dkar po thon pa yin/29 tsha ba'i 'chi chu khrag 'drasha dul mnam pa'ir+gha mtshan ci/lan/ khrag dang 'dra ba ni khrag zungs su ma gyur par mar babs pas khrag dang 'dra zhing / tsha bas lus zungs 'drul bas ko rul mnam pa yin/20 ku ya yod sa'i gnas las lus kyi stod smad bar gsum gyi nad brtag tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ ku ya dri chu'i steng ngam chu khar gnas na mgo dang glo snying sogs lus kyi stod na nad yod pa dang / dri chu'i bar du yod na mchin mkhris pho mcher sogs lus kyi bar na nad yod pa/ dri chu'i 'og gam snod kyi zhabs su 'byung na mkhal rked dang rgyu long lhang phug dag la nad yod pa yin/ kha zhabs kun tu snyoms par khyab 'dug na lus kyi stod smad bar gsum dang don

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 93snod rnams su nad kyis ma btab pa'i mngon tshul yin pa'am/ yang na 'dus nad yin pa'i rtags yin/21 tsha ba byer ba dang grang ba 'byams pa/ gdon shas che ba'i chu gsum mi ldog pa'agyu mtshan ci/lan/ tsha ba byer ba ni rlung gis byer du bzhug pas rlung gi ngo bo grang ba yin pas mi ldog pa dang / grang ba 'byams pa ni grang ba lus zungs la khyab par gyur pa dang rgyas par gyur pas mi ldog pa/ gdon gyis bla tshe srog gsum phrogs nas lus kyi drod nyams pas gdon shas che ba'i chu yang mi ldog go /22 lar na stongs tshad khrag tshad dmar por 'khrul/ / bad gan smugapo chu ser smug por 'khrul/ / mkhal ma mchin pa mcher gsum dmar por 'khrul/ / gab tshad bad rlung grang ba sngon por 'khrul/ / zhes pa'i dri chu'i 'khrul so bsal thabasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ skyem pa'i lag len gsal byed las/ stongs tshad dmar yang dwangs la wu ba che/ / khrag tshad dmar yang ska dugs ku ya 'dril/ / bad kun smug po smug kyang rnyogs la dugs/ / chu ser smug kyang rgya bshal dwangs pa'o/ / mchin tshad dmar rnyogs mcher tshad dmar la smug / mkhal tshad khrag 'dra mtshal zhabs gting du snyigs/ / gab tshad sngo yang ska la ku ya mthug / grang ba sngo yang sla la ku ya srab/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /22 spyir na don nad rtsa dang snod kyi nad rnams chu la gsal ba'i rgyu

94 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/mtshan ci/lan/ lag len gsal byed las/ don gyi nad rnams rtsa la gsal te/rlung khrag don la rgyu ba shas che bas so/ / snod kyi nad rnams chu la gsal te/nad chu snod rnams su brgyud nas 'byung bas so/ / zhes gsungs pa las 'thus/24 'tsho 'chi'i la shan rtsa yis 'byed na yang / / tsha grang la shan chu la mthong bas gsal/ / zhes pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gso bya'i 'tsho 'chi rtsa la gsal te srog gnas rtsa ba rtsa yin pa dang / nad kyi tsha grang chu la gsal te ku ya khrag mkhris nas byung bas phyir/'di'i thad la gnad kyi lde mig las/ 'tsho 'chi'i la shan rtsa yis 'byed de/khyab byed rlung gi byed las la brten nas rtsa 'phar ba yin pas/ de'i rgyun las srog gi rten nyams ma nyams shes nus pas so/ / tsha grang la shan chu la gsal te/ khrag mkhris dang lhan cig tu chu khams lus kun la khyab par nges pas so/ / zhes gsungs/25 bshad da khyad par gso tshul gyi le'ur gnod bya yul dus rang bzhinan chod dang zhes bcu bstan pa dang / man rgyud tsha grang gal mdo'i le'ur rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na chod dang zhes bcu bstan pa'i dge mtshan ci/lan/ bshad rgyud le'u nyer brgyad pa'i gnod bya yul dus sogs bcu

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 95ni dman lhag log pa'i bcos nyes dang bral te nad dang 'tshams pa'i gnyen po bsten pa'i ched yin zhing / rgyud chen le'u bcu gsum pa'i rgyu rkyen yul dus sogs bcu ni ltar snang rtags kyi dbang du ma shor bar tsha grang gi dbye ba 'khrul med du rtogs pa'i ched yin no/ /26 tsha grang gal mdo'i 'khrul so rim par bsal thabs ltar snang lnga drugs zhes pa de' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ nad gzhi'i ltar snang 'khrul so rtags kyis bsal/ / rtags kyi ltar snang 'khrul so bcos kyis bsal/ / bcos kyi ltar snang 'khrul so goms pas bsal/ / goms pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so skyed kyis bsal/ / bcos skyed ltar snang 'khrul so chu yis bsal/ / chu mdog ltar snang 'khrul so ku yas bsal/ / de la nor ba nam yang 'byung mi srid/ / de dag ltar snang lnga phrugs zhes bya ste/ / 'khrul med tsha grang gnad kyi gal mdo yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /sa bcad bdun pa/ gso byed thabs/1 nad spyi'i gso tshul gyi rtsa dona' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ dang po rlung la sogs pa ji snyed nad/ / rang gnas gsog pa'i dus su bsal bar bya/ / langs shing rgyas nas nad gzhan 'khrug byed phyir/ / gzhan la gnod pa med pa'i sbyor bas gso/ / nad

96 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gzhan skyes na nad stobs gang che bcos/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /2 phyi ma da du zas zhu sman la sman zhu zas btang gtses zhes pa dang /bshadargyud du sman btang tshul bcu ltar ma btang bar kun la zhu dus btang na rmongs pa'i lugs yin zhes gsungs pa gnyis phan tshun mi 'gal lam/lan/ mi 'gal te/ phyi ma rgyud du zas zhu sman la sman zhu zas btang gces zhes pa ni spyi'i gtong tshul te nad phal mo che la de ltar gtong chog pa dang 'ju sla ba'i dge mtshan yod pa bcas la gzhigs nas gsungs pa dang /bshad rgyud du nad kyi gnas dang mtshan nyid/ nad ldang ba'i dus bcas la bltas nas gang la de 'tsham gyi nad dang sbyar te sman gtong tshul mi 'dra ba bcu bstan pa ni bye brag gi sman gtong tshul yin pas de gnyis spyi dang bye brag gi 'brel bar grub pas so/ /2 rlung mkhris bad gan gyi nad so sor sad mda'i sman gang dang gang gtong dgos sam/lan/ rlung gi nad la sad mda' sre long gi thang dang / mkhris pa'i nad la sad mda' tig ta'i thang / bad kun gyi nad la sad mda' rgyam tsha gsum thang gtong dgos so/ /4 tsha ba stobs can nad la chu bzhi dang grang ba stobs can nad la me bzhis bcos zhes pa de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ tsha ba stobs can nad la chu bzhi dbab/ / ga bur rtse

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 97chung sman dang dpyad kyi chu/ / kha zas yin la gtad pa zas kyi chu/ / bsil sar sdod pa spyod lam chu yis bcos/ / grang ba stobs can nad la me bzhi spor/ / drod dgu sbyar ba sman gyi me yin te/ / me btsa' dpyad me drod bcud zas kyi me/ / gnas gos dro ba spyod lam me yis bcos/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /5 gso tshul mi 'dra ba dgu bstan pa'i dgos pa dang rin thang ci yin nam/lan/ gso tshul dgu ni nad rigs spyi bye brag dang bcas pa gso bcos byed pa'i brgyud rim nang nad gzhi'i ngo bo mi 'dra ba dang / 'phel rim gyi gnas skabs mi 'dra ba/ mngon tshul gyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba sogs kyi khyad chos dngos dang bstun nas gang la de 'tsham gyi gso tshul khyar par can 'dzin dgos pa'i thabs dpe don dang bcas gsal bar ston pa'i rig pa zhig yin gshes/ de ni rang re'i gso rig gi nad gzhi gso tshul gyi man ngag chen po dang nad sman sprod pa'i gcus gzer lta bu yin/6 gnyen po bzhi bsten pa'i go rim la rgyud las zas spyod sman dpyad dang / sman dpyad zas spyod/ spyod lam zas dang sman dpyad ces mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung ba la dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa ci yod dam/lan/ zas spyod sman dpyad ces pa ni spyir btang dang yongs khyab la kha gtad pa dang / khyad par du nad rigs stobs chung gi gras la gzhigs nas

98 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gsungs/ sman dpyad zas spyod ces pa ni shin tu stobs che ba'i tsha grang gang rungagi nad rnams la gnyen po bzhi bo dpung bskyed de shugs chen po bsten par dgongs pa dang / spyod lam zas dang sman dpyad ces pa ni nad bye brag pa'i dgos mkho la gzhigs nas gsungs pa yin/7 rten dang brten pa 'phel zad bcos thabs gcig ces pa'i go dona' ltar yin nam/lan/ spyir lus nad gnyen po thams cad 'byung ba bzhi las grub pas na rten lus zungs la sogs pa'i gnod bya rnams dang brten pa gnod byed nyes pa rnams 'phel pa dang zad pa gnyis kyi bcos thabs gcig ste/ dper na rten dwangs ma 'phel pa dang brten pa bad kun 'phel pa'i bcos thabs smyung ba gcig pus bcos pa dang / rten khrag zad pa dang brten pa mkhris pa zad pa gnyis brta ba gcig pus gso dgos mod/ rten rus pa dang brten pa rlung gi 'phel zad kyi bcos thabs gong dang mi 'dra ste/ rlung 'phel pa dang rus pa zad pa gnyis brta ba'i thabs gcig pus bcos la/ rlung zad pa dang rus pa 'phel pa la nyams dmad smyung ba'i thabs gcig pus gso bar bya/'di'i thad la zur mkhar ba'i rdo ring mdzes byed du/ bshad rgyud du/ rten dang brten pa 'phel zad bcos thabs gcig / ces gsungs pa ni dngos bstan spyir btang ba yin la/ dmigs bsal du yan lag brgyad par/ rus parnyung gnyis la 'di min/ / zhes pas mkhris pa dang bad kun gnyis kyi

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 99rten lus zungs dang bcas pa 'phel zad kyi bcos thabs gcig kyang rus pa dang rlung gnyis 'phel zad bcos thabs mi gcig ste/ rus pa 'phel pa'i tshe rlung zad cing / rlung 'phel pa'i tshe rus pa zad 'gro bas/ bcos thabs go ldog ste shes dgos pa yin no/ / zhes pa las kyang 'thus so/ /sa bcad brgyad pa/ bya byed sman pa/1 man pa'i drug po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa dang /sems can kun la phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pa mchog tu dkar ba/ dam tshig dang ldan zhing gtsang bar bsrung nus pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam pa bzo ba/ bya ba gang zhig byed kyang dus las mi g.yol ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten mi chos la mkhas pa bcas drug go /2 dam chig ldan pa'i blo bzhag rnam pa drug po gang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ dang po slob dpon gsung dang gso dpyad dang / /mched dang nad pa rnag khrag rnam drug la/ sangs rgyas drang srong gsung dang bka' rgyud dang / / grogs spun bu tsha khyi phag lta bu ni/ / blo bzhag pa yi dam tshig drug bsrung bya/ / zhes so/ /2 man pa zugaca 'byin pa yan lag bzhi ni gang gang yin nam/lan/ sman pa gang zhig nad la mkhas pa dang / nad slong ba la mkhas

100 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/pa/ nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa/ spang ba phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa bcas lags/4 sman pa'i 'chal spyod gsum po gang gang yin/lan/ bslu brid rdzun 'phrul che ba sman pa 'chal/ / khas blangs don thog mi rgyug sman pa 'chal/ / le lo chang dbang che na sman pa 'chal/ / zhes pa 'di ni sman pas nges par du dor dgos pa'i 'chal bar spyod pa gsum yin/ga sangs rgyas sman bla'i gzungs sngags legs sbyar skad du bzhag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad 'di nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rjes byin gyisarlabs pa'i skad yin gshis byin rlabs kyi tshan kha mi nyams shing rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i ched du legs sbyar skad du bzhag pa yin/6 tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams la sman pha zhes don ci yin nam/lan/ 'gro ba nad pa rnams la phas bu la brtse ba ltar nad par byams snying rjes skyong ba'am/ phas bu 'jigs pa las skyob pa ltar nad pa nad kyi 'jigs pa dang zug rngu'i sdug bsngal las skyob par byed pas na sman pha zhes brjod/7 tshad med bzhi bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ tshad med bzhi ni snying rje dang / byams pa/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms bcas so/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 101sa bcad dgu pa/ mjug don yongs gtad/1 'gro ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub ces lus chags pa'i mthar thug gi rgyu la 'byung ba bzhi bzhag pa las 'byung ba lnga ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ de ni nam mkha' rgyu'i gzugs su ma bzhag la/ nam mkha' stong ba'i cha de 'byung ba gzhan bzhi la spyi khyab tu gnas pa dang / sa chu me rlung bzhi bo nam mkha'i khongs su skye zhing 'phel pa tsam las/ nam mkha' ni gzugs can ma yin pas gzugs su mi rung ste/ mngon pa mdzod las/ 'dus ma byas rnam gsum yod de/ / nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin nam mkha' ni 'dus ma byas yin gshis rgyu rkyen gyi rnam bzhag tu mi rung zhing / rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag yod na 'dus byas yin la/tsho 'dus byas la mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid yod pa'i phyir nam rgyun gzugs 'grub byed kyi rgyu ston skabs 'byung ba bzhi zhes brjod pa rgyun 'byams su song yod/2 lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel/ / zhes pa'i don mdor bsdus shig brjod thub bam/lan/ khu khrag sems gsum ni lus chags pa'i rgyu yin pa rgyud rang gi dgongs don yin zhing / pha ma gnyis kyi phung khams 'byung ba lngas 'tsho zhing

102 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gnas pa dang / khu khrag gnyi ga ni 'byung ba lnga ldan zas kyi dngas ma yin phyir de gnyis ni mig gi spyod yul las 'das pa'i phra zhing phra ba'i 'byung ba'i rdzas rgyun phra mo las grub pa dang / de min gang rnam shes tshogs drug sogs kun gyi gzhi gyur pa'i sems der shin tu phra ba'i 'byung ba'i rang gshes yod pa gzhung 'grel rnams su gsungs 'dug des na 'gro ba'i lus 'di nyid mngal du grub pa'i mthar thug gi rgyu ni 'byung ba bzhi yin pa ma zad/ bar du 'byung ba'i rgyun la brten nas lus 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa dang / tha ma yang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i dbang gis rim gyis nyams nas lus 'jig par byed/nad kyi skor ni lus 'di nyid dang thog ma'i mngal du chags pa'i skabs der pha ma'i khams dkar dmar gnyis kyi ngo bor thog ma nyid nas dug skyed srin 'bu'i tshul du rgyu dug gsum gyi 'bras bu rlung mkhris bad kun gyi rang bzhin rang chas su yod pa dang / lus la lhan skyes su gnas pa'i rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po phyi nang gi rkyen gang dang ma 'phrad par tha mal du gnas pa'i skabs de ni nad mngon sum du gyur pa rnams kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa las nad dngos ma yin zhing / gal te rkyen ga ge mo dang phrad nas rnam pa gzhan du gyur na gnod bya dang gnod byed sogs lus kyi 'byung khams rnams 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum du gyur nas lus la gdung ba'i nad du 'gyur/ skabs der mkhris pa me dang bad kun sa chu lta bu 'byung ba bzhi dang rlung mkhris bad kun gsum phan tshun mtshan nyid mthun pas 'byung ba bzhi bo nyes pa gsum la

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 103sbyar nas nad khams kyi ngo bor 'grel bshad dang rnam gyur nad kyi rang bzhin mtha' dag 'byung bzhi'i ngor mdor hril gyis dril ba yin/de yang 'byung ba bzhi ni brtan g.yo'i dngos po yongs rdzogs 'grub byed kyi rgyu 'ba' zhig yin pas na/ lus kyi 'byung khams gso zhing nad gzhi 'joms par byed pa'i gnyen po sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo nyid las ma 'das shing thams cad 'byung ba tshogs pa las grub pa ni rgyud las rten ni 'byung ba lnga las skye 'gyur te zhes pa las 'khums/ mdor na 'byung ba bzhi ni lus chags gnas 'jig gsum gyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / phyi nang gi 'byung khams ma snyoms pa las tshe srog la gnod cing gdung ba'i rnam gyur nad 'gro ldog byed pa ma zad/ khams ma snyoms pa snyoms par byed pa'i gnyen po sman yang 'byung ba'i rang bzhin la dag las pa bcas mdor dril nas bshad na lus nad gnyen po gsum 'byung bzhi la brten nas skyed cing grub pa dang /de gsum po ngo bo bdag gcig gi rang bzhin zab gsal du bkrol ba de ltar yin/ 2 rgyadakri che ba bcu gciga' ltar yin nam/lan/ g.yu thog pas/ yang rtse rgyal po spyi 'grel rtsa ba dang / / 'byung gnas me long mjug sdud char rgyun dang / / skyabs sbyin spyi nor yid bzhin nor bu ste/ / dpal ldan rgyud kyi che ba bcu gcig yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /

104 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/4 tsha ba'i nad la log gnon drod dang grang ba'i nad la log gnon bsil bsten skabs do snang byed dgos sa ci yod dam/lan/ spyir nad tsha grang gi ngo bo ma nor bar ngos zin pa de la rang rang gi gnyen po bsil bcos sam drod bcos nan gyis bston na phan zhing bcos thub mod/ gnyen po bsil drod gang dgos ma 'khrul bar bsten yang ma phan pa rnams la log gnon tsha ba la drod dang grang ba la bsil bsten dgos tshe dus dang tshad la sbyar shes pa gnad yin/ gang lags she na/ log gnon bsten pa snga drags na gnyen po nad kyi grogs su song nas srog 'phrog nges shing / log gnon bsten pa kha thal na tsha ba la 'das dang grang ba gting 'khar ba sogs su gyur nas srog la rgol bas so/ /5 rgyud bzhi'i mjug don du bstan pa'i gces bzung bzhi ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rims la ma smin stongs tshad gces par bzung / / 'grams dang 'khrugs la rgyas tshad gces par bzung / / dug dang smug po rnyings tshad gces par bzung / / bad mkhris nad la gab tshad gces par bzung / /zhes pa 'di'o/ /6 rgyud bzhi'i mjug don du nad gzhi la gzhigs nas dpyad kyi mchog ji ltar gsungs yod/lan/ khrag nad dpyad mchog kun la gtar ga mchog / mkhris pa'i

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 105nad la khrus dang sbyang ba mchog / bad kun nad la skyugs dang me btsa' mchog / rlung gi nad la bsku mnye 'jam rtsi mchog / 'bras kyi nad la lums dang me btsa' mchog / ces so/ /7 rgyad bzhi'i mjug don du zas spyod sogs kyi mchog bshad pa de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ zas kyi mchog tu nas rnying rtsam pa mchog / skom gyi mchog tu shong dkar rtse mo mchog / mi rngul bcag pa spyod lam mchog yin no/ / zhes gsungs// khrag nad kun la gtar ga mchog yin pa'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ khrag gi nad rigs la ngan khrag dang khrag rlangs 'don dgos pas sman gyis bcos pa las khrag gtar na phan skyed che bas gtar ga nyid mchog tu gyur par bshad/'a rgyud bzhi'i mjug don du bstan pa'i gtsor bzung lnga ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ tshad pa kun la zhu 'khyag gtso bor bzung / / pho mcher mkhal nad bad kun gtso bor bzung / / glo mchin mkhris pa tshad pa gtso bor bzung / / snying srog long la rlung nyid gtso bor bzung / / khong nad kun la pho ba gtso bor bzung / / zhes so/ /10 pho mcher mkhal nad la bdakan gtso bor 'dzin dgos don ci/

106 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ pho ba sa khams ni bad kun gyi gnas yin zhing / de bzhin mcher ba sa khams dang mkhal ma chu khams gnyis bad kun sa chu'i khams dang phyogs mthun zhing / bad kun ni grang ba'i gzhi rten yin stabs gnas de rnams su bad kun grang nad 'byung sla bas de dag gso tshe bad gan gtso bor bzung nas drod kyis bcos dgos/11 rgyud chen bzhi so so'i dgos pa dang khyad chos mdor hril gyis dril na' ltar yin nam/lan/ le'u drug pas mdor bstan rtsa ba bzung / / bshad pa'i rgyud kyis gso rig spyi khog khrol/ / man ngag rgyud kyis gang byung nad rnams gso/ / phyi ma rgyud kyis lag len mdo don dril/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /12 rgyud bzhi bo so so'i gsung pa po drang srong rig pa'i ye shes dang rgyad bzhi zhu ba po drang srong yid las skyes ni sangs rgyas sman bla'i gang las sprul ba yin/lan/ rtsa rgyud kyi gsung pa po ni sangs rgyas sman bla'i thugs kyi sprul ba yin la/ bshad rgyud ni sku yi sprul ba/ man ngag rgyud ni yon tan gyi sprul ba/phyi ma rgyud ni 'phrin las kyi sprul ba/ rgyud bzhi zhu ba po drang srong yid las skyes ni gsung gi sprul ba yin no/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 107sa bcad bcu pa/ nyes gsum gso di/1 rlung mkhris bad gan gsum la nyes pa gsum zhes pa de gang la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/lan/ de ni 'bras bu'i gnas skabs la dgongs pa ste/ lus la lhan skyes su gnas pa'i rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po rkyen dang phrad nas rnam par gyur na lus srog la gnod cing sun 'byin pa'i nyes pa 'byung ba'i phyir nyes pa zhes btags/na rjod byed gzhung don skabs bco lnga de brjod bya yan lag brgyad nang sdud tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ gso thabs yan lag skabs bco lnga las rigs gtso bor byas pa'i nyes gsum ldan 'dus gso ba'i skabs dang / khong nad gso ba/ tshad pa gso ba bcas skabs gsum dang / gnas gtso bor byas pa'i lus stod gso ba dang don snod gso ba/ gsang nad gso ba bcas skabs gsum/ 'dres mar bstan pa thor nad dang lhan skyes rma gso ba bcas bsdoms pas skabs brgyad po yan lag brgyad kyi dang po lus spyi gso ba'i yan lag tu bsdu ba dang /de nas byis pa gso ba'i skabs dang / mo nad gso ba'i skabs/ gdon nad gso ba'i skabs/ mtshon rma gso ba'i skabs/ dug nad gso ba'i skabs/gis pa gso ba'i skabs/ ro tsa gso ba'i skabs bcas skabs re re yan lag

108 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/de dag gi nang du bsdu dgos/2 nyes pa gsum las rlung nad thog mar bstan pa'agyu mtshan ci/lan/ rgyud las/ de la rlung ni nad kun 'khrug pa'i rgyu/ / sna 'dren mjug sdud 'thor dang khyab par byed/ / rang rgyud gdug cing nad mang rtsub pa'i phyir/ / thog mar rlung gi bcos thabs bshad par bya/ / zhes so/ /4 rigs0 sgo nas dbye ba'i drung nad nyi shu bo gang gang yin/lan/ rlung nad nyi shu la rgyud chen las/ rlung nad a warta dang da rgan gnyis/ / 'gram pa nyams dang lce ldib phyogs gcig gug / rtsa 'dzin gzhogs phyed skams dang lus kun skams/ / shing rengs dpung 'ja' bi sha tse dang ni/ / sra 'theng dang ni brla rengs ce spyang mgo / tsher ma gzugs 'khums kha li rkang brtse dang / / rkang pa tsha ba zhes bya nyi shur bshad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /5 rlung gi sbyi gsang drug po gang gang yin nam/lan/ spyi gtsug dang / an stong tshigs pa dang po/ tshigs pa drug pa/tshigs pa bdun pa/ tshigs pa bcu drug pa/ brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams bcas lags/6 rlung gi nad la bya ra sgrims dgos don ci/lan/ rlung ni tsha grang gnyis ga'i zung du 'jug / mkhris tshad 'bud cing bad kun grang ba 'khyag / dpu 'or skya rbab g.yo zhing skran rnams

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 109sgong / / bsags pa'i nad rnams thams cad rlung gis slong / / byer ba'i nad kun sna 'dren rlung gis byed/ / tshad gzhug phal cher thor bu'i rlung gis 'bud/ / de phyir rlung gi nad la bya ra sgrims/ / zhes pa'i lung gis sgrub nus so/ /7 rlung gi nad la gnyen po drod bcud kyi rigs bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rlung dang bad kun grang ba chu yin te/ / zhes pa ltar rlung gi rang bzhin grang ba yin pas der gnyen po drod kyi rigs bsten dgos pa dang /rlung nad phal cher lus kyi zungs bcud nyams pa las byung bas na gnyen po bcud kyi rigs bsten dgos so/ // rlung nad gso skabs0 'don bzhi bo gang gang yin nam/lan/ de ni dkar 'don dang / dmar 'don/ sgog 'don/ skyur 'don bcas bzhi yin/kha mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid zur bdun po'i nad rtags ston tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid bdun las snum pa lhag pas gdong pa snum la/ de bzhin rno bas myur du smin pa dang / tsha bas lus drod che ba/yang bas gnyen po'i zlog kha yang ba/ dri mnam pas dri chen dang dri chu sogs kyi dri che ba/ 'khru bas thur du bshal ba/ gsher bas gtar khrag dang lud pa

110 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/sogs sla ba bcas kyi rtags rnams 'byung /10 rigs0 mkhris pa rnam bzhi be+e gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na rnam bzhi ste/ / nad gzhi'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa dang / / me drod mkhris pa gzhan gyi gnas gyur dang / /snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud kha shor dang / / thun mong mkhris pa rtsa ru rgyu ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /11 thun mong mkhris pa zhes pa de gang 'dra zhig la go dgos/lan/ lus kyi me khams dang mthun zhing thun mong gi byed las ldan pa'i nad gzhi'i mkhris pa dang / snod kyi mkhris pa/ me drod mkhris pa gsum 'doms pa la go dgos/12 grang mkhris la bshang ba dkar po 'byung ba'i mtshan ci/lan/ spyir mkhris pa ni lus drod kyi mnga' bdag dri chen gyi ser rtsi/chu ser gyi rtsa ba bcas yin pas/ grang mkhris la bshang ba dkar po gyur pa ni ma zhu bas mkhris yul 'phrog nas dri chen gyi rtsi ru gyur pa'i mkhris khu tshul bzhin 'bab mi thub pas red/12 mkhris pa k+ṣa ya nag po zhes pa'i go don ci/ ming 'di ji ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ k+ṣa ya nag po ni legs sbyar skad de bod skad du bsgyur na zad byed nag po zhes mkhris nad gdug pa can zhig gi ming yin zhing / 'dis

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 111zin pa'i dus su snod kyi mkhris pa phyi sha pags dang bar rtsa rus/ nang don snod kyi gnas su byer te lus zad par byed pas na zad byed dang / nag po ni nad rang gi mdog la bltas nas btags pa yin la don du mkhris pa'i nad stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dus yin zhing / rtags su sha pags sngo nag tu gyur pa dang sen mor nag thig 'byung ba'i phyir ming de ltar btags/14 bdakan rigs drug po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ bad kun lhen nad dang / lcags dreg gi nad/ me drod nyams pa'i nad/ mgul 'gags kyi nad/ grum bu dkar po'i nad/ 'ju skem gyi nad bcas drug go /15 bad gan mgul 'gags kyi nad 'gyur ngo bo dang ming gi rnam grangs ji ltar yin nam/ lan/ bad kun be snabs 'phel te pho ba dang brang dang glo ba'i yul du rgyas shing / de'i rlangs pa zo mar chags pa ji bzhin mid pa'i sbubs su chags nas min pa 'chus shing zas skom mi thar bar 'gags par gyur/ ming gi rnam grangs la bad kun gre thog dang / bad kun mid 'chus/ bad kun rke 'ching sogs yod/16 bad gan skya bo dang / bad gan ser po/ bad gan nag po/bad gan dmar po zhes pa'i brda chad de dag ji ltar btags pa yin nam/lan/ nad kyi rgyu sa chu'i khams 'phel te ma zhu ba las byung zhing lus kyi

112 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/pags mdog skya bo gyur pas na bad kun skya bo dang / snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud nas rtsa mig tu byer te sha mdog ser por 'gyur ba la bad kun ser po/mcher bar gnas shing rlung dang bsdongs pa la bad gan nag po/ mkhal ma'am glo la gnas pa'i skabs su bad kun dmar po zhes bya/ yang na bad kun pho bar babs na dkar po dang / mkhris par babs na ser po/ mcher bar babs na nag po/ glo bar babs na dmar po zhes pa'i zer srol yang mchis/17 sten dang lhen skran gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gang yin nam/lan/ nyen zhes pa ni bid kun be snabs 'phel nas nyen sna'i 'og tu tshogs te pho ba stong nger na la nad par skran yod par snang ba tsam las da dung skran du dngos su dril med pa dang / nyen skran zhes pa ni pho ba'i me drod kyis zas skom rnams tshul bzhin ma zhu ba'i rkyen gyis nyen sna'i 'og tu sra mkhregs can gyi skran chags pa la bya'o/ /1ra bad gan gyi nad la pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces par 'dzin dgos pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ rtsa bar/ spyir na bad kun lci rtul bsil ba'i phyir/ / khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba bad kun byed/ / sha lpags rtsa tshigs phyi ru byer ba nyung / /rang gi gnas las gzhan du zhugs pa dkon/ / phal cher ma zhu pho bar rgyas pa'i sa/ / de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces pa yin/ / zhes pa'i lung gis

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 113sgrub nus so/ /19 bad gan gyi nad bcos skabs sman dpyad rnams yun ring por drod du sprug dgos pa'i rgya mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ dang po bad kun ngo bo bsil ba'i phyir/ / sman dpyad zas spyod rnam bzhi drod du sprug / sa 'dra gnyen po'i kha na lci ba'i phyir/ / lan res mi sel yun du bsten pa gces/ / zhes gsungs pa las 'thus/2༷ rlung mkhris bad gan gsum la rgyud las rnam par gyur ma gyur du bshad pa dang / zla la du phan pa dang gnod pa zhes dbye ba la nye bag ci yod dam/lan/ rgyud las rnam par gyur pa'i rlung dang rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung zhes pa ni ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad pa dang / zla rgyal las phan pa'i rlung dang gnod pa'i rlung zhes pa dag ni byed las kyi sgo nas bshad pa tsam las de gnyis kyi gnad 'bab sa gcig yin/21 rlung mkhris bad gan gsum la 'du ba gsum zer don ci/lan/ rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gyi ngo bo phan tshun mi mthun par tha dad yin na'ang kha bral thabs med pa ste/ de gsum po gcig la gcig brten nas lus kyi cha shas kun tu 'dzoms shing 'du nas mi'i srog gnas pa'i bya ba byed pas na 'du ba gsum du grags/22 sbug po'i nad kyi rgyu gang gang yin pa dang / der bad gan zhes

114 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'dogs dgos don ci yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni bad kun khrag mkhris rlung bcas bzhi yin la/ nad 'di thog mar sa chu'i khams 'phel te ma zhu ba shas che ba las byung ba'i phyir bad gan smug po zhes brjod/22 sbug po zhes pa'i ming 'di' ltar thogs pa yin nam/lan/ 'di'i thad la pod dmar las/ bad kun smug po ni/ nyes gsum khrag bcas rang mdog 'dres pa'i 'dus nad yin pas na smug po dang /dri chen dri chu smug po yin pas na smug po/ gyen thur gnyis nas khrag smug 'byung bas na smug po/ bzhin mdog lud pa'i kha dog smug pas na smug po/zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gtso bo nad 'di ni nyes gsum khrag bcas 'dus pa'i nad yin pa mtshon byed kyi ming yin snyam/24 7ga po'i rang gnas bzhi bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ pho ba dang / mchin pa/ rgyu ma/ long bcas yin/25 skug po'i rigs bzhi bo gang gang yin/lan/ smug po byer ba dang / smug po rgyas pa/ smug po 'gyings pa/smug po 'dril ba bcas bzhi'o/ /26 smug po yas babs dang mas chags zhes pa'i go don ci/lan/ smug po tsha rkyen gyi dbang gis nad 'di thog mar yas mchin pa nas rim par mar pho rgyu long gsum du babs pas yas babs zhes pa dang /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 115smug po grang rkyen gyi dbang gis nad 'di dang po mas pho ba'i yul nas yar mchin par song ba la mas chags zhes btags pa'o/ /27 skug po'i nad zhugs pa'i dus gsum dang dus kyi lo ma rnam gsum gang gang yin/lan/ smug po'i dus gsum ni bad kun smug po'i nad kyi 'phel rim la bltas nas btags pa'i dang po tsha ba'i dus dang / bar du tsha grang 'thab pa'i dus/ tha ma grang ba snying chad pa'i dus bcas gsum mo/ / dus kyi lo ma rnam gsum la rtsa bar/ 'di la dus kyi lo ma rnam gsum 'byung / / dang po 'jug dus chu tshan chu skyur skyug / bar du smin nas ser po rgya bshal skyug /tha mar rgyas nas khrag rul dud khu skyug / ces pa 'di yin/2/ sprug po'i rnam 'gyur bcu gsum gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ 'di ni bad kun smug po'i nad rtags mi 'dra ba bcu gsum gyi bsdus ming yin te/ pod dmar las/ bad kun smug po'i rnam 'gyur bcu gsum ni/ / pho bar bad kun mchin par khrag gi nad/ / rgyu mar mkhris pa long du rlung gi nad/ / rtsar byer dug dang tshigs zhugs grum bu'i nad/ /mgo la mgo nad glo la glo nad dang / / snying la snying rlung mcher bar mcher ba'i nad/ / mkhal mar mkhal nad pags la grams pa dang / / shar rgyas gnyis ka sa bdag gi nad de/ / rnam 'gyur bcu gsum skabs 'di'i tshig don yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /

116 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/2 smug po'i sbas don bcu gsum gang gang yin nam/lan/ bad kun smug po'i nad rtags mi 'dra ba rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba gzhung gi shugs bstan bcu gsum po ni/ 'phyur ba mgo nad dang 'dra/kha yan snying rlung 'dra/ byer ba dug 'dra/ rgyas pa 'gramase pa 'dra/ zhud pa tsha grang 'thab pa dang 'dra/ gab pa grang ba dang 'dra/ skyugs pa ma zhu ba dang 'dra/ 'khru ba glang thabs 'dra/ 'byams pa skya rims 'dra/ 'dril ba rdo skran 'dra/ 'gyings pa dmu chu 'dra/ 'grims pa mkhal nad 'dra/ ral ba skya rbab 'dra ba ste bcu gsum mo/ /2༷ smug po'irtags sukha nang du nya dri thra ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ 'di ni smug po'i khyad par gyi rtags shig yin la/ gtsang stod dar mgon gyis/ smug po zhes bya'i 'chi bdag nad/ / mi 'gyur rtags su 'di ltar 'byung / / pho ba rdol ral gyur pa'i rtags/ / dri chen smug la skam pa 'byung / / khong pa rul myag gyur pa'i rtags/ / kha nas nya rul dri ltar 'byung / / zhes so/ /21 sprug po skran du dril ba'irtags ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ smug po skran du 'dril na mchin pa dang / / mcher ba pho long rgyu ma'i gnas su 'byung / / sra 'dril gzer zhing na la mnan na 'phar/ / gnas de tsha zhing stobs 'dzad dang ga 'gag / rtsa rgyud phra mgyogs chu mdog dmar bar 'ong / / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 11722 skug po'i nad rang gnas bzhir zhugs pa de bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ pho bar gnas tshe bad gan gtso bor bcos pa dang / mchin par gnas tshe khrag nad gtso bor bcos rgyu/ rgyu mar gnas tshe mkhris pa gtso bor bcos pa dang / long du gnas tshe rlung nyid gtso bor bcos dgos so/ /22 dug thabs zhes pa'i go don ci yin nam/lan/ skabs 'dir thabs ni 'dra ba'i don yin zhing / dug thabs zhes pa ni dug dngos ma yin yang nad rtags dug lta bur 'byung bas de ltar brjod/24 skug po gso skabs yid gzab byed dgos pa ni gang dang ci yin nam/lan/ de ni rgyud las/ lar ni smug po 'dus pa'i nad yin pas/ /sa 'dra gso dka' nad snar lci ba'i phyir/ / lan res zhi bar mi 'gyur bcos rnams bskyar/ / zungs ma bsrungs par sman dpyad bstud drags na/ / gser zad g.ya' zad nad zungs dus gcig 'dzad/ / de phyir nad stobs cung zad bri ba'i skabs/ / gsar bcud zas kyis lus zungs bsrung zhing bcos/ / zhes gsungs so/ /sa bcad bcu gcig pa/ khong nad gso ba/1 gtsong n+de bzhi bo gang gang yin nam/

118 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ 'dril ba'i gcong dang / zags pa'i gcong / byer ba'i gcong /'gyings pa'i gcong bcas bzhi'o/ /2 rgyu ma zhu ba las byung ba'i khong nad chen po bcu drug gi bsdus ming gtsong sde bcu drug po de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ gsal byed sgron me'i rgyud las/ bad mkhris nyen dang lcags dreg gcong gi sde/ / 'khru skyug 'bras dang suyo gcong gi sde/ / dreg grum chu ser thig nag gcong gi sde/ / 'or dang skya rbab dmu skran gcong gi sde/ / sde bzhi zung brgyad phra mo bcu drug go / zhes gsungs las 'khums/2 rigs kyis dbye na ma zhu ba la be snabs bdud nad shing 'dra dug 'dra bcas bzhi yod pa de dag gi gnas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ ma zhu be snabs pho bar gnas pa dang / ma zhu bsud nad long la gnas/ ma zhu shing 'dra rgyu mar gnas/ ma zhu dug 'dra mchin par gnas so/ /4 dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i nad 'gyur ngo bo' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ me mnyam rlung gis dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa'i/ / snyigs ma dwangs ma'i rtsa mig shor ba yis/ / mdangs sgyur mkhris pas zungs khrag ma smin te/ / yun ring mchin gnas dwangs ma ma zhu yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /5 dwangs ma ma zhu ba dang cigs ma ma zhu ba gnyis0 ngo bo ci/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 119lan/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na ma zhu ba la dwangs ma ma zhu ba dang snyigs ma ma zhu ba gnyis yod pa las dwangs ma ma zhu ba ni zas cung zad zhu nas mchin pa'i nang du khrag ngan du gyur zhing de nas ma zhu bas ngo bo tsha ba dang / snyigs ma ma zhu ba ni zas ma zhu bar pho ba'i nang du lus pa yin pas ngo bo grang ba yin/6 ma zhu ba ni khong nadakun gyi rtsa ba yin don ci/lan/ rtsa bar/ ma zhu'i dbang gas pho ba'i bad kun 'phel/ / be snabs de yis rlung rgyu'i rtsa sbubs bkag / lhen dang lcags dreg me drod nyams la sogs/ / gcong nad ma lus skyed par byed pa yin/ / zhes pa'i lung gis sgrub nus so/ /7 ma zhu gsar rnying thams cad la rtsol ba zad na 'grig gam/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rgyud las/ snyigs ma ma zhu gsar ba bcags phan te/ / dwangs ma ma zhu rnying pa'i dug tu 'gyur/ / ci phyir dwangs ma mchin gnas mkhris ldan tsha/ / snyigs ma pho long bad rlung bsdongs pas grang / / zhes pa las 'khums// ma zhu ba'i nad gso ba gces par gdams dgos don ci/lan/ rgyud chen las/ rgyu ma bcos par 'bras bu gso 'dod pa/ /dug rtsa ma phyung lo ma bcad skyur 'dra/ / khong nad thams cad ma zhus skyed pa'i phyir/ / ma zhu'i gso dpyad mkhas pa shin tu gces/ / rgyu nyid grol na

120 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'bras bu ga la 'byung / / zhes gsungs pas so/ /kha man nadakyi dbye ba dang gnas sa gang dang ci yin nam/lan/ dbye ba bad kun zas nyen rdo yi skran/ / rlung gi snying skran khrag mkhris rtsa skran dang / / spu srin chu skran rnag skran bcu gcig go / gnas ni glo snying mchin dri mchin mcher mkhal/ / mkhris pa pho long rgyu ma lhang pa mngal/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /10 skran nad mdor bsdus na phyi skran nang skran bar skran gsum yod pa de'i gnas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ mdor bsdus phyi skran nang skran bar skran gsum/ / phyi skran snod kyi phyi dang sha lpags bar/ / bar skran snod kyi nang ldebs don gyi logs/ /nang skran don snod kun gyi gting na gnas/ / zhes pa 'di las gsal/11 skran yod sa'i gnas der dreg pa nag po chags pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skran yod pa'i gnas de'i ba spu'i bu ga 'gags pas rlung khrag gi rgyu ba nyams pas red/12 snod kyi mkhris skran gyi 'gyur tshul dang nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ man rgyud skran nad kyi le'ur/ dwangs ma ma zhu mchin gnas mkhris par lhung / / mkhris pa'i rtsi chags 'dril ba snod mkhris skran/ / zhes dang / snod kyi mkhris skran sha mdog sngo la skam/ / zas len gyur kyang shed

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 121bral mig chu ser/ / smin nas lus kun za 'phrug byed pa yin/ / zhes so /12 mngal skran gyirtags ltar yin nam/ lan/ rtsa bar/ mngal skran tshigs pa rgyu zhabs ldang dub gzer/ /'grangs tshe na zhing skabs su khrag chen 'dzag / ces pa 'di'o/ /14 skyan nad kyi bcos thabs mdor hril gyis dril na ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mdor bsdus rlung skran snum 'chos btang bar bya/ / mkhris skran sbyang zhing khrag skran gtar gyis drang / / rtsa skran rnag tu 'gugs shing chu lums shis/ / rdo skran thur ma lhen skran sman gyis bshig / chu skran rnag skran gsang du dbyung bar bya/ / nang skran sman la bar skran thur mas bshig / phyi skran bum par drangs la dmar 'byin bya/ / de ltar shes na 'tsho byed mkhas pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /15 7 zab nad0 brtags ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ spyi rtags dang po kha gdong mig lcibs dang / /rkang bol ngar gdong sbod por g.yo zhing skrangs/ / 'gul na rngam 'degs snying sprug dang ga 'gag / kha zas mi 'ju lce mchu rnyil bkrag 'chor/ /stobs chung rtsa bying chu ser shin tu ngal/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/16 7 zab dang 'or dmu chu gsum gyi khyad par ci yin nam/

122 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ chu nad de gsum po ngo bo dngas ma ma zhu ba las byung ba 'dra yang /skya rbab ni dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rgyun sha mdangs bar du khyab pa la bya zhing / 'or nad ni dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rgyun pags pa'i 'og dang sha'i bar du byer ba/dmu chu ni dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rgyun phyi sha mdangs dang / bar sha pags/ nang rgyu long bcas la khyab cing g.yo bar gyur pa yin/17 skya zab dang 'or dmu chu gsum gyi 'brel ba ci yin nam/lan/ skya rbab dang 'or dmu chu gsum dus gsar rnying dang nad stobs che chung gi go rim/ yang na bcos dka' sla tsam ma gtogs de gsum po pho ba'i me drod nyams pa dang dwangs ma ma zhu ba las byung bas na ngo bo gcig yin zhing / de dag spyi'i dbang du byas na chu nad thog ma'i dus su skya rbab dang /de las sdug tu song nas bcos ma thub pa'am lhod g.yeng du song na chu nad bar ma'am 'or nad ces su bshad/ de bas sdug tu song ste bcos ma thub pa'am bcos nyes shor na chu nad tha ma'am dmu chu ru 'gyur/ mdor na skya rbab rnyings nas 'or nad dang / 'or nad rnyings nas dmu chur 'gyur ba yin/18 chu yi mkhar brgyad po gang gang yin nam/lan/ man rgyud dmu chu'i le'ur/ bol gong ngar gdong chu so bcu drug mdo/ / pho ba brang zhol kha gdong mig lcibs dang / / chu yi mkhar brgyad g.yo zhing skrangs pa yin/ / zhes pa 'di'o/ /19 chu gsang rnam gsum zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 123lan/ steng gi chu gsang tshigs pa dang po dang / bar gyi chu gsang tshigs pa bcu gsum pa/ 'og gi chu gsang tshigs pa bco brgyad bcas gsum mo/ /20 dmya chu'i skabs su yan lag phra la skam pa yi dgas 'dra ba dang sbom la rags pa mgon po lta bu'i rtags mngon pa de gnyis kyi ngo bo ci/rtags de 'dra gang gi dus su mngon nges/lan/ yi dwags 'dra ba ni tsha chu dang mgon po 'dra ba ni grang chu yin la/rtags de gnyis dmu chu tha ma rgyas pa'i dus su 'byung / /21 dmu chu'i spyi'i bcos thabs lnga bo gang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ spyi ru dmu chu bcos thabs rnam lnga bshad/ / dang po chu bo 'ol kha bsgyur ba dang / / gnyis pa rgya mtsho gnas su bskam pa dang / / gsum pa rdzing gi 'or khung brtol ba dang / / bzhi pa mtsho mo yur du /nga ba dang / / lnga pa rtsa la 'gag mig gzhug pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar 22 cha lag bco brgyad du gsungs pa'i chu rdzing gi 'or khung bsal thabs gsum po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ cha bshang lam nas sbyong ba'i cha bshal dang / cha cha lam nas ra ra ra ra sbyong ba'i cha sbyong / rtsa cha gnyis ka nas sbyong ba'i 'phral 'dzag bcas gsam //tsās/ / ri rib ri ri ri ri ri ri

124 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/22 sbyir dmu chu'i nad la skom gyi rigs 'dzem dgos mod 'u su dang skyu ru'i thang mang du gtong rung ba'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ thang de gnyis kyis skom dad sel ba ma zad chu nad la'ang phan pas red/24 gtsong nad chen po'i nad tshul bcu gcig po gang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ de rjes bar du gcong chen stod na gnas/ / cham 'debs lud pa mang la dbugs mi bde/ / phrag pa mgo na skad 'gag yi ga 'chu/ / smad du gnas na pho ba rgyu long 'bab/ / skyug cing 'khru'am rtug skam nad du 'gyur/ / bar na gnas na rtsib logs gzer zug byed/ /tshigs gzhir gnas na rims kyis 'debs pa ste/ / de ltar gcong chen nad tshul bcu gcig ldan/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /25 gtsong chen zad byed la bla gnyan gyi nad gang dang gang 'byung nges pa yin/lan/ gcong chen gnod pa ma zhu 'khru dang skyug / cham pa lud pa skad 'gags yi ga 'chu/ / de dag gcong chen nad kyi bla gnyan yin/ / zhes pa 'di dag 'byung nges so/ /26 snying nad bdun po ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ snying 'phyos dang / snying gzer/ snying tshad/ snying chu/ snying 'thibs/ snying srin/ snying nad kha le nag po bcas bdun no/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 12527 glo nad brgyad po gang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ dbye ba thang po skya rbab tsha ba dang / / chu shor thes po glo gcong glo rgyas dang / / bung tshang can dang rnam pa brgyad du bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /2ra klo nad bang po dang zhes po gnyis0bad par ci yin/lan/ ribang po ni glo bar rlung zhugs pa yin la/ thes po ni glo bar bad kun babs pa yin/29 blo nad sbyi'i khyad chosaji ltar yin nam/lan/ spyir na glo ba ni bad kun grang ba'i yul yin stabs de la dro na 'phrod pas/ dus kyi dbang du byas na dbyar dus ni dro ba'i dus skabs yin pas de dus bde ba dang / dgun dus ni grang ba'i dus dang bad kun khong du gsog pa'i dus yin pas de dus na ba dang / nyin mtshan gyi dbang du byas na nyin par nyi mas dro ba'i rkyen gyis cung zad bde la mtshan mo zla bas bsil ba'i rkyen gyis na ba bcas khyad chos mngon/20 glo ba'ind la bya ra sgrims dgos pa drug yod pa de dag gang gang yin/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ ji skad du/ rlung ni sna 'dren rgyus can mi dang 'dra/ / mkhris pa gsod byed gdug can rgyal po 'dra/ / bad kun zhi byed rgyu ngan blon po 'dra/ / khrag ni 'joms byed dpung ldan dmag mi 'dra/ / rnag ni gsod

126 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/byed gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dra/ / tshad pa rgyug byed thag ring jag pa 'dra/ /nad rnams kun gyi spyi 'gro yin na yang / / khyad par 'di drug glo ba shin tu 'jigs/ / des na rang rang gnyen pos mnan par bya/ / zhes pa'i lung gis sgrub nus so/ /21 mchin nad la dbye ba du yod/ gang gang yin/lan/ rgyud las/ dbye ba leb gon rgyas dang ldem bu dang / / dug thabs chu shor rkun bu 'or lhung dang / / kha lud gzhung rengs mchin grum nag po dang / / mchin nad hal skem mchin dri dkar nag dang / / gnad mchin rtsa byer mchin rlung mchin rgud dang / / rlan grangs glang dgur grang sbos bco brgyad do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /22 mchin nad ldem bu dang dug thabs/ mchin rgyad bcas la nad rtags ci 'dra 'byung gi yod dam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ mchin nad ldem bu na ba mi tshor bar/ /gnyid med khong snyom lus lci zas mi 'dod/ / khrag 'bros sha dang rus pa khad kyis skam/ / dug thabs mig dmar gdong sngo rtsib steng zug / pho mchin gang snyam 'ju dka' zos tshe na/ / brun skam bol g.yo mur gong mthil bzhi ser/ / gzhug tu mchin pa rul nas dud khur lu/ / zhes dang /mchin rgud zas zos rjes la mchin pa na/ / nyam chung chu dron skyug la g.yal mi phyin/ / zhes so/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 12722 mkhalasa'i nad la drodakris bcos pa gtses dgos don ci/lan/ mkhal ma ni chu khams chu yi mtsho dang bad kun grang ba'i gzhi yin pas drod bcos gces par 'dzin dgos/24 mkhal nad bcos skabs rgan pa rnams la me btsa' dang /gzhon nu dang dar ma rnams la gtar gas bcos dgos don ci/lan/ pod dmar las/ mkhal ma bsam se bu snod dang 'brel bas/ / gzhon la me btsa' spang zhing gtar ga bya/ / ci'i phyir zhe na me btsasasrid sgo 'gegs/ / gtar gas nad kyi ro ma gting nas 'byin/ /rgan la gtar mi 'phrod cing me btsa' legs/ / ci'i phyir zhe na gtar gas lus zungs 'joms/ / me btsas lus drod bskyed cing nad sgo 'gegs/ /zhes gsungs/25 mkhal ma'i tshad nad dang grang nad la sman sbyor gang dang gang gces par 'dzin dgos/lan/ 'di'i thad la pod dmar las/ a ru'i sbyor ba ma shes na/ /mkhal tshad bcos pa'i sman pa min/ / go yu'i sbyor ba ma shes na/ / mkhal grang gso ba'i sman pa min/ / zhes pa las 'thus/26 po ba'i nad bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ pho ba zas 'ju byed pa'i gzhi yin pas/ / zas spyod drod bston se 'bru da lis shis/ / zhes pa 'di rtsa don du 'dzin dgos/

128 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/27 don snod kyi nad gsungs skabs snod mkhris dang mngal sgang pa bcas ma bstan pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ snod mkhris dang mngal gnyis mkhris pa gso ba dang mo nad gso ba/ de min skran nad gso ba'i skabs bcas su rgyas par bstan pa dang /snod drug gi ya gyal lhang pa de mtshan nyid chos mthun gyi dbang gis mkhal ma chu khams dang 'brel bas sgang pa'i nad rnams mkhal bcos kyis 'thus pas red/2/ zin tig gces bsdus su rgya ma'i nad rnams mkhris pa ltar bcos par gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rgyu ma ni mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi gnas gtso bo yin pa dang /mkhris khu rgyu mar babs nas de'i gnas su rgyu bas na rgyu ma'i nad mkhris pa ltar bcos chog pas red/29 long gi nad rnams rlung dang bad gan phyed mar bcos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ long rlung khams ni rlung gi gzhi rten dang / kha zas kyi snyigs ro rnams gsog pa'i snod yin pas grang shas che bas de ltar bcos dgos so/ /sa bcad bcu gnyis pa/ tsha ba gso ba/1 gnas skabs kyi tsha ba drug po'i dmigs bsal gyi nad rtags dang

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 129khyad chos ci/lan/ rgyud chen las/ ma smin phrum ser tshigs gzhi srod dus na/ /rgyas pa'i tsha ba tshad rtags rdzogs par 'byung / / stongs tshad bsil gyi gnyen po bston gyin 'phel/ / gab tshad drod bcud bsrings kyin gnod par tshor/ / rnyings pa'i tsha ba yun lon gyur pas shes/ / rnyogs tshad rngul brtse sna khrag g.yo las gsal/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /2 nyes pa'i sgo nas tsha ba bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ nyes pa'i sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni/ / rlung gi tsha ba 'bros 'ded tshul du bcos/ / mkhris pa'i tsha ba zags bcad tshul du bcos/ / bad kun tsha ba mgo spur tshul du bcos/ / khrag gi tsha ba shed dmad tshul du bcos/ / chu ser tsha ba sbyang skem tshul du bcos/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /2 tsha ba zhi bar byed pa'i thang sbyor bdun po gang gang yin pa dang /de'inang gses0 smin thang dang dbye bang la dbye ba gang gang yod pa dang de dag so so'i phan nus ci yin/lan/ rtsa bar/ thang la smin thang dbye thang sdud pa'i thang / / gsod thang sad thang dgug thang skam thang bdun/ / zhes thang sbyor bdun yod pa dang / smin par byed pa'i thang la rnam gsum ste/ / ma nu bzhi bas bad rlung smin par byed/ / tig ta gsum pas mkhris tshad smin par byed/ / 'bras bu

130 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gsum gyis khrag tshad smin par byed/ / dbye ba'i thang la rnam pa gsum yin te/ / slo tres chig thang rlung tshad 'byed par byed/ / skyu ru'i chig thang khrag nad 'byed par byed/ / se 'bru gsum thang bad kun tsha ba 'byed/ / ces gsungs pa 'di'o/ /4 rigs0 tsha ba bzhi po'i mi 'khrul ba'irtagasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ rims tshad mgo na za zi grang shum byed/ / 'khrugs tshad gzer dang lud pa dbugs la gsal/ / 'grams kyi tsha ba spyod lam drag rjes na/ /dug tshad ma nges khol bur nad sna mang / / 'di dag mi 'khrul so so'i ngos 'dzin yin/ / zhes so/ /ga dpyad kyis tsha ba bcos pa'i thabs drug po de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud kyi tsha ba spyi'i le'ur/ dpyad kyis bcos thabs rnam pa drug yin te/ / gtar gyis khrag ngan rtsa lam sbyang ba dang / / rngul gyis tshad rlangs ba spur dbyung ba dang / / dugs kyis 'phral gyi zug gzer bcag pa dang / / lums kyis tsha ba byer ba gdon pa dang / / chu yis phyi tshad me dpal bcag pa dang / / me yis tsha ba 'bros phrang bsdam pa'o/ / zhes pa 'di yin/6 tsha ba'i nad yin yang gtar mi rung ba'i tsha nad bdun po gang dag yin/ de dag gtar mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gtar mi rung ba'i tsha nad bdun ni ma smin pa'i tsha ba dang rims
