rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 131tshad/ khrag ma phyed pa'i tsha ba/ stongs tshad/ gnyan tshad/ dug tshad/zungs zad tsha ba bcas lags/ de dag gtar mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni rgyud las/ tsha ba gtar du mi rung rnam pa bdun/ / ma smin tshad pa gtar na rnyogs par 'gyur/ / khyad par rims la gang gtar don la 'bab/ /'khrugs sogs ngan khrag ma phye gtar ba yis/ / zungs khrag shor bas rlung skye tsha ba byer/ / nad khrag lus pas tsha ba'i ro mi thon/ / stongs tshad gtar na rlung 'phyo zug gzer skye/ / gnyan tshad gtar na khrag shul srog rtsar 'jug / dug tshad gtar na byer te ro mi thon/ / zungs ngan tshad pa gtar na srog rten chad/ / ces pa'i lung gis sgrub nus so/ /7 rlung gi zhu 'khrags srun nas bsu ba dang / mkhris pa'i zhu 'khrags 'phrang la bzag pa/ bad gan gyi zhu 'khrags phyi rjes bcad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rlung gi zhu 'khyags 'byung sla zhing thal skyon che bas tsha ba ma zad pa'i sdun nas bsu dgos shing / mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags zlog dka' zhing rno myur dang ldan pas tshad pa zad nas rlung skye mtshams las mi phyi bar 'phrang la bsgug pa dang / bad kun gyi zhu 'khyags 'byung bul zhing bying che bas tsha ba zad nges kyi mtshams su phyi rjes bcad de tha mar bcos dgos so/ // ci 'dra zhig la thor bu'i rlung zer/lan/ thor bu'i rlung zhes pa ni rlung nad rigs dang gnas kyi khongs su

132 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/ma 'dus par kha thor du gnas pa'i rlung nad stobs chung la bya'o/ /9 tsha ba ma smin pa dang smin pa gnyis kyi khyad par gyi rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ ma smin pa'i rtags su grang shum byed pa dang tshigs gzhi na ba/me dang nyi ma snyeg cing srod la tsha ba che ba bcas dang / smin pa'i rtags ni bsil 'dod pa dang / lus la dri 'byung ba/ grang shum chad pa bcas yin/10 tsha ba smin du mi 'dod pa'irkyen gsum po gang gang yin nam/lan/ rlung gis tsha ba bus nas smin du mi ster ba dang / bad kun gyis tsha ba'i 'go byibs nas smin du mi ster ba/ zas spyod rkyen gyis tsha ba lus zungs la byer nas smin du mi ster ba bcas gsum mo/ /11 nyes gsum gang rung zhig la rkyen phog na gzhan gnyis mi bde ba'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ rlung mkhris bad kun gsum po pha spun dang 'dra bas gcig la dusagadon zas spyod kyi rkyen phog nas nad byung na gzhan gnyis kyang mi bde bar 'khrugs par byed do/ /12 rgyas tshad bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ bcos tshul stobs chen dar drag thog babs bsad/ / stobs chung tsha ba 'jam la zhi bas bcos/ / dang por rlangs bsad bar du lo ma brab/ / tha ma rtsa ba bcad pa'i tshul du bcos/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 13312 rgyas tshad la dpyadakrisa' ltar bcos dgos/ lan/ rgyas tshad la sman gyis ma choms na gtar gyis dbyung ba dang /rngul gyis tsha ba ba spu nas dbyung ba/ chu lcag bran nas tsha ba'i rlangs pa 'don pa/ bsil dugs kyis zug gzer gcog pa bcas bya dgos/14 tsha stongs dang rlung stongs gnyis0༄da par ci yin nam/lan/ tsha stongs ni tshad pa'i nad gnya' chogs nas tshad gzhug rlung gis bus pa dang / rlung stongs ni tshad pa'i gzhug rlung du log pa yin/15 gab tshad zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ gab tshad kyi brtag thabs bzhi bo gang gang yin/lan/ rgyud chen du/ gab pa'i tsha ba sbas pa'i me dang 'dra/ / grang rlung gnyis kyis tsha ba'i 'go byibs pas/ / bad rlung 'og tu tshad rtags bag la nyal/ / phyi grang nang na tsha bas gab ces bya/ / zhes dang / brtag thabs bzhi ste rtags la nad ngos bzung / / rtsa chus mtshang 'bru gtar gyis phugs btsal te/ / zas dang sman gyis mgo phur bshu bar bya/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /16 po ba dang mkhal ma snying gsum la gab tshad 'byung ba'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ pho ba sa khams ni zas 'ju sa'i gzhi yin pas gnas der tsha ba'i nad zhugs na 'ju byed me des log pa'i las byas nas grang rtags 'byung ba

134 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/dang / mkhal ma chu khams ni bad kun grang ba'i gzhi yin pas tshad nad zhugs kyang grang rtags ston nges shing / snying ni khyab byed rlung gi gnas yin pas tsha ba'i rtags mi mngon/ de'i phyir pho ba dang mkhal ma snying gsum la gab tshad 'byung ngo / /17 tsha ba gsar rnying gi tshad gzhi ci 'dra yin nam/lan/ tsha ba'i nad phog nas zla ba gcig ma 'das na tsha ba gsar ba dang / zla ba gcig phar 'das na rnyings tshad yin te/ g.yu thog pa'i tshad pa'i stong thun las/ zla ba ma 'das pa ni/ tsha ba gsar ba/ zla ba 'das pa ni/ tsha ba rnyings pa/ lo lon pa ni/ shin tu rnyings pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /18 rnyings tshad la zas spyod lo za'i bar du bsnam dgos pa'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ spyir rnyings tshad kyi nad 'di ras la snum zhen pa ltar lus zungs dang 'dres yod pas bcos dka' zhing / bcos kyang tshad pa'i lhag ma cung zad tsam yang med par ma byas na tshad ro slar 'phel nges pas zas dang spyod lam gnyis yun ring du sring zhing bsdam dgos/19 rtogs tshad la thog mar skem pa'i tshul du bcos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ rtogs tshad kyi rgyu ni chu ser yin phyir de nyid bcos skabs thog

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 135mar rlan chen po'i rigs la bye ma btab nas skam pa ltar chu ser rang sar skam du 'jug dgos/20 gnas skabs tsha ba sde drug gi dang nad 'gyur ngo bo' ltar yin pa dang / de dag la gnas skabs0 tsha ba zer don ci/lan/ ma smin tsha ba'i rgyu ni bad rlung dang ngo bo 'dus pa'i tshad pa yin/rgyas tshad rgyu ni gnod byed mkhris pa dang tsha ba rkyang ba'i sde tshan yin/ stongs tshad ni rlung gis tsha ba bus pa dang / gab tshad ni tsha ba'i 'go bad kun gyis byibs pa/ rnyings tshad ni yun ring lon pa/ rnyogs tshad ni chu ser gyis skyed pa yin no/ /tsha ba de dag gnas skabs gnas skabs la 'gyur ldog 'byung nges pa ste/masan pa tsha ba kun gyi sdun la 'byung ba dang / de nas rgyas tshan/ de nas stongs tshad yin la/ tsha ba de gsum yag por bcos ma thub pa'am bcos nyes shor na res gab tshad res rnyings tshad res rnyogs tshad sogs la 'gyur 'gro bas gnas skabs kyi tsha ba zhes brjod pa yin/21 'grams tshadashā go don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ spyod lam drag shul dang brdabs lhung sogs las lus la phog thug shor nas lus kyi phyi nang gang rung du tsha ba 'grams pa la bya mod/ yin yang brdabs pa sogs las lus na rma yod tshe rma tshad yin pa las 'grams tshad ma yin no/ /

136 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/22 'grams tshad rigs gnyis ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ sha rus rtsa dang chu rgyus bcas phyi yi yul bzhir 'grams pa dang /glo snying mchin mcher sogs nang gi don snod la 'grams pa dang gnyis so/ /22 rgyas 'khrugs stongs 'khrugs 'jam 'khrugs gsum gyi ngo bo gang 'dra yin/lan/ rgyas 'khrugs kyi ngo bo ni mkhris tshad khrag la rgyas pa ste mkhris shas che ba dang / stongs 'khrugs ni mkhris tshad rlung gis bus te rlung shas che ba/'jam 'khrugs ni bad kun grang bas khrag mkhris tsha ba'i 'go mnan nas bad kun gyi shas che ba la bya/24 rgyas 'khrugs0 babs sgo brgyad po gang gang yin/lan/ rgyud chen las/ babs sgo glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / / mkhris pa rtsa dang rlung la babs pa brgyad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /25 'khrugs tshad kyi lud pa'i brtag thabs brgyad po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ lud pa skya gsob yin na snying gi gab 'khrugs dang / dmar na glo ba'i gab 'khrugs/ dmar ser mchin pa'i gab 'khrugs/ smug nag mcher ba'i gab 'khrugs/ sre 'o mkhal ma'i gab 'khrugs/ dmar la theng por lu ba rtsa 'khrugs/ ser dwangs mkhris pa'i gab 'khrugs/ sngon po wu

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 137gsob rlung 'khrugs bcas brgyad do/ /sa bcad bcu gsum pa/ gnyan rims gso ba/1 rims nad ces pa'i go don ci/lan/ rims zhes pa bya ba'i rim dang don gcig yin la/ nad kyi skabs su mi nor phyir rims zhes sbyar ba yin te/ nad rigs rnams 'jug sgo drug nas rim bzhin lus la zhugs pa dang gcig nas gcig tu rim gyis 'go ba/ yang na rim gyis smin pas na rims zhes bshad/ man ngag rin chen gces bsdus las/ rims nad ces pa nad pa'i dri dngos sam/ / nad de yod pa'i phyogs kyi du ba dang / / rlung sogs phog pas gcig nas gcig nyid la/ / rim gyis 'go ba'i phyir na rims zhes bya/ / zhes gsungs/2 rims nad sbyi'i dbye ba lnga bo gang gang yin/lan/ rims nad lnga bo ni bal nad dang / 'brum bu/ rgyu gzer/gag lhog cham rims bcas lags/2 b.land ces pa'i ming de' ltar thogs payin/lan/ ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo la ming gi rnam grangs bcu drug yod pa las nang gses bal mo he le 'bar ma zhes pa de'i kha rlangs las byung ba'i rims nad yin phyir bal nad ces nad bdag gi ming nad la btags par bshad/

138 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/4 rlung rims dang mkhris rims bad rims gsum gyi babs sa dang /rgyas sa/ lam don sa bcas gang dang gang yin/lan/ rgyud las/ rlung rims babs sa rus yin rus kun na/ / rgyas sa don yin lce skam za zi mang / / tha mar srog rtsar lam don smyo 'bros byed/ / ces dang / mkhris rims dang po babs sa rtsa yin pas/ / rtsa chu tsha la rtsa rgyas rtsa rnams 'khyug / bar du rgyas pa'i sa ni khrag yin pas/ / chu dmar ro stod tsha zhing sna khrag 'ong / / tha ma phal cher pho bar lam don pas/ / mkhris pas pho ba'i me drod phyir bton te/ / lce skam mchu thung kha skam so dreg chags/ / dang ga mi bde stong skyugs byed pa'o/ / zhes dang /bad rims dang po babs sa dang ga ste/ / kha mngal zas mi 'ju la dang ga 'gag / bar du rgyas sa sha dang klad pa ste/ / lus lci myos dang lkugs par 'gyur ba yin/ / tha mar 'chor sa mkhal mar lam don pas/ / chu sri mkhal rked na la rna ba 'on/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /5 'dus rims dbye na rgyun rims rtag pa'i rims nyin gcig nyin gsumanyan bzhi bcas rnam pa lnga yod pa de dag ni lus zungs bdun gyi nang nas gang dang gang la babs pa'i ming yin/lan/ rgyun rims ni rims nad lus zungs bdun gyi nang nas dwangs mar babs pa'i ming dang / rtag pa'i rims ni khrag la babs pa/ rims nyinagacig pa ni sha la babs pa/ rims nyin gsum pa ni tshil la babs pa/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 139rims nyin bzhi ba ni rus la babs pa'i ming ngo /6 'dus rims la bco brgyad nyi shu gcig na 'tsho 'chi phye zhes pa'i don ci yin/lan/ 'di'i bad la be+e sngon las/ zhag grangs ni dwangs ma nas lus zungs bdun rim par khyab pa'i dbang gis lus zungs re re la zhag gsum re babs pas dngas ma'i zhag gsum bcad pa'i zhag bco brgyad dang / dwangs ma'i zhag kyang rtogs na nyi shu gcig 'das nas mjug gzhan la ma 'khyogs tshe phal cher 'tsho ba dang 'chi ba'i shan phye/ zhes pa 'di las 'thus/7 gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gnas gzhan la babs pa'i khyad par gyirtags ci yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ khyad par mgor bros klad gzer sna khrag 'dzag / glor babs ro stod gzer la lud pa ser/ / mkhal babs mkhal skad na zhing dri chu sdom/ / pho bar babs na kha kha mkhris pa skyug / rgyu mar babs na zug che tshan can 'khru/ / de dag mi 'gyur 'khrul med nad rtags yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ // 'brum bu'i rims0 nad 'gyur ngo po' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ ngo bo tsha ba chu ser la babs nas/ / rus rkang lha ba'i gting nas skye bar byed/ / thor ba'am 'brum bu 'ong phyir ming du brjod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /

140 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/9 beg ge nad kyirgyu dang thog ma'i nadartagasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ gnyan nad beg ge'am sib bi'i rgyu ni khrag dang chu ser la gnyan tshad babs pa yin la/ nad 'di lus la thebs ma thag tu mgo rkang dang tshigs gzhi na zhing grang shum byed pa dang / de nas lus la tsha rgyas te mig rtsa dmar por 'gyur zhing mig skyag mang ba/ thog mar rkan phug dang kha'i nang 'gram/ gre ba'i ldebs sogs la thor ba skya sib 'byung zhing rim gyis rna rgyab dang mchan 'og ske mjing sogs lus kun la thor ba dmar zhib kyis khyab pa bcas yin/10 rgya gzer stobs chen gyi nad bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ stobs chen nad la bcos tshul rnam pa bdun/ / snod kyi rtsi srung mkhris pa'i me bsad cing / / rgyu long rul sbyang nad dngos gnyen pos bsad/ / mchin pa'i zags bsdam 'khru ba'i kha dog sgyur/ / tha mar chu bo'i rgyun lam bcad pa'o/ / zhes rgyud las gsungs pa 'di rtsa don du 'dzin dgos/11 gag pa'i nad rigs bzhi bo gang gang yin/ cilan/ pho gag dang / mo gag bu gag gnyan gag bzhi'o/ /12 lhog pa la dbye tshul ci 'dra yod/lan/ lhog pa 'byung bas dbye na sa chu me rlung bzhi dang / nad gzhi'i sgo nas dbye na dkar nag khra bo gsum/ rigs kyis dbye na rgod dang yang

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 141rgod yam bu yu mo bcas bzhi yod/12 gnyan rims la babs sa'i dbang gis ming tha dad du dbye tshul dzi ltar yin nam/lan/ gnyan nad mgo la babs na klad gzer dang / gre bar babs na gag pa/ ro stod la babs na gzer thung / pho bar babs na pho log gam gnyan glang / rgyu mar babs na rgyu gzer/ lpags la babs na me dbal/tshil la babs na rmen bu/ nywa la babs na nywa log shar babs na lhog pa zer/'di la gag lhog spun dgu zer tshul yang mchis/14 gnyananadakyi nad 'gyur ngo bo' ltar yinanam/lan/ lus la lhan skyes su gnas pa'i khrag srin rkang med zlum po dmar bdang phyi rol gyi dug can srin bu pan ta gnyis lhan cig tu bsdongs nas gyur pa yin/15 ci 'dra zhig la nag po sum bsgril zer/lan/ lus srog la 'phral du gnod par byed pa'i nad gdug pa can la nag po zhes mdog gi tha snyad sbyar ba'i gnyan dang tshad pa rlung gsum mnyam du bsgril ba'i nad kyi ming ste/ gdug pa'i nad ngan tre tre hos bcos pa'i gdams pa thengs po zla ba'i thigs pa las/ gnyan srin par pa ta dang ni/ /tshad pa tre tre hos zhes pa/ / rlung rims thol pa mgo 'khor gsum/ /bsdongs pa nag po gsum bsgril zer/ / zhes so/ /

142 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/16 cham rims0 dbye ba bzhi bo gang gang yin/lan/ cham rims bzhi ni gre cham dang / glo cham/ rims cham/ sna cham bcas lags/17 ci 'dra zhig la cham pa skyur shor zer/lan/ rims cham gyi nad la zas skom bcud can dang skyur ba'i rigs/spyod lam drag shul sogs bsten drags pas nad stobs sngar bas cher rgyas pa la cham pa skyur shor zer ba'o/ /sa bcad bcu bzhi pa/ lus stod gso ba/1 lus stod gso ba'i nang don gtso bo dbang bo lnga'i gso tshul yin yang der lus stod gso ba zer don ci yin/lan/ de ni wa ba dbang bo'i gras min pas red/2 lus stod kyi nad gso skabs mgo bo'i nad thog mar bslab dgos don ci/lan/ mgo ni dbang bo lnga'i nang gi mchog dang de dag gi rten gtso bo/klad pa rtsa dkar gyi gnas bcas yin pas thog mar bslab dgos/2 mgo bo'i nad la gtso phal gyi dbye ba 'byed don ci/lan/ nad kyi rkyen dang stobs che chung la bltas nas de ltar dbye ba ste/gtso bo'i nad brgyad ni nang rkyen la bltas nas stobs che bar bstan pa dang /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 143phal ba'i nad drug ni phyi rkyen la bltas nas stobs chung bar bstan pa yin/4 rgyurkyen gang la brten nas skya byi ba yin/lan/ skra byi ba'i rgyu ni ro tsha ba dang skyur ba sogs khrag ngan chu ser rgyas pa'i bza' btung gi rigs bsten drags pa dang / mya ngan dang sems las che ba bcas las mkhris pa rlung dang 'dres pa de ba spu'i bu gar zhugs nas skra rtsa srul te skra byi bar byed pa yin/5 skra dkar por 'gyur ba'i rkyen ci yin nam/lan/ spyir zas spyod dman lhag log pas lus kyi 'du ba 'khrugs pa dang / khyad par du 'byung ba me chu gnyis kyi stobs che ba'i ro lan tshwa lta bu mang du bsten drags pas khrag mkhris skyed nas de'i drod rlangs mgor zhugs nas skra tshos te skra dkar 'gyur ba yin/6 mig nad nang 'gribs skabs mcho gnyis 'dres zhes pa'i go don ci yin/lan/ mtsho gnyis 'dres zhes pa ni dbus chu'i mtsho dang mthong byed rgyal mo'i mtsho gnyis 'khrugs nas 'dres te snag tsha lta bu nag ngam du song ba'i don/7 migashām bzhi ni gang dang gangayin/lan/ mig khyim bzhi ni phyi rus pa'i khyim dang / nang tshil bu'i khyim/dbus chu'i khyim/ mthong byed rgyal mo'i khyim bcas lags/

144 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho// mig nad bar 'gribs bzhi bo'i nadartags ltar yin nam/lan/ bar 'gribs rlung las gyur pa ni 'grib byed kyi dbyibs dang kha dog sogs nyi ma dang 'dra ba/ mkhris 'gribs ni zhug pa'i mig dang 'dra ba ste/ 'grib byed ser po chags pa/ bad kun gyi 'gribs pa ni zla ba dang 'dra bar dkar ba/ 'dus pa'i 'gribs pa ni 'ja' tshon 'dra ba ste/ tshon mdog sna tshogs yod pa lta bu khra bor chags pa bcas 'byung ba yin/9 mig nad bar 'gribs thur mas dbye ba'i dus kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs nyes pa so so'i smin dusa' ltar yin nam/lan/ dus kyi sngon 'gro rlung 'gribs lo gsum smin/ / bad kun lo gcig 'dus pa phyed dang gnyis/ / mkhris pa zla ba drug gis smin pa'i dus/ / zhes rgyud las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /10 mig nad bar 'gribs thur mas dbye rung min gyi tshad ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ dbyer mi rung ba lud pa cham pas btab/ /ma zhu 'khru skyug mgo gzer yod pa dang / / lus la dgra dar spar kha li la babs/ / 'dus pa'i mig tshil zhu ba dbyer mi rung / / phyi 'gribs nang 'gribs thur mas dbyer mi phyed/ / ma smin dus su bsal yang slar 'gebs spang / / me zla nyi ma shar nub mi mthong na/ / dus 'das rgyal mo'i mthu nyams dbyer mi rung / / dbyer rung de zlog chu nang zhag thigs 'dra/ / zla

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 145ba nya ltar gang ba dbye bar bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/11 mig sprin gyi pags pa'i srab mthug dang nang gi chil bu'i ska sla de ji tsam yin nam/lan/ 'di'i thad la gong sman pa'i pod dmar las/ lpags pa srab mthug gla tel tsam/ / nang gi tshil bu zan sla tsam/ / zhes gsungs/12 kong sprul zin tig tu 'grib rigs yod pa'i mig nad la zhes bstan pa'i 'grib rigs zhes pa'i go don ci yin nam/lan/ 'grib rigs kyi nad ces pa ni rgyud 'ded rang bzhin gyi nad la go dgos/12 mig sman rnams tho rangs0 dus dang bla ba'i yar ngo la bsten pa gces pa'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ mig nad ni rtsa sgo rnams rgyad pa las byung bas na/ tho rangs ni pho ba'i me rlung gi nus pa gyen du 'phyo zhing rtsa sbrubs rnams kyi sgo phye ba'i dus yin pas de dus bston na nus pa shin tu mnga' ba dang / zla ba'i yar ngo la bsten pa ni zla ba je gsal du 'gro ba nang bzhin rten 'brel gyi dbang gis yin/14 rna ba'i nad la dbye ba du yod/ gang gang yin/lan/ rags pa'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis dang zhib tu bcu yod de/ rtsa bar/ dbye ba rna ba'i nad dang 'on pa gnyis/ / nad ni rlung mkhris bad

146 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/kun khrag dang bzhi/ / 'dus gyur rnag 'dzag 'brum thor 'byung ba drug /'on pa sgra bcas 'on dang rna spabs 'gags/ / skam 'on ma rlung bu la shor ba bzhi/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /15 sna khrag gi mdog la bltas nas rigs gsum du dbye ba de dag gi bcos thabs ji ltarayin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ sna nas khrag 'dzag de rigs rnam pa gsum/ /ser la sla ba klad pa las 'byung ste/ / smin dbrag mes bsdam rta sbangs sna sman btang / / smug nag sne bzhi las babs sne sa bcing / / nu ma rlig pa za 'og skud pas bkyig / dmar la dwangs pa rtsa kha bye ba yin/ / sna yi dbugs kyis gar sleb dpung 'dzum bsreg / ces so/ /16 sna khrag 'dzag pa bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ sna khrag phal cher khrag 'phel ba las byung bas na rtse chung sogs gtar nas 'ol kha bsgyur ba dang / mgo dang ro stod chus bran la/ rtsa kha bsdam byed kyi sman bsten pa dang / zas dang spyod lam bsil zhing dal bar bya dgos/17 rlung gi so nad dang so grin gnyis kyi nadartagasa' ltar yin/lan/ rgyud las/ rlung gi so nad ber ba langs nas na/ / 'phar rtsa 'khyug cing grang mo bzod thabs med/ / ces dang / srin nad tsha grang gang yang reg thabs med/ / ldang dub byed cing zug langs lhang lhang gzer/ /

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 141zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / — 1〈 spu ba'i nad la dbye ba du yod/ gang gang yin/lan/ de la dbye na rlung wa dang / mkhris wa/ bad wa/ tshil wa/'dus pa'i wa ba/ g.yang wa/ byur wa bcas brgyad yod/19 wa ba'i sman rmen bu'i smyor ba sogs bod ches zla ba'i mar ngo la bsten dgos don ci/lan/ zla ba'i mar ngo tshes bcu drug nas zla ba rim bzhin je chung du 'gro ba bzhin wa ba yang rim gyis chung du 'gro bar rten 'brel gyi sgo nas sbyar ba yin no/ /sa bcad bco lnga pa/ thor nad gso ba/1 thor bu'i nad ces pa'i go don ri yin/lan/ ma lag chen po chags ma thub pa'i sde tshan kha thor du ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa dang / yang na sde tshan gzhan nang ma tshud par thor bu gnas pa rnams dkyus gcig tu bstan pa la thor nad zer/2 pho ba'i glang thabs dang rgyu ma'i glang thabs/ long gi glang thabs bcas gsum gyi na sa'i gnas gang dang gang yin/lan/ pho ba'i glang thabs nyen sna'i 'og tu na/ / rgyu ma'i glang thabs lte ba'i 'og tu na/ / long glang lte ba'i g.yas g.yon thad kur na/ / zhes

148 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/so/ /2 srin bu'i nad rnams kyi khyad par gyi gnas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ bad kun pho ba rlung srin long na gnas/ / mkhris srin so mig lpags gzhang mtshan mar gnas/ / khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba ste/ / khrag la gnas shing rtsa nang kun tu rgyug / gnyan nad kun gyi rgyu dang mdze nad byed/ / klad srin ya ma dkar nag de las byung / / zhes rgyud las gsungs/4 bshang ba chu'i gting du 'gro na tsha 'khru dang / chu khar ling nger sdod na grang 'khru yin pa'ir+gha mtshan ci/lan/ tsha 'khru phal cher mchin tshad thur du babs pa las byung bas na zungs 'dres pas lci zhing chu nang du btang na gting du 'gro ba dang / grang 'khru phal cher me drod nyams pa las byung bas zungs med yang ba dang chur btang na chu khar sdod pa yin/5 tsha 'khru dang grang 'khru gnyis0rtags gtso bo ci yin nam/lan/ tsha 'khru'i mdog dmar ser dang dri ma mnam la na zug yod pa/grang 'khru'i mdog com pa can dang dri med la zug chung ba'am med pa bcas yin/zhi gcin 'gags dang gcin sri gnyis kyi nye bag ci yin nam/lan/ gcin 'gags ni gcin pa mi 'bab par 'gags pa'am dri chu

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 149mi 'byung ba'i don dang / gcin sri ni gcin pa rgyun ldan ltar mi 'bab par gcin kha sra ba'am gtong dka' ba'i don yin/7 gcin snyi za khu'i nadakyi rkyen ci yin nam/lan/ ro lan tshwa ba dang mngar ba/ nus pa bsil lci ldan zhing bcud che ba'i zas skom rigs bsten drags pa dang / rlan gsher yod sar bsdad drags pa sogs las bad kun sa chu rang bzhin gyi khams 'phel zhing / dwangs ma lus zungs su ma smin par snyigs ma dang 'dres te lhang par zags nas za khu skyed par byed// za khu nyi shu bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ dbye ba bad mkhris rlung dang rnam pa gsum/ /bad kun za khu chu chang bur shing dang / / gar po 'bras phye khu chu bye ma dang / / bsil dang bags 'byung kha chu bcu ru bshad/ / mkhris pa'i za khu nas tshig snag tsha dang / / sngon po skyer khu btsod khu khrag 'dra drug / rlung gyur rkang zhag glang chen sbrang 'dra bzhi/ / za khu nyi shu gcin snyi'i nad rigs yin/ / zhes so/ /kha gcin snya za khu'i spyi rtagasa' ltar yin/lan/ de rtags mngon tshul mal stan gnyid la rtsi/ / rngul mang dri mnam skra dang sen mo ring / / kha mngar gre ba rkan skams bsil la rtsi/ /mthil bzhi tsha zhing gcin mdog rnyog can 'byung / / gcin gyi shul la sbrang

150 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/ma'i tshogs kun 'du/ / mngon tshul mi gsal mdog la nges ma yin/ / zhes rgyud las gsungs pa 'di'o/ /10 gcin snyi dang gcin snya za༅ gnyis0༄da par ci yin/lan/ gcin snyi ni phal cher grang stobs kyi dbang gis mkhal ma dang lhang pa'i stobs shor ba'am thur sel rlung gi nus pa lhag nas dus min du gcin pa bongs chung ngu 'phral 'phral grangs mang 'byung ba la bya zhing / dper na byis pa kha shas dgong mo nyal dus mal stan gyi steng du rang dbang med par gcin shor ba lta bu/ 'di la zungs mi 'dres pas gcin mdog dwangs shing gso sla ba/ gcin snyi za khu ni zas kyi dwangs ma zungs su ma smin par snyigs mar 'dres nas 'bab pas na gcin kha snyi ba'i khar za khu yang yod pas gcin mdog rtogs pa can 'byung zhing shin tu nas gso dka' pa'i nad cig yin/'di'i thad la zur mkhar bas/ gcin snyi yin min gcin pa'i grangs la brtag / za khu yin min gcin pa'i mdog la brtag / ces pa las kyang 'thus snyam/11 gcin snya za khu bcos skabs bad chil gtso bor bcos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gcin snyi za khu ni zas spyod mngar bsil lci ba sogs bsten drags pas rten dang brten par gnas pa'i tshil dang bad kun gnyis 'phel zhing / zas kyi dwangs ma rnams zungs su ma smin par dwangs snyigs 'dres pa

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 151de mkhal ma'i me drod kyis ma thub par lhang par bags kyis zags nas gcin snyi za khu bskyed pas na/ nad 'di bcos skabs bad tshil skyed byed kyi zas skom rigs spang ci thub dang zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi bo drod du sprugs nas nad rgyu bad tshil gtso bo bcos rgyu gal che ste/ rgyud las/ rgyu ma bcos par 'bras bu gso 'dod pa/ / dug rtsa ma phyung lo ma bcad skyur 'dra/ / zhes gsungs pas so/ /12 tshad 'khru la0 nad tshad 'khru zhes brjod don ci yin/lan/ de ni nad 'di rgya gar dang rgya nag sogs tsha ba che ba'i yul grur mang du 'byung bas 'byung khungs la bltas nas de ltar btags pa yin/12 dreg nad0rgyurkyena' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ rgyu rkyen khrag 'khrug byed pa'i zas spyod bsten/ /nyin par gnyid log skyid par 'dug pa dang / / drag shul rkyen gyis rlung khrag 'khrugs pa yis/ / rkang pa'i mtheb mo lag pa'i gru mor gnas/ / dang po khol bu rnyings nas mched par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/14 cag nad bcos pa'i rtsa don ci dang nad de'i thog ma'i gnas bzhi bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ dreg nad bcos pa'i rtsa don ni kun la bad tshil rlung khrag gtso bor bcos dgos shing / thog ma'i gnas bzhi ni rkang pa'i mtheb mo gnyis dang lag pa'i gru mo gnyis yin/

152 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/15 grum bu zhes pa'i go don ci yin/lan/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/ tshigs mig chu ser 'phel ba yis /'byor byed byed las nyams gyur te/ / tshigs kun chag grum shor ba ltar/ /gyur pas grub bu zhes su bshad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar dang / nad 'di ni sha rus kun la gnas pa'i nad cig yin/16 4ma dkar dang trem nag ces pa'i go don dang ngo bo ci yin nam/lan/ trem ni zhang zhung skad kyi grum bu'i ming dang / dkar dang nag ces pa ni nad tsha grang gi ngo bo dang rtags la bltas nas btags pa ste/ nad kyi ngo bo chu ser dkar po dang bad rlung grang ba shas che zhing skrangs mdog skya la na zug chung ba la trem dkar zhes brjod pa dang / nad kyi ngo bo chu ser nag po dang khrag mkhris tsha ba shas che zhing skrangs mdog nag cing na zug che ba la trem nag ces brjod/17 ro drug zas skom dag lus0 chu ser du ji ltar 'gyur ba yin/lan/ rgyud chen las/ dang po gyur tshul kha zas dwangs ma de/ /mkhris pa dmar bsgyur las kyis khrag tu 'gyur/ / khrag gi snyigs ma mkhris pa'i nang du gsog / mkhris pa'i dwangs ma chu ser nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes so /1/ chu ser dkar po dang nag po zhes pa gang la bltas nas dbye ba yin/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 153lan/ chu ser dkar nag ces pa ni nad kyi ngo bo la bltas nas dbye ba ste/ nad kyi ngo bo bad rlung grang bar bsdongs pa la chu ser dkar po dang /nad kyi ngo bo khrag mkhris tsha bar bsdongs pa la chu ser nag po zer/19 chu ser gyi khyad par gyi gnas dang ldang tshada' ltar yin nam/lan/ spyir chu ser lus kun la khyab pa dang / khyad par sha mdangs /ra dang tshigs par gnas pa dang / ldang tshad ni rang gi snyim pa bzhi yin 20 chu ser lpags la grams pa dang sha la rgyas pa'i rtags gang 'dra yin/lan/ chu ser lpags grams khyad par za 'phrug byed/ / thor chung mang la phrags na cha ser 'dzag / lpags mdog sngo rtsab gyong la srin thor mang / /rami chosi rari sha la rgyas na nywa sgang shu ba 'byung / / sha kun 'gul 'phrig skrangs shing sbo ba yin/ / zhes pa ltar yin/21 chu ser gyi nad la bya ra gces pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rtsa bar/ mdor bsdus chu ser 'phel bas nad 'gyur te/ / sha bkra glang shu srin thor khye ma dang / / shu ba za rkong za 'phrug chu ser byed/ /'or dang skya rbab dmu chu chu ser byed/ / sur ya me dpal dreg grum gag lhog dang / / rnyogs pa'i tsha ba thams cad chu ser byed/ / mgo dang yan lag byang khog la sogs pa/ / rma yi nyes pa thams cad chu ser byed/ / 'bras

154 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/dang mdze nad chu ser las 'byung bas/ / de phyir chu ser nad la bya ra gces/ / zhes so/ /22 rtsa rigs gcig la chu rtsa dang rgyu rtsa dbang rtsa rlung rtsa rtsa dkar bcas ming mi 'dra ba 'dogs don ci yin/lan/ chu rtsa zhes pa ni chu ba dang 'dra bas 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags/ rgyu rtsa yang rgyu ma dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas btags/ dbang rtsa ni lus kun la bya ba byed pas byed las kyi sgo nas btags/ rlung rtsa ni ngo bo'i sgo nas btags pa ste rtsa'i nang du rlung rgyu ba'i phyir/ rtsa dkar ni kha dog gi sgo nas btags pa ste khrag rtsa dang bsdur na dkar po yin pas so/ /22 spags nad0r+gha rkyena' ltar yin nam/lan/ lus la lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu dang chu ser rang rang gi ldang tshad las brgal bar 'phel pa la phyi rkyen gdon dang / nad kyi 'du ba 'khrugs nas lpags pa'i nad skyed par byed pa yin no/ /24 ci zhig la phran bu'i nad zer ram/lan/ lus srog la gnod pa cher med cing nad stobs chung la glo bur 'phral 'phral du 'byung ba'i rgyun mthong phran tshegs kyi nad rigs la phran bu'i nad ces brjod do/ /sa bcad bcu drug pa/ lhan skyes rma gso ba/1 spyir 'bras nad 'byung sla ba'i gnas dang khyad par du khrag las

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 155gyur pa'i 'bras nad 'byung sla ba'i gnas gang dang gang yin/lan/ spyir khong 'bras phal cher pho long dang mid pa'i 'brel mtshams la mang du 'byung ba dang / khyad par du khrag las gyur pa'i 'bras ni gtso bo bud med kyi nu ma dang mngal du 'byung sla bar bshad/2 'bras dang skran gyi khyad par gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ nad 'di gnyis thog mar ma zhu ba sogs las 'byung ba shas che zhing lus kyi phyi nang stod smad bar gsum du sra mkhregs gong bu can gyi rnam pa 'dril ba 'dra na'ang / skran nad la reg pa'i sgo nas brtags tshe gong bu'i mtha' mtshams gsal zhing 'jam la 'gul nus pa dang / 'phel 'gros dal zhing gnas gzhan du mi mched pa/ spyir btang de'i nye 'dabs kyi dbang bo la gnod mi skyel zhing mi'i tshe srog la nyen kha mi che ba/ lus stobs dang gzi mdangs rim gyis shor ba dang nad ldang ba'i skabs la zug che ba bcas khyad chos yod/ 'bras nad reg na gong bu chung zhing ngo bo shin tu nas sra mkhregs ldan la/ mtha' mtshams mi gsal zhing g.yo 'gul mi byed pa/ nye 'dabs kyi dbang bor gnod skyel ba/ nad gsar ba'i dus su na zug chung zhing rtags mi mngon pa/ phyis su 'phel skyen zhing rtsa lam mam rmen bu'i lam brgyud nas gnas gzhan du mched pa/ lus stobs myur du nyams shing gso dka' la gdug rtsub che ba/ nad pa'i tshe srog la rgol ba 'byung bcas khyad chos ldan/2 khong 'bras smin nas gso ba dka' ba'i phyir/ / smin du mi gzhug

156 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gsar dus gso ba sgrims/ / zhes pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ khong 'bras kyi rigs rnams smin nas nad stobs rdzogs na bcos dka' ba phud/ lus kun la byer nyen yang che bas smin du mi gzhug par dro bcos mi bya zhing nges par du nad stobs ma rdzogs gong gsar ba'i dus su legs par brtags rjes mi lhod par gso ba sgrims dgos/lu rmen bu'i nad 'byung sla ba'i gnas gang dang gang yin/lan/ rmen bu'i nad 'byung sla ba'i gnas ni ske mjing dang / mchan khung / sne sa khud bcas men bu 'dus pa'i gnas rnams yin/ga rligacags kyi ming gzhan la ci zer/lan/ wa rta ni rlig rlugs kyi ming gi rnam grangs shig yin/6 rkang 'bam smad du ma babs gong gnyan sman gyi rigs bsten mi chog pa'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ rkang 'bam smad du ma babs gong gnyan sman klu bdud bco brgyad lta bu bston na lus kun la byer 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /7 sur+ya'i nad0 go don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ surla zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di legs sbyar skad du nyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs shig yin la/ bod skad du bsgyur na 'od 'gyed dam nyi zer ces 'byung / dngos don ni khrag ngan don glo mchin mkhal ma dang snod pho long gi gnas rnams su 'dus nas 'drul te/ rma'i mdog nyi ma ltar dmar la

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 157dbyibs sgor mor 'byung zhing mthar nyi zer ltar 'byung bas de dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas btags pa'i ming ngo / /sa bcad bcu bdun pa/ byis pa gso ba/1 byis pa'i nad la rags phra zhib tshags gsum gyi go rim ltar nges dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ byis pa'i nad la rags phra zhib tshags gsum du dbye don ni gtso bo nad stobs che 'bring chung gsum la sbyar nas nad stobs cung zad che zhing nyen kha yod pa'am 'byung mang ba'i nad la rags pa'i nad dang / rags pa'i nad las nyen kha mi che zhing nad stobs 'bring tsam yin pa la phra ba'i nad/nad stobs dang nyen kha cung zad chung ba la zhib tshags kyi nad ces ltos sa ltos 'jog gi sgo nas de skad ming btags pa dang go rim yang de ltar dbye ba yin/2 phru gu skyes dus ngu skad drag po sgrog pa dang sbyi bo ring la kha rjes nu ma drag tu 'jib pa bcas bkra gis pa'irtags yin don ci/lan/ de ni phru gu de nyid kyi dbang bo'i tshor shes gsal po yod pa dang /mgo dbyibs legs shing de mthun gyi klad pa bzang ba/ bkres skom dus su 'byung ba sogs mdor na lus kyi 'tshar stobs legs shing gson tshad mtho la gso sla ba'i rtags yin pas so/ /

158 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/2 byis pa'i nadakri brtags ci 'dra yin/lan/ rgyud chen du/ spyi rtags rtag tu ngu las nar shes bya/ / gang nar 'ju dang der mnan na ba dang / / mig 'byed dka' zhing ngo nag dang ga 'gag / rtsed mo mi rtse dbugs mi bde ba dang / / skad gnya' 'khun zhing sen mo rno ba 'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/4 byis pa na phra rnams la brtag thabs gang gang brten nas nad ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ lus sems ma smin pa'i byis pa na phra rnams la rlung khrag rgyu shed ma rdzogs pas lag pa'i 'phar rtsa la nges pa med phyir gtso bo byis pa'i rna rtsa dang ngu skad/ ma'i zho pra bcas la brtags nas nad ngos 'dzin dgos/5 byis pa'i rna rtsa dang don snod② 'brel smyor ci 'dra yin/lan/ byis pa pho'i rna ba g.yon par mngon che ba'i rtsa bzhi yod pa ni dang po mtshun rtsa/ de 'og snying dang rgyu ma'i rtsa/ de 'og mcher ba dang pho ba/de 'og mkhal g.yon dang bsam se'u rtsa/ g.yas pa'i dang po mtshun rtsa/ de 'og glo long gnyis kyi rtsa/ de 'og mchin mkhris/ de 'og mkhal g.yas dang lhang pa'i rtsa/ mo la glo snying go ldog dgos/6 byis pa'i zang nad ces pa'i nad de'i ngo bo ci yin/lan/ de'u dmar bas brang nad byis pa'i rtsa nad ming zhes pa ltar nad 'di thog mar phog dus brang dang ro stod du spangs pa 'byung zhing / ngo bo ni rtsa

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 159nad chu ser grams pa las byung ba'i 'dar nad yin/ de'i phyir ming gi rnam grangs la byis pa'i brang nad dang / byis pa'i rtsa nad/ byis pa'i 'dar nad bcas kyang zer/7 byis pa'i nad dus skabs gsum dang sbyar nas sman dpyad bsten tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ zho 'thung dus na sman dpyad ma la bya/ / zas 'dres dus na ma bu gnyis la bya/ / zho spang zas za'i dus na bu la bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin// byis pa'i nad man gyis bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin/lan/ de yang rgyud las/ sman gyis bcos pa zhi dang sbyang ba gnyis/ /zhi byed bzang zhing 'jam la 'ju sla ba/ / kur bur kha blangs mngar shas che ba byin/ / sngo thang bshal sman la sogs rtsub mo rnams/ / legs par bsdus khu 'jam zhing 'ju sla bsten/ / bshal rjes 'bras kyi tshod ma shis pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di rtsa don du 'dzin dgos/9 ci 'dra zhig la zho ras nad zer/ de'i gtso po'i nadartags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ zho ras kyi nad ces pa ni byis pa chung ngu zho 'thung gi skabs su ma'i nad stobs dang / yang na mas zas skom 'dra min nyog bsres byas pa las nu zho ras pa ste skyon can du gyur pa de byis pas yang yang du 'thungs nas

160 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/byis pa la na zug byung ba'i nad cig yin la/ nad rtags gtso bo rgyud chen las/ rlung gyur nu zho wu bcas chu stong 'phyo/ / de yis pho ba sbo skyug bshang gci sri/ / mkhris gyur ser snang ro skyur tshad pa skye/ / bad kun sngo nal chur 'bying ma zhu skyed/ / tshom bur chad na gdon ngo yod pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /sa bcad bco brgyad pa/ mo nad gso ba/1 khrag tshabs dang rlung tshabs gnyis0bad par ci yin nam/lan/ khrag tshabs dang rlung tshabs gnyis kyi khyad par la nyams yig kha shas su lte ba yan chad na na khrag tshabs dang / lte ba man chad na na rlung tshabs zhes lus kyi stod smad la gzhigs nas dbye tshul mchis kyang / dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang gzhung 'grel phal mo che ru khrag dang rlung gnyis kyi shas che chung dang /dus kyi yun 'gor ma 'gor sogs la bltas nas ngos 'dzin dang dbye ba 'byed pa ste/ rgyud las/ dbye ba khrag tshabs rlung tshabs rnam pa gnyis/ /de rgyu dang po zla mtshan las byung phyir/ / gsar ba'i dus na khrag tshabs zhes bya ste/ / rnyings nas rlung dang bsdongs pas rlung tshabs so/ / zhes gsungs/2 khrag tshabs sbyi'i nad rtags ltar yin nam/lan/ de rtags khrag tshabs spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ / rked so man chad rus pa 'khol zhing na/ / rgyu zhabs tsha 'brab ro rgyab mchin dri gzer/ / rtsa

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 161rnams tsha 'khyug shu ba 'brum phran 'ong / / mngal khrag 'dzag gam 'khyil dang rnag tu 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /2 mo nadakyi skabs su rtsa nad bcu drug la tshabs nad ces brjod don ci yin/lan/ de ni nad de dag bud med kyi lus la lo zla du mar gnas shing lus zungs nyams par byed pa dang / lus sems mi bde bar mnar bas gnod tshabs che phyir tshabs nad ces bshad pa yin/ /4 zla mtshan dang nu zho'i ldang tshada' tsam yin/lan/ zla mtshan gyi tshad ni snyim pa bzhi dang nu zho'i ldang tshad snyim pa do yin par bshad/5 mngal srin gnyis po gang gang yin/lan/ mngal srin gnyis ni ma ra ka dang a so ka gnyis so/ /6 mngal skran gyi thun mong gi nadartags ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ kun kyang byis pa chags ltar sra zhing 'dril/ /skabs su sbo zhing na gzer chu ser 'dzag / ces pa 'di'o/ /7 rlung tshabs dang khrag tshabs/ mngal nad bcas bcos pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ rlung tshabs drug po drod dang bcud kyis bcos/ / khrag tshabs bcu po bsil drod khre 'ur bcos/ / zhes dang /

162 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bcos thabs mngal nad phal cher rlung yin pas/ / snum 'chos 'jam rtsi dugs kyis gso ba bsngags/ / zhes pa 'di'o/ /rdo mo nad kyi skabs su gtso phal zhes pa'i brda chad de ci'i dbang du gsungs pa yin/lan/ mo nad gtso bo zhes don ni bud med rnams la rgyun par mang du 'byung zhing rgyugs che ba'i nad du bzung nas bshad pa dang / mo nad phal ba zhes don ni dus rgyun par mi 'byung bar 'phral gyi rkyen nam mngal sbrum pa'i gnas skabs kho na la 'byung bas na de ltar zer/9 mo nad phal ba'i nad brgyad po gang gang yin/ de'i nang gi mtshan ma'i nad ces pa de gang 'dra zhig la go dgos/lan/ mo nad phal ba mtshan ma'i nad dang ni/ / bu ma phyin dang mgo mjug log pa dang / / rogs ma phyin dang snod lug khrag ma chod/ / nad gzhug lus dang dug thabs gyur pa brgyad/ / ces gsungs pa 'di dang /de'i nang gi mtshan ma'i nad ces pa ni mngal chags bdun phrag bzhi ba'i skabs tsam la mngal nang gi lus can der mtshan ma'i dbyibs dod pa'i dus su ma la 'khri nad 'byung ba la bya'o/ /10 sha ma'i ming gi rnam grangs la gang gang yod / sha ma zhes pa'i ming 'di' ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ bu rogs dang phru ma ni sha ma'i ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ der

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 163sha ma zer don ni/ mngal gnas lus can ma ltar du/ / gso bar nus pas sha ma bshad/ / ces stang tshang lo tsā bas gsungs pa las 'khums so/ /sa bcad bcu dgu pa/ gdon nad gso ba/1 gdon zhes pa'i go dona' ltar yin nam/lan/ gdon ni legs sbyar skad kyi gra hā zhes pa'i sgra las drangs pa'i len pa'am 'dzin pa'i don la 'jug pa dang / don dngos ni lha klu 'dre srin sogs mi ma yin gyi gnod byed des lus can rnams kyi bla tshe srog gsum phyir gdon zhing 'phrog par byed pa la go dgos/2 sems sems byung gnyis kyi mtshan nyid dang 'brel ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rig pa ni sems kyi mtshan nyid dang / rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi khyad par rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rig pa ni sems byung / sems dang sems byung gnyis ni phan tshun tha dad yin pa gang zhig la gcig med par cig shos rkyang par mngon du 'gyur nus pa ma yin te/nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin no/ /2 sems byung nga gcig nang gi rtsa nyon drug po gang gang yin/ ming de ltar btags pa'irgyu mtshan ci/

164 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ rtsa nyon drug ni 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/lta ba nyon mongs can/ the tshom bcas drug go / bsam pa'i rnam pa de dag ni rang nyid 'phung bar byed pa'i blo'i 'khyer so yin pas/ de dag gis rang gi lus ngag gi spyod pa dman par 'jug par byed pa ma zad/ de dag la brten nas nyon mongs gzhan dag ste nye nyon nyi shu sogs skyed cing sems nyog par byed pa'i rtsa ba lta bu yin pas rtsa nyon drug ces brjod pa yin/4 kun brtags gdon nad la rim gro'i cho ga gtso bor byed dgos pa'i rgya mtshan ci/lan/ gdon nad de/ yid shes sogs rang babs su mi gnas pa'i nad 'di'i rgyab rten gdon yin pas nges par du thog mar bod rang gi khyad chos dmigs bsal ldan pa'i rim gro'am gdon bcos la brten nas gdon bgegs ma bskrad na sman dpyad kyi bcos ka mi len zhing phan skyed mi 'byung bas gtso bor rim gros bcos dgos/5 gdon chen btso brgyad nang gi bla ma zhes pa de gang la go dgos/lan/ bla ma ni gza' bcu'i bye brag phur bu'i ming gi rnam grangs su lha'i bla ma zhes 'bod pa dang mtshungs shing/ lha'i bla ma'am gza' phur bus gnod pa btang ba'i nad la bla ma'i gdon zer/6 smyo byed dang brjod byed nad gnyis kyi spyi'i rgyu rkyen dang bye brag gi gso thabs gcig mtshungs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 165lan/ smyo byed dang brjed byed gnyis ni nang sems kyi rnam rtog gi rgyu dang phyi gdon gyi 'phral rkyen gyis nyes pa 'khrugs shing rnam shes rgyu ba'i bu gar zhugs nas yid lam bkag pa'i dbang gis shes pa g.yeng zhing dran shes 'chol ba bcas chos mthun pas red/7 gza' yi 'dzin dus samargu dus brgyad po gang gang yin/ dus de dag ma yin pa'i gzas zin pa'i dus yod dam/lan/ 'dzin dus tshes bzhi brgyad dang bcu gcig dang / / bco lnga bco brgyad nyi shu gnyis dang lnga/ / nyi shu dgu dang rgyu dus brgyad la 'dzin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan gnam stong ngam gnam gang la 'dzin pa'ang yod// gza' nad dang rtsa dkar nadakyi nor 'phranga' ltar bsal dgos/lan/ gza' nad dang rtsa dkar gyi nad gnyis la kha mig yon por 'gyur ba dang kha lkugs pa/ yan lag zha rengs 'khums pa bcas mtshungs kyang zhib tu brtags na mi nor te/ gza' nad phal cher mi dar ma dang rgan pa'i gras la glo bur du 'byung zhing phog pa'i dus la rag las/ rtsa dkar ni rgyu rkyen drag shul 'grams pa'am rims tshad rtsar babs pa bcas las rlung 'khrugs te/ klad pa las gyes pa'i chu rtsa spyi dang sgos su chu rtsa drug la nad 'gyur byung ba yin pas mgo dang byang khog yan lag gang la babs na de bzhin du nad rtags ston pa dang / dus la nges pa med cing nad stobs gza' nad

166 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/las tshabs chung /rdzo gza' nad dam gza' grib/ grib skyon zhes pa 'di nad gang zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ gza' nad dam gza' grib ces pa don dam par rā hu la sogs gza'abargyad kyi rkyen la brten nas byung ba'i klad skyon gyi nad la ngos 'dzin dgos/10 me gza' dang chu gza' gnyis0khyad par ci/lan/ rgyud las/ khyad par brtag pa me gza' chu gza' gnyis/ / me gza' gzhogs g.yas la phog lce g.yas thung / / tsha ba che zhing sen mo gzhob rog 'ong / / chu gza' g.yon la phog cing lce g.yon thung / / lus kun drod dang bral zhing chu rgyus gyong / / zhes pa las gsal/22 klu gdon zhes pa de don dngos thog tu nad gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ nad 'di lus la gnas pa'i chu ser rang gi ldang tshad las mang du 'phel nas dug can gyi gnyan srin pan ta dang bsdongs te/ lus kyi sha lpags rtsa rus don snod bcas chu ser gyis bsrul nas mi bzod cing gso dka' ba'i 'gos nad gdug pa can mdze nad la ngos 'dzin dgos/12 mdze nad kyi skabs su mkhar brgyad rtse nas bcom pa zhes pa'i don ci yin/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 167lan/ mkhar brgyad de spyi gtsug dang / smin dbrag sna rtse/ ya rkan/snying ga nye ba/ mtshan ma/ rkang mthil rnams su sha ro chags pa'i don yin/12 mdze nad kyi rtags su sru gsum byi dang mdangs gsum yal zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ spu gsum byi zhes pa ni mdze nad lus la rgyas nas skra dang smin ma ba spu gsum byi ba dang / mdangs gsum yal ba ni mig mdangs yal te gzi dang 'dra ba/ byad mdangs yal te glo ba dang 'dra ba/ so mdangs yal te dung dang 'dra bar gyur pa'i don/14 mdze nad bcos skabs bstan pa'i ril bu'i sbyor ba gtso bo de gang yin nam/lan/ bya khyung rnam pa lnga'i ril bu cho ga bzhin legs par sbyar ba de'o/ /sa bcad nyi shu pa/ mchon rma gso ba/1 rma yi ngo bo dang nges chig gang yin nam/lan/ 'dzag pa dri nga tshor ba sdug bsngal bcas/ / lus las 'phral du nyams shing rma ba la/ / pags pa sha gdan ral phyir rma zhes bya/ / zhes so/ /2 za spyi gso thabs0 rtsa dona' ltar yin nam/

168 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ thog mar skrangs pa gzhom pa dang / bar du red pa sbyang ba/ tha mar sha 'u gso bar bya/ de la zas dang spyod lam 'phrod pa bston zhing mi 'phrod pa spang ba ni dang po bar tha kun tu shes dgos/2 ci 'dra zhig la rma red zer/lan/ rma la bla gnyan gyi nad gzhan snon ma byung ba la bya'o/ /4 'jib 'dul gyi lag lena' ltar yin nam/lan/ cu gang dang sho mang sogs rma la phan zhing nus pa bsil ba'i sman rnams spangs pa'i steng byug pa dang / bran pa/ bdug pa bcas byas nas rma'i nang gi chu ser 'jibs shing skrangs pa 'dul bar byed/5 klo burarkyen gyi rma la rigs kyis dbye na du yod/ de dag gi go don ji ltarayin nam/lan/ rigs kyis dbye na bshus gshags bcad pa dang / / rnam par bcad dang rab tu 'phyang ba dang / / lhung dang grums dang phug pa brgyad yin no/ / zhes pa ltar dang / bshus pa ni pags pa tsam bshus pa dang /mtshon gyis sha gang gyen thur du gshags pa/ sha 'phred la bcad pa/ rus la thug pa'i bar rnam par bcad pa/ sha dang rus pa'ang bcad nas thur du lhab lhub tu 'phyang ba/ sha rus gnyis ka rbad kyis bcad nas sa la lhung ba/ rus pa rgya cher bsnad pas grums pa'am chag pa/ mtshon gyi rtse mos thad kur phug pa bcas la bya/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 1696 mgo'i gnas lugs las mgo dbyibs klad pa dang sbyar tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung mgo spyi ring sha klad de/ / mkhris mgo ltag 'bur mar klad do/ / bad kun sog ka bung tshang klad/ / rlung mkhris gru bzhi phrum klad yin/ / bad mkhris zlum po zho klad dang / / bad rlung 'phred nyal 'o klad yin/ / 'dus pa spyi leb chu klad do/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ /7 mgo yi sha gnad lnga bo gang gang yin/lan/ bzhag sgor 'khyil 'dra spyi gtsug sha dang / nya ldang gshibs 'dra ltag pa'i sha gzhu shul btang 'dra mtshogs ma'i sha lug mkhal brtsegs 'dra mur gong gnyis bcas lnga'o/ // gsum 'gyur ske bcos pa'i rtsa don ci/lan/ ske rma bcos thabs mdor hril gyis dril na rus pa mgo yi tshul du bcos pa dang / rtsa gnyan gang bsnad byang khog gi tshul du bcos rgyu/ sha dang chu rgyus gang bsnad yan lag gi tshul du bcos dgos/9 byangakhog la mchon phog na nang du rdol ba'i rtags dgu bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ nang brtol smrar bcug skad kyi mjug chad cing / / 'gro ba'i stangs zhan khong lci dbugs mi bde/ / glo sor langs pas gang rgyab phyogs su 'khyog / kha zas mi 'dod zug che skra mtshams rngul/ / de dgu tshang na nang

170 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/du brtol ba yin/ / zhes rgyud las gsungs/10 byang khog gi rma'i skabs bstan pa'i khrag gzer dang rtsa gzer don gzer gsum dpyadakyi gnyen po gang dang gang gis btsos dgos/lan/ khrag gzer la dugs dang / rtsa gzer la me btsa'/ don gzer la gtar gyis bcos dgos/11 rgyu mar bug pa du yod zhag re thub cus pa'i go don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dus skabs de dang de lta bu la rgyu mar mtshon gyis phug pa'i bu ga du yod kyang zhag re ste zhag gcig ma gtogs tshe gnas mi thub par 'chi ba'i don no/ /12 byang khog rma gso ba'i le'ur bstan pa'i 'chi ba'i bya gtong gsum zhes pa de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ mig mdangs nyams shing 'dzum dka' gyen du zlog(rtsa'i bya gtong)/ kha sna'i dbugs grang gdong la bag rngul chags(rlung gi bya gtong)/ / lus kyi stobs shor stan la 'byar ba na (zungs kyi bya gtong)/ / 'chi ba'i bya gtong gsum na 'chi bar nges/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /12 byang khog gi rma gso skabs nyes byed dus dang sbyar nas bcos thabs0 rtsa dona' ltar yin nam/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 171lan/ nyes byed dus kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni/ / dang po zhag bdun zhugs pa khrag gi dus/ / bram ze lta bur gtsang sbra'i sgo nas bcos/ / bar du zhag bdun rgyas pa chu ser dus/ / dge slong lta bur spyod lam zhib sor bcos/ / tha ma zhag bdun smin pa rnag gi dus/ / rgyal po lta bur zas kyis bcos pa 'o/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /14 byangasag smadakyi bcos thabs rnam dgu bo ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ spyi la bcos don rnam pa dgu yin te/ / zas kyis gzhi bzung dugs kyis gzer ba bcag / chas kyis drod bskyed 'dren gyis 'gags pa bsal/ / sman gyis don snod tsha ba bsad pa dang / /gtar gyis ngan khrag rtsa ru dbyung ba dang / / bshal gyis mkhris tshad 'or du bsgyur ba dang / / me yis rtsa 'phrang bsdam zhing spos pa gzhil/ / rnag khrag babs pa gsang du gdon par bya/ / zhes so/ /15 sha yi gnad dang rtsa'i gnad/ migs gi gnad rnams gnyen po gang dang gang gis bcos dgos/lan/ sha yi gnad la 'jib dang zhun dang nan sogs kyis bcos nas khros pa 'dul ba dang / rtsa'i gnad la me btsa' dang gtar ga dang sman gsum gyis gtso cher bcos nas nad kyi dngos rgyu gzhom pa dang / tshigs kyi gnad la deb dang chings dang phyogs gsum gyis gtso cher bcos nas rang sor gzhug dgos/

172 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/16 deb chings gnyis la nang gses su dbye na du yod/lan/ zhun nan gyi stong du tsho 'dzin btang ba'i deb la lpags deb rtswa deb spu deb shog deb shing deb bying deb bcas rnam pa drug dang / rma kha dkri byed kyi chings la chag chings gson chings 'ded chings 'dar chas chings sdom chings bcas lnga yod/17 skyogs rigs gsum po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ sgom phyogs tshem bu yod med dang / sba smyogs dra ba can phyi nang gnyis/ 'phrul skyogs bsil ma bcas gsum mo/ /1〈 sgrogs khra byi ze gsum po'i spyod yul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tshigs la bskur ba phyogs dang / rkang la bskur ba khra/ gnas ma nges pa la bskur ba byi ze'o/ /19 rnag gnas dmigs gsum zhes pa de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rnag gi gnas gsum ni glo sbubs dang / glo ba'i tshang tshing /dbye gsang bcas lags/20 rnag gsange du babs yod med bem tol brgyab nas sgra la brtag tshul ltar yin/lan/ bem tol gyis brtag thabs ni sor mos dogs pa yod sa kun la snyoms par bdeg ste sgra skad la legs par brtag par bya/ de yang g.yas g.yon dang / mdun rgyab/ stod smad kun 'dra bar snang min bstun la/

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 173stong skad byung na rnag dang chu ser sogs med cing / gcod skadabyung na chu ser yod pa dang / 'dar skad byung na rnag tu smin pa yin no/ /21 rkang lag sogs0 chigs shor na rtags ci 'dra 'byung ngam/lan/ shor rtags zug gzer cung zad tsam la ldang / / sod du skrangs shing brkyang bskum bya ba nyams/ / gang shor 'bur kyong ring thung 'byung ba yin/ / zhes so/ /22 chigs shor gzhug pa'i rtsa don ci yin nam/lan/ gzhug thabs ma spangs gsar dus mod la gzhug / rnyings nas lums kyis sha chu btul la gzhug / gang yang tshigs kha bral bar drag tu 'then/ / shor ngos dus pa'i mgo nas nang du 'phul/ / tshigs kha bral nas gang shor ngos su bkan/ / zhes man rgyud las gsungs pa 'di'o/ /22 yan lag gi chigs 'chor tshud pa'irtagasaji ltar yin nam/lan/ sgra 'byung 'bur po nub dang brkyang bskum btub/ / zug gzer bri na gnas su tshud pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /24 dus pa'i chag lugs bzhi bo dang chagartags gang yin/lan/ rgyud chen las/ chag lugs ma la bu thogs chag pa dang / / smyu gu kha dang sdum chag grums pa bzhi/ / de yang rma can rma med gnyis su 'dus/ / chag rtags grang zhing 'khrog la 'gul mi nus/ / zhes so/ /

174 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/sa bcad nyer gcig pa/ dug nad gso ba/1 dug gi nges chig ci yin/lan/ rje zur mkhar bas/ dug ces pa 'jug sgo mang yang skabs 'dir mi'i lus khams la gnod pa'i yul dus zas spyod spyi dang / khyad par du mi'i khong du song na lus srog la gnod pa'i rdzas yongs kyi spyi ming ngo /zhes pa 'di ltar yin/2 dug nad bskur ba'i rta lnga dang dar sa'i yul rigs bzhi zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ bskur ba'i rta lnga la rgyud las/ mthong ba nyi ma'i zer la bskur ba dang / / du ba rlung gi rdzi la bskur ba dang / / 'goms pa sa yi rlangs la bskur ba dang / / reg pa snum gyi rta la bskur ba dang / / khong par zas la bskur ba rnam lnga 'o/ / zhes dang / yul rigs bzhi ni rgya gar dang / rgya nagadol po/ mon bcas bzhi'o/ /2 sakyis dbye ba'i dug rigs drug po tsha sbyor dang grang sgror gnyis su' ltar phye dgos/ ci'i phyir/lan/ rin po che'i sbyor ba dang rdo sbyor/ sha sbyor/ rtsi sbyor/ dngos la sbyor ba/ sngo sbyor bcas rdzas sbyor drug po mdor bsdus na tsha sbyor dang grang sbyor gnyis su 'dus par 'gyur te gang zhe na/ rin po che dang rdo la sbyar ba ni

rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang nad thog lag len gyi skor/ 175tsha ba mi srid grang bar 'gyur ba dang / sha dang rtsi dang sngo sogs la sbyor ba byas pa dang / ha las gtso byas par sbyar ba ni grang bar mi srid cing tsha sbyor gyi dug tu 'gyur bas so/ /4 tsha ba byu'i skabs rigs kyis dbye na 'grams 'khrugs rims dug bzhi zhes dug nad tsha ba yin par gsungs pa dang / dug nad kyi skabs su tsha grang gnyis su dbye bas snga phyi mi 'gal lam/lan/ mi 'gal te/ tsha ba spyi'i skabs su tsha ba'i khongs su bzhag pa ni rags pa'i dbang du gsungs pa yin la/ dug nad kyi skabs su tsha grang gnyis su phyes pa ni phra zhib tu dbye ba yin/5 sbyar dug sdud bsadakyi dpe don de' ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ de yis 'dus nas gnyen po'i sman gyis bsad/ / ma 'dus bsad pa ri dwags thang 'ded 'dra/ / byer ba mi gsod bcosadaka' yun du sbyong / / 'dus na me steng chu bzhin choms pa skyen/ /zhes pa 'di'o/ / 6 dug gi nad gzhi phal mo che sdud bsad ma byas par gtar ga dang me btsa' bshal skyugs sogs byed mi rung ba'i mtshan ci/lan/ dug rigs gang yin yang gnyen po'i sman gyis ma sod par gtar dang me btsa' bshal skyugs sogs sdun la byas na gtar gas nad byer 'gro ba dang / me btsas lus ston la mnan nas btson du 'dzin zhing /

176 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bshal skyugs kyis nad slong ba'i phyir de 'dra dus kun tu spang dgos/7 dug yin pa nges pa'ikhyad par gyi na lugs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud chen las/ khyad par rtsa dang chu gnyis brtag mi thub/ /sna tshogs nad sna mang zhing 'gyur ldog che/ / zos kyang mi phan sha 'bros lus stobs 'chor/ / pho mchin mi bde cham 'debs snying mi dga'/ / don med na zhing byas med dar re drag / de bdun ldan na nges par gdon mi za/ /ces so/ // kha zas kyi rigs rnams ji ltar byas nas dug tu 'gyur ba yin/lan/ bshad rgyud kha zas bsdam pa'i le'ur gsungs pa'i mi 'phrod pa'i zas rnams snga ma ma zhu bar phyi ma zos pa dang lhan cig tu bsres nas zas pa bcas las phan tshun mi 'phrod par nus pa 'thab nas nyes pa 'khrugs par 'gyur ba dang / yang na mi 'phrod pa'i kha zas ma yin yang ma goms pa dang 'ju dka' ba'i zas rigs bab col du bsten pa/ dus min du za ba bcas las ma zhu bar dwangs snyigs 'dres te rtsa mig kun tu byer nas lus zungs bdun po rim gyis 'grib par byed pa yin/rdzo gang 'dra zhig la ba dang mi ba'i dug zer/lan/ khyi smyon dang dug sbrul lta bu dug ldan srog chags kyi mtshe bas rmugs pa las byung ba'i dug rigs la rgyu ba'i dug dang / btsan dug dang bse shing lta bu sems med kyi rigs khong du song ba'am lus la reg pa'i tshe

dug yod pa'i rdzas spyi la mi rgyu ba'i dug zer/1༷ sbrul dug lus la mched pa myur ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ sbrul gyi dug gis khrag dag la/ / ma brten lus la gnod mi byed/ / khrag ni cung zad la brten yang / / til mar thigs pa bzhin du mched/ / ces pa las 'khums so/ / / /

178le'u gsum la/ min gyi skor/sa bcad dang po/ spyor ba sman/1 a ru rnam parargyal ba sman gyi la por 'jog don ci yin nam/lan/ a ru rnam rgyal la ro drug dang / zhu rjes gsum/ nus pa brgyad/yon tan bcu bdun bcas yongs su tshang zhing / nad rigs thams cad sel zhing shin tu dkon pa yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yin pas sman gyi rgyal por bzhag pa yin/ /2 a ru ra dang brag zhun gnyis 'du ba byu snyoms kyi sman la 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ a ru ra ni rgyu 'byung ba'i rang bzhin cha snyoms pa las byung bas na ro drug nus pa brgyad zhu rjes gsum yon tan bcu bdun ldan pa dang /brag zhun la 'byung ba'i bcud khams lnga dang ldan pas de gnyis kyis nyes pa 'phel pa 'bri ba dang / 'grib pa gso ba/ 'khrugs pa sdeb thub pas 'du ba spyi snyoms kyi sman du bzhag pa yin/

sman gyi skor/ 1792 man gyi ro yod do tsog grangs drug tu nges pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ sman gyi ro ni rgyu'am rten 'byung ba bzhi bo gnyis gnyis shas che ldan pa las byung bas na drug las mi mang mi nyung bas 'bras bu ro drug tu grangs nges so/ /4 sman gyi nus pa dang stobs dang yon tan bcas ni bsal bya nad kyi sbyi bye brag gang la bltas nas gsungs payin nam/lan/ nad nyes pa gsum du gnas pa la 'joms byed kyi gnyen po nus pa brgyad kyi 'gro ldog bstan pa dang / nad tsha grang gnyis su 'dus pa la 'joms byed kyi gnyen po tsha ba dang bsil ba'i stobs gnyis su bstan/ nyes gsum gyi mtshan nyid nyi shu la 'joms byed kyi gnyen po yon tan bcu bdun du bstan pa yin no/ /5 ro sbyor dang nus sbyor gnyis0 dgos pa khyad par can de gang yin nam/lan/ ro sbyor ni 'phel zad bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por sbyar ba dang /nus sbyor ni nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por sbyar ba yin no/ /6 sman gyi nus pa brgyad dang yon tan bcu bdun bar gyi 'brel ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ khyad gzhi nus pa brgyad las khyad chos yon tan bcu bdun byung bas na/ nus pa dang yon tan gyi bar du khyad gzhi dang khyad chos dbar gyi

180 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'brel ba grub/7 mnangs kyi sbyar thabs gsum las ches dbang btsan shos ni gang yin/ ci'i phyir/lan/ rgyud las/ sman gyi nus pa ro nus ngo bo gnyis/ / spyi dang bye brag ces su bshad pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pas na ro sdebs dang / nus sdebs/ zhu rjes sdebs pa gsum las ches dbang btsan shos ni nus sdebs yin te/ ro'i nus pa ni spyi'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa dang / ngo bo'i nus pa ni bye brag gi dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa rgyud rang gi dgongs don yin pa'i phyir/ spyi las bye brag dbang btsan zhing stobs che bas ro'i nus pa de zhu rjes kyi nus pas zil gyis gnon pa dang / zhu rjes kyi nus pa de ngo bo'i nus pas zil gyis gnon pa ste/ mthar thug ngo bo'i nus pa de nyid dbang btsan shos su brtsi dgos// shel phreng du bstan pa'i man rdzas kyi ngo bo'i nus pa brgyad po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ de'u dmar ba'i shel phrel du bstan pa'i nus pa brgyad ni stobs kyi nus pa dang / kha dog gi nus pa/ rigs mthun gyi nus pa/ gnyen po'i nus pa/ dri'i nus pa/ dbyibs kyi nus pa/ rten 'brel gyi nus pa/ smon lam gyi nus pa bcas lags/kha ro drug po'i go rim de bzhin du bsgrigs pa'irgyu mtshan ci/

sman gyi skor/ 181lan/ ro mngar ba nas bska ba'i bar go rim de bzhin du bsgrigs pa'i dgos pa ni/ bsgrub bya srog gi rten lus kyi zungs rnams 'phel zhing 'tsho bar byed pa la bltas nas sgrub byed kyi ro'am sman yang lus srog 'tsho bar byed pa'i stobs gang che ba rnams sdun la bzhag ste/ phyi ma phyi ma rnams rim pa bzhin du stobs je chung je chung du 'gro ba yin pas go rim de ltar du bsgrigs pa yin no/ /10 ci 'dra zhig la zhurjes zer/lan/ ro drug tu gtogs pa'i rdzas gang zhig khong du bsten pa rnams pho ba'i me drod rnam gsum gyis myag bzhu dwangs snyigs legs par phye nas bzhus zin pa'i rjes khyad par smin zhing gzhan du gyur pa'i gnas skabs de la zhu rjes zer/11 yan lag brgyad pa dnga'agrel ba zla zer rnams su zhu rjes gsum rnamangar skyur tsha ba gsum du brjod cing / bshad rgyad lus kyi mtshan nyid skabs su yang don du mngar skyur tsha ba gsum 'byung rigs mod/ kha bar gyur ces gsungs don ci yin nam/ lan/ bshad rgyud lus kyi mtshan nyid skabs zas sman rnams thog mar sa chu'i rang bzhin can bad kun myag byed kyis myag par byas nas sa chu las ro mngar ba wu ba can gyur cing des bad gan skyed par byed/ bar du wu ba can de mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi drod kyis bzhus pas me'i nus pa rnam par tsha

182 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bsaskyar bar gyur cing des mkhris pa'i stobs skyed par byed la/ 'ju byed kyis legs par bzhus tshar rjes tha mar me dang mnyam pa'i rlung gis dwangs snyigs phye zhing rgyu me rlung shas che bas tsha bar 'gyur rigs mod/ tsha bas rlung mi skye zhing kha bas rlung skyed pas rgyu'i dbang du ma byas par 'bras bu'i skabs la dgongs nas kha ba bzhag pa yin/12 lus kyi mtshan nyid skabs kyi zhu rjes gsum dang sbyor ba sman du bstan pa'i zhu sa gsum dbar gyi 'brel ba' ltar yin nam/lan/ lus kyi mtshan nyid skabs bstan pa'i zhu rjes gsum ni pho ba'i me drod rnam gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs nas byung bas na spyir btang pho ba'i me drod dang sbyar ba dang / der gnas skabs kyi zhu rjes zhes brjod chog sbyor ba sman du bstan pa'i zhu rjes gsum ni ro'i rjes su 'brang phyir bye brag ro'i khams gtso bor sbyar ba yin la/ de ni mthar thug gi zhu rjes yin/ des na de gnyis kyi bar du spyi dang bye brag tu 'brel/12 bzhu ba dang mi bzhu zhes pa'i khyad par gtso bo ci yin nam/lan/ bzhu ba'i khams ni rin po che'i rigs mer bsregs pa'i tshe bzhu thub pa gser dngul lta bu dang / mi bzhu ba'i khams zhes pa ni rin po che'i rigs mer bsregs pa'i tshe mi 'ju ba g.yu dang byu ru lta bu la bya/14 rtsi sman dang thang sman zhes pa la go ba' ltar len dgos/lan/ rtsi sman ni nad 'joms shing lus zungs gso ba'i rtsi bcud dang

sman gyi skor/ 183ldan pa'i sman rigs la bya ste de'u dmar bas/ rtsi sman nad 'joms zungs gso ba'i/ / dbang ril brag zhun lta bu'i ming / / zhes pa ltar dang / thang sman ni rdza ri g.ya' gangs lta bu mtho sar skyes pa ma yin par thang du skye ba'i ldum bu'i sman rigs la bya/12 rtsi sman la 'byung khungs kyi sgo nas dbye na rigs du yod/ gang gang yin/lan/ ga bur lta bu shing las byung ba'i rtsi sman dang / gla rtsi lta bu srog chags las byung ba'i rtsi sman/ gur kum lta bu sngo las byung ba'i rtsi sman bcas gsum du bshad kyang brag zhun lta bu rdo las byung ba'ang yod/16 rtsargyudakyi skabs su a ru ra la ro drug ldan par gsungs pa dang /bshadargyud du a ru lan tshwa ma gtogs ro lnga ldan zhes ro lnga ldan par gsungs pas de gnyis phan tshun mi 'gal lam/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mi 'gal zhing / de gnyis la dngos shugs kyi khyad par yod de/bdud rtsi snying po las/ rtsa rtse gnyis la kha zhing tsha/ / mngar ba dbus la bska ba rus/ / skyur ba phyi shun dag las 'byung / / lan tshwa de dag shugs las 'byung / / zhes gsungs pas so/ /17 rdo sbyor la po sde bzhi ni gang dag yin/lan/ rdo rigs kyi sman sbyor rgyal po lta bu gtso bor gyur pa'i mdung rtse dang / sbal rgyab/ gangs thigs/ cong zhi bzhi'o/ /

184 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/18 khab len3gas bzhi bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ 'gugs byed dang / gcod byed/ 'jigs byed/ skor byed bcas bzhi'o/ /19 ga dor gsum zhes pa gang dang gang yin/lan/ spyir gwa dor zhes pa ni ri dwags sha ba sogs kyi rwa skyes nas 'bur tsam thon pa la bya zhing / gwa dor gsum ni bse ru'i rwa dang / kha sha'i rwa/ sha ba'i rwa gsum gong ltar skyes pa la go dgos/ rwa gsum zhes pa'ang ri dwags 'di gsum gyi rwa la zer/20 shing mchog gsum po gang gang yin nam/lan/ tsan dan dkar po dang / tsan dan dmar po/ a ga ru gsum la bya'o/ /21 dri ldan gnyis dang dri ldan gsum zhes pa sman dzis gang dag la go dgos/lan/ dri ldan gnyis ni shing kun dang shu dag gnyis la go dgos shing /dri ldan gsum ni gong gnyis kyi steng du gla rtsi bsnan pa la bya/22 dri bzang bzhi ni gang gang yin/lan/ 'di la shing tsha dang sug smel gca bha dra ge sar bcas bzhi la go ba zhig dang / yang na ka ko la dang shing tsha sug smel ge sar bcas bzhi la 'dod pa yod pas skabs thob tu go dgos/

sman gyi skor/ 18522 nag po gsum ni gang gang yin/lan/ nag po gsum ni gu gul dang / gla rtsi/ shu dag gsum gyi ming yin/24 ga bur dkar po dang ga bur nag po/ ga bur smug po/ ga bur sngon po rnams sman gang dang gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ ga bur dkar po zhes pa ni ga bur dngos dang / ga bur nag po ni byed las dang mdog la bltas nas btags pa'i phag brun nus bsregs byas pa'i thal ba'i gab ming / ga bur smug po ni byed las dang mdog la bltas nas btags pa'i gla rtsi'i ming / ga bur sngon po ni byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa'i g.ya' kyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs shig go /25 mi rgod lta bur gcig ngu rkyang rgyug gi ga bur sbyor ba la cu gang chur srungs nas grogs su bsdebs dgos don ci yin nam/lan/ 'di'i thad la dharma su mis/ sman gyi rgyal po ga bur de/ / cu gang blon gyis ma bsgyur na/ / nus pa rtsub pas tshad par ldog / ces gsungs pa ltar ga bur gyi nus pa rtsub pa'i cha de 'joms pa'i ched yin/26 gi waṃ la go don ci 'dra yod/lan/ gi waṃ ni rgya nag skad kyi snyi'u dbang zhes pa zur chag pa ste/ bod skad du bsgyur na snyi'u ba lang dang / dbang bcud la 'jug pas ba lang bcud ces pa'i don no/ /

186 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/27 chu sman rnon po gsum gang dang gang yin/lan/ de ni rgya tshwa dang / gser bye/ sdig srin bcas gsum gyi bsdus ming yin/2/ me med du ba rnam gsum po gang gang yin/lan/ 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa'i sa rdzi ka dang / nya lcibs/ pha ba dgo dgo gsum gyi ming yin/29 'bugs byed gsum zhes pa gang gang yin/lan/ rgya tshwa dang / tsha la/ ze tshwa gsum gyi bsdus ming ngo / /20 chu ser sman brgyad gang gang yin/lan/ spos dkar/ thal ka rdo rje/ so ma ra dzā bcas chu ser sman gsum gyi steng du seng ldeng dang / til dkar nag zi ra dkar nag bsnan pa'i sman sna brgyad po la bya/21 bsil gsum nang gi drod gcig dang drod gsum nang gi bsil gcig ces pa de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ bsil gsum nang gi drod gcig ni li shi dang / drod gsum nang gi bsil gcig ni sug smel yin/22 drod0 rgyal po bzhi ni gang gang yin/lan/ pho ba'i nad kyi kha 'dzin se 'bru dang / shing tsha/ pho ba ris/ kha ru tsha bcas bzhi'o/ /

sman gyi skor/ 18722 srog chags rtsi yi rgyal po gnyis zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ de gnyis ni nad rnams 'joms par mchog tu mnga' zhing srog chags las byung la nus pa bdud rtsi dang mtshungs pa'i gi waṃ dang gla rtsi gnyis yin/24 sbyong byed gsum zhes pa ni mnajos gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ sngon bu dang / khrin bu/ thar nu bcas sbyong sman gsum la bya/25 ka rañja dang khri la wa ri/ shrīkaṇ+ḍa bcas smanangs gang dang gang la go dgos/lan/ ka rañja ni 'jam 'bras dang / khyi la wa ri ni seng ldeng gi khaṇ+ḍa/shrī khaṇ+ḍa ni bse shing dkar po'i zhun la go dgos/26 a za mo/ skya bzang / sge gsher/ bai ṣa/ zhim shing / gar+bha tsaṇ+ḍa li zhes pa rnams sman gang gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ a za mo ni dbyi mong gi ming dang / skra bzang ni par pa ta/ sge gsher ni sman sga rlon pa'i ming / bi ṣa ni btsan dug zhim shing ni lcam rtsa/gar+bha tsaṇ+ḍa li ni 'ol mo se'i ming ngo / /27 gur kum kha che'i yul du bzang zhes pa ltar bzang po drug gi 'byung yul de dag gang dang gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ bzang po drug gi 'byung yul la dpal spungs pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'grel las/ cu gang bre ta pu rir bzang / / gur kum kha che'i yul du

188 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bzang / / li shi li yi yul du bzang / / dzā ti srin po'i yul du bzang / /sug smel rgya mtsho'i gling na bzang / / ka ko la rdo rgod yul du bzang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / cu gang gi 'byung yul dngos ni bre ta pu ri ste deng sang gi mnga' ri'i yul yin la/ gur kum gyi 'byung yul ni legs sbyar skad du kusmi ra(76sko7)dang / bod skad du kha che yul te/ yul gyi ming me tog la btags nas kha che'i gur kum zer/ kha che zhes pa ni yul de'i mi rigs kyi kha shin tu che bas kha la bltas nas btags par bshad/ li shi'i 'byung yul ni li yi yul te deng sang shin cang du 'bod pa de yin/ dzā ti'i 'byung yul ni srinapo'i yul te deng sang si ri lan kha(mo༅༅rdo)zer ba de yin/ sug smel gyi 'byung yul la rgya mtsho'i gling zhes pa 'di mtha' gcig tu ma nges par yul 'di dang de zer rgyu shin tu dka' mod/ mdor na rgya mtsho'i pha rol gyi rlan shas dang tsha ba che ba'i yul la ngos bzung na legs snyam/ ka ko la'i 'byung yul rdo rgod yul ni rgya gar gyi yul gru zhig yin par bshad/2rdo gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na bong nga nag po'i ming gi rnam grangs la gang dag yod/lan/ bong nag la da dung 'dzin pa dang sman chen/ bdud rtsi lo ma sogs zer/ 'dzin pa ni byed las la bltas nas btags pa ste/ srog gi cha shas kun bong nga'i sman nad kyis 'dzin zhing bsdams pa ltar byed pas na 'dzin pa zhes btags/ gzhan bong nga nag po'i rtsa ba la sman chen dang / kha

sman gyi skor/ 189'bus nas sor bzhi tsam yod pa la 'dzin pa'am bdud rtsi lo ma zer/29 zang rtsis bdakan gyi nad dang skyu ru ras khrag mkhris kyi nad sel ba'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ sbrang rtsi dang skyu ru ra gnyis ro'i dbang du byas na sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar bas bad kun skyed pa dang / skyu ru ra'i ro skyur bas khrag mkhris kyi nad skyed nges mod/ 'dir sman sna de gnyis kyis ro las go ldog nus pa'i las byed pa ste/ sbrang rtsi'i ngo bo'i nas pa dro la rtsub pas bad kun gyi nad sel ba dang / skyu ru ra'i ngo bo'i nus pa bsil bas khras mkhris kyi nad sel pa yin/40 skye dngos smanangs kyi pho mo ma ning gardo bo gang la bltas nas dbye ba 'byed dgos/lan/ skye dngos gang zhig la me tog dang / 'bras bu/ gang bu yod med bcas ni pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba 'byed sa'i gzhi gtso bo yin zhing / da dung sman rdzas kyi skye gnas dang skye dbyibs/ lo 'dab/ ring thung / kha dogasra snyi/ che chung bcas las khyad par 'byed dgos/41 sngo yi tsha ba gsum dang sngo yi bsil gsum po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ sngo yi tsha ba gsum ni lce tsha dbyi mong srub ka gsum dang / sngo yi bsil gsum ni dug mo nyung hong len bong nga dkar po gsum/42 sngo yi bu mo spyan bdun po gang gang yin/

190 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ de ni sngon gyi gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas btags pa'i g.ya' kyi dang / stong zil/ gaṅgā chung / hong len/ tig ta/ bong dkar/ spang rtsi bcas bdun gyi bsdus ming yin/42 rdzo man ba'i 'dul thabasa' ltar yin nam/lan/ sngo sman gyi rigs gang btus pa de gnas de'i chus gtsang mar bkrus rjes chom brdungs byas nas rma phab ste bsil sman grib lhags dang drod sman nyi mar bskams nas skam gsed legs par byas pas grub/44 ko byi la'i dug 'don tshula' ltar yin/ sman 'di dug 'don mi dgos pa'i skabs yod dmamed/lan/ ko byi la la ldum stag kyang zer la dug 'don tshul ni ko byi la lcags slang nang du ser tsam brngos nas phyi'i spu 'brad pa dang / yang na mdzo mo'i 'o ma'i nang btsos nas 'o ma phyed tsam lus tshe phyungs nas skam na grub/sman 'di btang yul khyad par gyi dbang gis khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad dang / tsha ba gzer thung / tsha srin bcas la dug 'don mi dgos par spu dang bcas pa gtong chog45 rgyun mthong gi rwa rigs 'dul thabs gnyis po gang dang gang yin/lan/ thal tshan gyi nang du rtsi hrog bsregs pa dang / har bsregs byed pa gnyis so/ /

sman gyi skor/ 19146 mnarta rigs gnyis po gang dang gang yin/lan/ sman nus rtsa la myur du 'khrid par byed pa'i rta dang / sman khong du 'phul bar byed pa'i rta gnyis te/ snga ma ni rlung la bu ram dang / khrag dang mkhris pa la ka ra/ bad kun dang chu ser la sbrang rtsi bcas gsum dang / phyi ma nirlung la gar chang dang / mkhris par gangs chu'am chu skol grang mo/ bad gan la chu skol tshan mo bcas so/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ zhi byed sman sbyor/1 bang smyor gyi skabs su mgo thang gsum pa thog mar gsungs pa dang de'i rjes su mig nad sel byedakri sman gsungs pa'irgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mgo ni lus kyi dang po yin pa ma zad yan lag lnga'i nang nas gces pa'am gtso bo/ rtsa dkar gyi rten bcas yin pas gnad che bar dgongs nas sman bcos kyang thog mar mgo sman nas 'go tshugs pa dang / de nas mig nad sel byed kyi sman bstan don ni mig dbang bo lnga'i gtso bo yin pas so/ /2 'bras gsum chig thang gi nus pa ci yin nam/lan/ a ru'i chig thang pho ba'i mkhris pa sel/ / skyu ru'i chig bang khrag ngan 'byed cing skem/ / ba ru'i chig thang chu ser nag po skem/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/

192 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/2 nor bu bdun bang ni gang gnyis bsres pa yin nam/lan/ 'bras bu gsum thang dang ma nu bzhi thang bsres na nor bu bdun thang yin/4 cha mnyam bzhi thang gi ming gzhan la ci zer/lan/ rgyam tsha bca' sga a ru ra pi pi ling bcas bzhi bo cha mnyam par sbyar ba'i cha mnyam bzhi thang la rgyam tsha bzhi thang yang zer/5 in+d+ra bzhi bang gi sman sna bzhi bo gang gang yin/ de'i nus pa ci yin nam/rme lan/ rgyud las/ dug nyung bong nga ga dur ba le ga'i/ / thang gis rgyu long snod tshad ma lus sel/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ /6 sre long sog yu gzhug chung ste rus bcud gsum la rus pa'i bcud rnamasa' ltar 'dus yod/lan/ sre long la lus smad kyi rus bcud 'dus pa dang / sog yu la lus stod kyi rus bcud/ gzhug chung la byang khog gi bcud 'dus yod/gzhan du'ang / sre long la yan lag kun gyi bcud 'dus pa dang / sog yu la stod dus kun gyi bcud 'dus/ gzhug chung la smad rus kun gyi bcud 'dus pa'i bshad tshul yang mchis/7 thang sbyor sbyar thabs kyi lag len dang bsten thabs ji ltar yin nam/

sman gyi skor/ 193lan/ rtsa bar/ de sogs khu ba'i sde tshan sbyar ba'i thabs/ / grang thang khu ba thon pa sbang ba gces/ / bsdus thang kun la khu ba sum gnyis bsdu/ / tsha sel grang btang grang sel tsha mor btang / / tsha grang 'dres pa'i nad la dro 'jam bsten/ / zhes so/ // rgyan du spyod pa'i phye ma'i ming gi rnam grangs la gang gang yod/ de dag yul gang dang gang gi skadayin/lan/ tres sam dang cur nis ni rgyun du bkol ba'i phye ma'i ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ de gnyis yul gang gi skad yin pa'i skor la bzhed tshul cung mi 'dra ste/ kha cig gis de gnyi ga zhang zhung gi skad yin par bshad pa dang /la las cur nis ni legs sbyar gyi skad dang / tres sam ni zhang zhung gi skad yin par bshad/9 blon po gsum sbyor gyi sman sna gsum po gang gang yin/lan/ cu gang dang / gur kum/ gi waṃ gsum mo/ /10 phyi rgyud phye ma'i le'ur bstan pa'i tsha sel gyi gnyen po rgyal blon rje'u bcas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyal po ga bur dang / blon po cu gang / rje'u gtso bo brgyad pa'i sbyor ba yin/11 rgyal po ga bur gyi sbyar thabs drug po de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ ga bur de la sbyar ba'i thabs drug ste/ / mi rgod lta

194 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bur gcig pur rkyang rgyugs dang / / dpa' bo lta bur mtshon cha bskur ba dang / / btsun mo lta bur 'jam sdebs btsal ba dang / / skyel ma lta bur dgra zun sbrag pa dang / / dmag dpon lta bur 'khor gyis bskor ba dang / /rgyal bu lta bur tshogs su 'don pa 'o/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /12 gtso bo brgyad pa'i sgror n+de dang phan yona' ltar yin/lan/ phyi ma rgyud las/ rje 'u gtso bo brgyad pa'i sbyor ba ni/ / bsil gyi gtso bo gi waṃ tsan dan dkar/ / rtsi yi gtso bo cu gang gur kum gnyis/ /thang gi gtso bo tig ta ba sha ka / sngo yi gtso bo hong len bong nga dkar/ / ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur rta la bskyon/ / don snod glo mchin khrag mkhris 'khrugs rims kyi/ / tshad pa gsar rnying ma lus 'joms par nges/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /12 se 'dru dngas ma gnas 'jog gi min sna ni gang dag yin/lan/ de ni se 'bru bzhi ba ste se 'bru/ shing tsha/ sug smel/ pi pi ling bcas kyi steng du gur kum bsnan pa yin/14 se 'bru'i sbyor ba spyi'i phan yon ci yin/lan/ rgyud las/ grang nad ma lus se 'bru'i phye mas sel pho ba'i bad kun sbyong zhing me drod skyed/ / dang ga 'byed cing kha zas len par byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar yin/15 phye ma'i sman rnams rtsi bzhin btags dgos pa'i mtshan ci/

sman gyi skor/ 195lan/ sman gyi nus pa che ba dang myur ba sogs zhib pa las 'byung bas na gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bzhin du zhib mor btags dgos pa yin/16 phye ma'i sbyar thabs ltar yin nam/lan/ de sogs phye ma gang yang sbyar ba'i thabs/ / tshad med cha mnyam gtsor smos thun tshad bskyed/ / tshad bshad tshad bzhin sbyar ba gces pa yin/ / zhes so/ /17 ril bu'i nges chig ci yin nam/lan/ ji skad du/ gang zhig sman rnams phye mar btags/ / brlan gyis sbrus la gong bur 'dril/ / 'di ni ril bu zhes byar bshad/ / ces pa 'di'o/ /1〈 ril bu'i sbyor ba la dgos pa khyad par can gang yod dam/lan/ nad rigs gang zhig gso bcos kyis gzhug bsrings te cod nas 'byin par byed pa dang / sman nus yun ring por mi yal ba dang / spyod stabs bde ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod/19 thun gsum cha mnyam ril bu zhes pa'i don ci dang smyor ba de'i phan yon ci yin nam/lan/ tshwa sna rnams thun gcig dang / 'bras bu gsum thun gcig tsha ba gsum thun gcig bcas thun gsum po cha mnyam byas nas sbyar ba'i sman la thun gsum cha mnyam ril bu zer zhing / de'i phan yon ni lhen gyi skran dang

196 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/mngal skran/ khrag skran sogs thal bar rlog par byed/20 sman gyi kha 'dzin dang / kha tshar/ kha bsgyur rnams don gcig pa yin nam/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir/lan/ de rnams kyi don mi gcig ste/ kha 'dzin ni sbyor sde'i sman gyi steng du don snod kyi nyen srung ba'i sman yin la/ kha tshar zhes pa ni sbyor sde yi nus pa ches cher 'phel bar byed pa'i man ngag myong grub kyi sman kha snon byed pa la bya/ kha bsgyur ni gnyen po nad thog tu 'khrid par byed pa'i sman la bya'o/ /21 khyang lnga'i sgor tshad dang cho ga'i lag len gyi rim pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ sbyor tshad ni bya khyung gi sha dang mtshungs pa'i a ru gser mdog zho bzhi dang / rus pa dang mtshungs pa'i ru rta zho gcig rgyus pa shu dag nag po zho gang gi sum gnyis/ snying btsan dug zho phyed/ khrag gla rtsi 'brum pa can zho gang gi sum cha gcig rnams sbyor/cho ga'i lag len ni/ thog mar a ru ra 'thag pa dang / de nas ru rta dang shu dag btsan dug gla rtsi rnams rim pas so sor zhib par btags/de nas gla rtsi bzhag ste gzhan rnams bsres nas skam 'thags 'them par byas te lo brgyad dri chus chu 'thag nyin gsum la bya/ byang ba'i tshad ni gnag la 'od 'tsher ba 'ong / de dus gla rtsi chur sbyangs nas ril bu bsgril dgos/

sman gyi skor/ 1mi22 gru gdon gyi skabs su bya khyung rnam lnga'i sgror ba gsungs skabs de la bde skyidamed na sha gnyis zi zhes pa'i don ci/lan/ bya khyung rnam lnga'i ril bu cho ga bzhin legs par sbyar ba de lo gcig tsam la bsten kyang bde skyid med na a ru ra zho bzhi yod pa zho dor phri ste phyed bcag byas nas lo dus bar du bston dgos pa'i don/22 khyung lnga'i bsten thabs dang phan yon ci 'dra yin/lan/ bya khyung rnam pa lnga yi ril bu 'di/ / srod dus lnga bdun dgu rnams rim pas btang / / pho log srin nad gnyan gzer gag lhog dang / /khyad par chu ser mdze nad 'joms pa'i mchog / ces pa 'di'o/ /24 bya khyung ril bu srod dus bsten pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ srod dus ni 'byung po 'du ba'am rgyu ba'i dus yin pa ma zad pho ba'i me drod bzang bas red/25 lde gu sbyar thabs0 lag lena' ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa bar/ de sogs lde gu'i sbyar thabs sbrang chu bcad/ / bu ram chur bsdus mar gyi wu snyigs phyungs/ / sman kun zhib btags bsres la 'dres par dkrug / ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab/ / 'ju tshod lon tsam khye'u sus bsten par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /26 lde guste'u sus dus la bsten dgos don ci yin/lan/ khye'u sus zhes pa skabs 'gar dus nges med du sman thun chung

198 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/chung yang yang du bston pa la bshad kyang / skabs 'dir nangs par tho rangs kyi dus la go dgos te/ de dus pho ba'i bad kun byang zhing zas ma zos pa rtsa sgo rnams kyang ma 'gags pas drod dang ldan zhing sman gyi nus mthu lhag tu che bas red/27 mnasar gyi nges chig cisananam/lan/ brang ti'i lag len pod chung las/ rtsi bcud sman rnams chur gdus shing / / de yi dwangs ma mar la bstims/ / de la sman mar zhes bya ste/ /lus zungs gso ba'i mchog tu gsungs/ / zhes so/ /2/ 'ba' sam sman mar ni sman myur gang gang bsres pa dang phan yon ci yin/lan/ spyir 'ba' sam zhes pa ni sna mang po mnyam du bsres pa'i don yin la/ 'ba' sam sman mar ni 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres nas sbyar ba'i sman mar la bya zhing / lus kyi stod smad bar gsum gyi nad kun la phan/29 ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar zhes pa'i ba yi rnam lnga bo gang dang gang yin/lan/ ba yi rnam lnga ni ba dmar zal gyi chu dang / lci ba/ 'o ma/ zho/mar bcas lnga'o/ /20 thal sman gyi bsregs thabs gnyis po gang dang gang yin nam/

sman gyi skor/ 17 lan/ har bsregs dang nus bsregs gnyis so/ /21 thal sman spyi'i sbyar thabs0 lag lena' ltar yin nam/lan/ kun kyang gar sla gzugs btub 'phang lo bya/ / ma spyad rdzar blug kha bcad mtshams mnan la/ / 'dag pa byugs la bye mas bar mtshams bcad/ / bong mes 'tshos par bsregs pa'i thal ba de/ / grangs nas zhib btags phye ma ril bu rung / / bu ram ka ra sbrang gi rta la bskyon/ / zhes pa ltar yin/22 thal sman spyi'i phan yon ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ ma zhu 'ju zhing pho ba'i me drod skyed/ / lhen dang skran bsheg bad kun lcags dreg 'gogs/ / skya rbab 'jil zhing thor dang dmu chu skem/ / man ngag grogs kyis bsgyur bas nad kun 'joms/ / zhes so /22 rdo thalas chos pa'i nyes skyon ci yin/lan/ 'di'i thad la bdud rtsi sgrom chung las/ rdo yi thal ba'i sman rnams ni/ / ma tshos sbyar ba dug sbyor yin/ / pho ba'i me gsod rtsa sbubs 'gag / nyen dang lcags dreg dmu skran skyed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar yin/24 cong zhi gtso byas pa'i thal sbyor la 'phrul thal zhes ming btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gong sman pas/ rta gdong me yis rgya mtsho skom pa bzhin/ /
