200 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/grang nad ma lus 'joms pa'i thabs 'di la/ / shin tu ngo mtshar khyad chos ldan pa'i phyir/ / 'phrul gyi thal ba zhes su grags pa yin/ / zhes gsungs/25 cong zhi 'phrul thal legs par tshos pa'i rtags lnga bo gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ 'phel nas kong bu khengs pa dang / dung phye ltar dkar po chags pa/ chu 'phrad na khol ba/ lcer myongs tshe 'jigs snyam byed pa/ sha rjen la byugs na me ltar tsha ba bcas lags/26 cong zhi da btul gyi tsha phab grang phab snyoms phab gsum gyi phab lugasa' ltar yin/ ma phab rang sor bzhagan nus pa ci 'drayin/lan/ rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i cong zhi rgod po sol mer tshos par bsregs nas dkar por song ba de chang gi nang sor sgra thon pa tsam gyis ngad bsad na tsha phab dang / chu'i nang du ngad bsad na grang phab/ dar ba'i nang du phab na snyoms phab yin/ gal te cong zhi ma phab par rang sor bzhag na nus pa shin tu tsha la rno bas bad kun grang nad la bsngags par bshad/27 khaṇ+ḍa ra thabs0 lag lena' ltar yinanam/lan/ rgyud las/ de sogs khaṇ+ḍa'i sde tshan sbyar ba'i thabs sa bshal khram khrum brdungs btsos khu ba bton/ / rnga mas legs btsags gtsang ma'i rdza nang bsdu/ / ma 'dregs dkrug cing skyo ma wu nag can/ chi/ de dus phog la thigs gcig rdo steng blug / de grang dril du btub na tshos tshad

smanagyiskor/ 201 yin/ / mtha' yi 'dregs pa mi btang grod pur btsa'/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /2/ rin po che la tshang dgos pa'i khyad chos drug po gang dang gangasan/lan/ ji skad du/ 'byung ba dkon dang dri ma med/ / mthu ldan spyi dang 'jig rten rgyan/ / mchog nyid gyur dang 'gyur ba med/ / de dag chos drug rin chen bzhag / ces so/ /29 rin chen grang sbyor gyi bsten thabs rnam dgu bo gang gang yin nam/lan/ g.ya' phyi ba dang / dug 'don pa/ 'jam btsal ba/ sna khrid pa/ bshig pa/ rtsa kha 'byed pa/ snod btang ba/ phyi bsrung ba/ nus pa bskyed pa bcas dgu'o/ /40 rin chen sbyor ba spyi'i phan yon ci yin nam/lan/ khrag mkhris bad rlung bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ / mgo dang byang khog yan lag rma rnams dang / / dmu 'or mdze 'bras gag lhog gnyan nad dang / / klu gnyan rgyal po la sogs 'byung bo'i gdon/ / rin po che yis mi sel 'ga' yang med/ / nad gzhi med pa'i mi la bcud len 'gyur/ / zhes rgyud las gsungs pa 'di'o/ /41 rdzo sbyor skabs kyi gces pa'i yan lag bdun zhes pa de gang dang gang yin nam/

202 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ rgyud las/ skye sar skyes dang dus su btus pa dang / / skam gsed legs dang so ma rnyings pa dang / / dug 'don 'jam btsal 'phrod par sbyar ba'o/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di yin/ /42 so ma rnyings zhes pa'i go dona' ltarayin nam/lan/ sngo sman gang yang btus nas lo dus 'das na nus pa 'chor ba'i phyir/ so ma rnyings zhes pa ni lo dus las ma yol zhing nus pa ma rnyings pa'i don no/ /42 rdzo sman gyi rtsa ba dang sdong po yal ga lo ma me tog 'bras bu pags pa bar shun bcas0 dug gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa ba'i sman rigs kyi dug ni phyi'i pags pa de yin zhing / sdong po'i sman rigs kyi dug ni nang dkyil gyi rkang skya sob/ yal ga'i dug ni tshigs pa/ lo ma'i dug ni ngar ba zhes lo ma'i yu ba de nyid yin/ me tog gi dug ni de'i gos sam phyi'i thum skogs lta bu de dang / 'bras bu'i rigs kyi dug ni nang gi rus pa/ pags pa'i dug ni phyi'i nyi char gyis gdungs pa'i dreg pa nag po/ bar shun gyi dug ni nang gi sha gdan zhes shun pags 'og gi skyi shun srab mo de nyid dor dgos/44 sngo sman gyi skabs su zho rkang chi ba gsum la dug med de zhes pa la go ba' ltar len dgos/lan/ sngo sman gyi zho dang rkang tshi ba'am thang chu'i rigs las byung ba'i

sman gyi skor/ 203sman rigs rnams la dug gtan nas med pa ma yin zhing / de gsum dug dang dbyer med du 'dres pas gzhan ltar 'di yin zhes 'dor rgyu med pas de bzhin gsungs pa'o/ /45 bshal sman rtsi skams nus pa gting 'gro'i dus/ / skyugs man kha 'bus rgyan 'dren dus sa brta/ / zhes pa ltar brta dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan /rjemi risi riri riri lan/ bshal sman rnams phyi'i 'byung khams kyi rtsi tog bskams nas sa chu'i nus pa thur du 'bab pa'i ston mjug la btus na/ de dus bshal sman gyi gtso bo dur byid dang thar nu lta bu'i rtsa ba la lci 'jam snum mnyen sogs sa sman dang chu sman gyi nus pa shin tu mnga' ba dang / ri sho dang spyang tsher la sogs skyugs sman rnams sngo dang rtsi shing kha 'bus pa'i dpyid dus lta bu ste/me rlung gi nus pa gyen du rgyu ba'i dus la btus na me gyen du 'bar ba'i rang bzhinadang chos mtshungs par yang g.yo rno ba sogs me sman dang rlung sman gyi nus pa shin tu mnga' bas de mthun gyi bshal dang skyugs kyi nus pa myur du thon pas red/46 rdzo yisang sbyor chen mo man sna gang dag las grub pa yin/lan/ sngo yi mang sbyor chen mo ni rtsa ba drug ste ra mnye dang / nye shing /ba spru/ la phug lca ba/ btsong bcas dang / lo ma lnga ste lce tsha dang / dbyi mong dkar po/ srub na zwa po/ da lis bcas dang / me tog gcig ste ra

204 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/dug pa'i me tog 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi ste thang phrom nag po dang / star bu/gze ma/ lcam pa bcas dang / tshwa gsum thal ba ste ze tshwa dang / bul togabyang tshwa bcas dang / thal ba gnyis te cong zhi rgod btul dang bya thal bcas bu ram dang sbyar ba las grub pa dang / mdor na rtsa ba drug dang lo ma lnga/ me tog gcig 'bras bu bzhi/ tshwa gsum/ thal ba gnyis bcas sbyar ba yin no/ /47 zhi byed lag len gyi go rim thang gye ril bu bcas sgrig pa'i dgos pa dngakhyad chos ci yin nam/lan/ nad gang yin yang thog mar smin sdud 'byed pa la ros las byed cing nus pa rno myur dang ldan pa'i thang sbyor bstan pa dang / des ma sel na nadakyi ngo bo gzhom pa la zhu rjes kyis las byed pa'i phye ma'i sbyor ba/ de nas nad lhag gting nas 'don pa la nus pas las byed cing byed las cung zad dal ba'i ril bu'i sbyor ba/ 'di gsumathos dang byed las dang nus pa'i go rim dang mthun par 'brel ba'o/ / rnyings shing zhen pa'i nad lhag 'don par lde gu'i sbyor ba dang / lus stobs skyed cing dbang bo gsal bar byed pa sman mar gyi sbyor ba/ grang nad gtso cher sel ba thal sman gyi sbyor ba/ tsha ba'i nad shas cher sel ba khaṇ+ḍa'i sbyor ba/ rlung ldan shas cher sel ba sman chang gi sbyor ba/ nad pa 'byor ldan gyi rjes su 'dzin pa'am zhi byed de rnams kyi log gnon la rin po che'i sbyor ba/ dbul phongs kyi nad pa rnams rjes su 'dzin

sman gyi skor/ 205pa'am glo bur thug phrad kyi nad la sngo sbyor/ de dag gnas skabs kyi dbang gis 'brel lo/ /48 zhi byed sde bcu bo n+de tshan lnga'i nang du sdud tshula' ltarayinaram/lan/ thal sman phye ma'i khongs su bsdu ba dang / sman chang sman mar du bsdu ba/ khaṇ+ḍa lde gur bsdu ba/ rin po che ril bur bsdu ba/ sngo sbyor thang gi khongs su bsdu ba'o/ /sa bcad gsum pa/ sbyong byed las/1 sbyong byed las lnga so so'ikhyad chos ci yin/lan/ khrag mkhris sogs rgyu long gi nad thur du drangs pa la bshal dang /bad kun lcags dreg sogs pho ba'i nad gyen du 'dren pa la skyugs/ nam tshong yan gyi nad la sna sbyong / rlung nad sogs lte 'og man gyi nad 'jam por sbyong ba la 'jam rtsi/ nyes gsum 'dus pa'i nad thur du drangs pa la ni ru ha bcas lags/2 sdum 'chos las lnga'i sngon 'gror 'jog don ci/lan/ de'u dmar bas/ de yang las lnga'i sngon 'gro snum 'chos don/ / nad rnams kun gyi sna 'dren mjug sdud rlung / / yin phyir de gnon 'gegs par byed pas na/ / snum 'chos sngon du 'gro ba ma byas gong / / las lnga gang yang btsams par mi bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar

206 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/sbyong byed las lnga'i sngon du snum 'chos byed pa ni rlung kha gnon pa'am rlung gi gegs zhi bar byed pa dang / lus zungs dang rgyu rtsi bsrung ba/ gnyen po'i sman dpyad rnams theg thub pa sogs kyi dgos par gzhigs nas thog mar snum 'chos byed dgos pa gal che bar bstan no/ /2 rtsam 'chos gtong skabs zhun mar dang 'dru mar sogs dus gang la lhag tu bsngags pa yin/lan/ rgyud las/ zhun mar dgun dus 'bru mar dbyar btang bsngags/ / rkang tshil dpyid dus nyin mor bsngags pa yin/ / zhes gsungs/4 sna sel gyi sbyor ba sman sna gang dag las grub pa dang / bshal gtong skabs thog mar sna sel gyi sbyor ba gtong dgos don ci/lan/ sna sel gyi sbyor ba ni a ru mchu ring lhum rtsa chu ma rtsi rgyam tsha pi pi ling bcas las grub cing / bshal gyi sdun la sna sel gyi sbyor ba gtong don ni/lto ba sra snyi brtag pa sna sel te/ / sna sel zhes bya lto ba'i sad mda' yin/ /zhes pa ltar lto ba'i sra snyi brtags te ded dpon gyi thun tshad shes pa'i slad yin/5 ded dpon bzhi sgror gyi sman rnamasa' ltar 'dul dgos/lan/ ded dpon a ru mchu ring dan rog dang / / shrī khaṇ+ḍa dur byin rnam pa bzhi/ / a ru ra ni thal tshan gseb tu gdul/ / darnga rog po lce

sman gyi skor/ 207gdon phye ma gdul/ / shrī khaṇ+ḍa mar dkar nang du gdul/ / dur byid rkang shun dug phral yos su gdul/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di ltar bya/6 bshal sman la btang tshul rigs du dang de dag so so'i btang yul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ btang tshul thang phye ril bu sman mar bzhi/ / rgas dang zungs ngan rnams la bskol thang shes/ / de yis btang bzhag ran par tshod zin 'gyur/ / zungs bzang nad rgyas phye ma ril bu shes/ / de yang skyug pa rnams la ril bu btang / / shin tu lto sra skyug lang yod pa la/ / sman mar sbyar te gsang la rgyun sbyongs bya/ / sman dred yi ga sdar na zas dang sdeb/ / ces gsungs/7 mgo dang nam tshong yan chad kyi nad la sna sman bsngags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/lan/ yan lag brgyad par/ nam tshong yan chad nad rnams la/ /lhag par sna nas btang ba phan/ / sna ni klad pa'i sgo yin te/ / des na de nas nad de 'choms/ / zhes pa las 'thus snyam// 'jam rtsi la sle 'jam bkru 'jam bkru ma slen gsum du dbye ba'i dgos pa ci yin nam/lan/ rlung nad las mi 'da' ba'i 'jam rtsi'i sbyor ba la sle 'jam dang /bkru 'jam/ bkru ma slen bcas gsum yod pa de yang rlung rkyang ba la sle

208 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'jam dang / rlung dang mkhris pa ldan pa la bkru 'jam/ rlung dang bad kun ldan pa la bkru ma slen sbyar ba yin/kha 'jam rtsi'i mnarta rab 'bring tha gsum po gang dang gang yin/lan/ mar la sbyar ba ni rab dang / sha khu la sbyar ba 'bring / 'o ma la sbyar ba tha ma yin/ sha khu'i grogs ni 'o ma dang / 'o ma'i grogs mar gces/10 rtsa sbyongs la sna sel dang mdung man gtong dgos don ci yin/lan/ sna sel btang na dngos gzhi sman gyis myur du 'bigs par byed pa dang / mdung sman btang na nad slong zhing 'khrugs par byed pas red/ /11 byang ba'i bzang ngan brtag tshula' ltar yin nam/lan/ byang ba dmar khra skyi tsher dang srad ma'i gseb tu gnas pa de nyid bdapa che ba dang ston ser gyi dus glo bur du gri shi byas pa bzang ba yin la/ngan pa ni ser khra yog mo dang lo'i gseb tu gnas pa de nyid dbyar char che zhing nam gzhug char dus rang bzhin gyis shi ba ngan pa yin no/ /12 byang ba'i dug gang yin pa dang de dbyung dgos don ci yin nam/lan/ byang ba'i dug ni bar gshog dkar po de yin zhing de ma phral na zug gzer che bas dbyung dgos/12 log gnon zhes pa der go ba' ltar len dgos sam/lan/ 'di la don mi 'dra ba gnyis mchis te/ nus pa'i dbang du bshad na sman gzhan las stobs log po ste ldab gcig gi che ba'i don dang /

sman gyi skor/ 209byed las kyi dbang du bshad na sman gzhan gyis log pa'i las mi mthun pa rnams kha gnon pa dang 'joms pa'i don la 'jug pas skabs thob tu go dgos/14 zhi byed dang sbyong byed dpyad gsum gyi log gnon gang dang gang yin/lan/ zhi byed sde tshan bcu'i log gnon rin po che'i sbyor ba dang /sbyong byed sde tshan lnga'i log gnon ni rtsa sbyongs/ dpyad sde lnga'i log gnon ni thur ma'o/ /sa bcad bzhi pa/ sman sbyor kha thor gyi skor/1 sbyar man mang sne can dang nyung sne can gnyis0khyad chos ཿyin/lan/ sman sna mang na nus pa 'jam pas gtso bo'i nad la phan zhing gzhan la phog thug mi 'byung ba bcas 'du ba spyi snyoms kyi nas pa ldan/ sman sna nyung na nus pa rno yang cung zad rtsub pas gzhan la gnod/2 khong sman thams cad mid pa brgyud nas po bar babs pa des ji ltar byas te glo ba dang snying sogasakyi nad la phan pa yin/lan/ khab len rdo yis lcags kyu len pa bzhin glo ba sogs gang nad yod pa'i gnas der sman nus rtsar khrid nas nad la phan par byed ces gong sman pas gsungs/

210 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/2 bsil bcud bco lnga rgun sman gang dang gang sbyar ba yin/lan/ de ni bsil gtso bo brgyad pa dang bcud a gar brgyad pa gnyis sbyar ba yin la/ sman sbyor de gnyis la sman sna bcu drug yod dgos mod de gnyi ga'i nang cu gang yod pa gcig tu dril nas bsil bcud bco lnga zhes brjod/4 min bral zer zhes pa sman sbyor gang dang gang sdeb pa yin/lan/ de ni nor bu bdun thang dang gtso bo brgyad pa gnyis sbyar ba'o/ /5 a gar bco lnga ni sman sbyor gang dang gang bsres pa yin/lan/ de ni a gar brgyad pa dang nor bu bdun thang gnyis bsres pa yin/6 zhi byed bcu gcig gi gzhi rtsa'i sman sbyor gang yin pa dang sbyar mkhan su yin/lan/ zhi byed bcu gcig gi gzhi rtsa'i sman sbyor ni zhi byed drug pa yin la/ 'di ni jo mo sman mo'i phyag bzhes yin/7 kun sel man ngag 'dzam gling nor phyed du grags pa'i sman sbyor 'di gang yin nam/lan/ de ni mo nad kyi spyi sman 'ol se nyer lnga yin no/ /ra bang chen nyer lnga dang smug po g.yul rgyal/ g.yu dril bcu gsum/

sman gyi skor/ 211ga bur nyer lnga/ gtso bo nyer lnga/ mgrin mtshal nyer lnga bcas kyi ming gzhan la gang dang ci zer/lan/ thang chen nyer lnga'i ming gzhan la gur kum nyer lnga dang / smug po g.yul rgyal la stod lugs cong zhi nyer gcig g.yu dril bcu gsum la ru rta bcu gsum/ ga bur nyer lnga la gting 'don nyer lnga/ gtso bo nyer lnga la wa glo nyer lnga/ mgrin mtshal nyer lnga la bong khrag nyer lnga bcas zer/rdzo bang chen nyer lnga sbyar mkhan su dang nus pa ཿyin/ sman 'di thang ma gtogs phye ma dang ril bu ru sbyar chog gam/lan/ thang chen nyer lnga ni zhug pa gdong nag gis gsar du sbyar ba yin la/ nus pa ni dug dang smug po tshad rnying byer ba sdud ba dang / 'du ba tsha grang snyoms par byed pa bcas yin/ sman 'di thang du gsungs kyang phye ma'am ril bu sbyar nas dbul chog10 bdud rtsi gsum sbyor gyi man sna gsum po gang gang yin/ sman sbyor 'di'i phan yon ci yin nam/lan/ bdud rtsi gsum sbyor la sbyar lugs du ma yod kyang ches rgyun bkol gyi sbyor ba ni cong zhi dang 'jib rtsi(spru yang kunam nu gsum sdeb pa la bya/de'i nang gi bdud rtsi zhes pa ni cong zhi la bzhed/ phan yon ni/ bdud rtsi gsum sbyor zhes bya ste/ / zhib btags gar chang rta la skyon/ / stod du bad khrag rgyas pa dang / / smad du mchin khrag lhung ba dang / / brang tsha chu skyur

212 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/skyugs pa dang / / mgo dang yan lag la sogs kyi/ / rus chag lugs su 'dzud pa dang / / bad mkhris za khu gcod pa'i mchog / ces gsungs pa ltar yin/11 tsan dan sro lo a grong bong nga kyi lce spang rgyan bcas drug po lhan du sdeb pa la dkar po drug myur zer don ci/lan/ de ni sman sna de drug po'i kha dog dkar po yin pa'i cha nas de ltar btags pa yin/12 rat+na bsam 'phel gyi gzhi rtsa'i sman myur gang yin zhing ming de ltar btags pa'i mtshan ci/lan/ rat+na bsam 'phel ni bsam 'phel nor bu'i steng sman sna mang po bsnananas sdeb pa yin la/ rat+na zhes pa ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin la bod skad du bsgyur na rin po che zer ba dang / de ni nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung la sbyar nas btags pa yin/12 gso byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi rtsa'i sman sbyor ni gang yin nam/lan/ de ni rgyud kyi se 'bru lnga ba gtso byas pa yin/14 rta zi'i ming thogs tshul dang ril bu'i mdog dmar po byed don ci yinanam/lan/ rta zhes pa ni rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i las tshogs las byung

sman gyi skor/ 213bas rta dang / zi ni me stag 'phro ba bzhin me 'bar ba'i zi ra dang sgo mtshungs par ril bu 'di btang ba tsam gyis tsha ba gnyan rims kyi nad rnams 'joms par byed pas ming de ltar btags pa dang / rta mgrin gyi na bza'i mdog dmar po yin pas ril bu 'di yi dam lha'i rang mdog dang mtshungs par mtshal gyis dmar po bsgyur ba yin/15 bde byed snyoms ldan zhes pa'i ming 'di' ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ sman 'di bsten pa tsam gyis me stong chu blugs pa nang bzhin pho ba sbos pa dang / 'tshangs pa/ 'khrog pa sogs med par ba3 bar byed r+pādab/ 'du ba'aphelazad 'khrugasagasumadu mgyur par snyosprasapar byed pa'i nusapasminapasabyed lasakyi sgo nasade ltar btags yin/16 'bam gyi gsang sman dkar nag gnyis ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ gsang sman dkar po bod kyi la phug dang gsang sman nag po btsong gnyis yin/17 rkang 'bam smad du 'bebs byed kyi man sbyor gsum po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ de ni ar glang gser gsum ste a gar so lnga dang / glang chen

214 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/bco brgyad/ gser thang bco brgyad gsum mo/ /1/ zin tig gi rlung sman skabs bstan pa'i gnyan 'joms bzhi ni gang dang gangayin nam/lan/ tshad pa'i 'go 'joms byed la ga bur dang / rlung la a gar rigs gsum/ don lnga bsrung bar bzang po drug 'du ba cha snyoms par 'bras bu gsum bcas lags/19 ri 'dra zhig la dngul chu btso bkru chen mo zer/lan/ k+ṣa ra rnam gsum dang / za byed rdo brgyad/ 'ching byed lcags brgyad bcas kyi nang du dngul chu btso ba dang / bkru ba/ sbyangs pa/ 'dul ba bcas byas te dngul chu'i dug phyir bsal nas bcud du len pa'i rdzas mchog tu bsgyur ba'i thabs la bya/2༷ dngul chu'i dug gsum po gang gang yin/lan/ lci ba'i dug dang / 'jigs pa'i dug rtsi'i dug bcas gsum mo /21 dngul chu rigs gsum mam dngul chu'i 'byung khungs gsum ni gang gang yin/lan/ rdo las byung ba'i dngul chu dang / srog chags las byung ba'i dngul chu/ sngo las byung ba'i dngul chu bcas gsum yin/22 dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i skabs k+ṣa ra rnam gsum zhes pa de

sman gyi skor/ 215gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ de ni na ra k+ṣa ra nad med byis pa lo brgyad can gyi dri chu dang /a shwa k+ṣa ra rta gseb sngon po'i dri chu/ go ba k+ṣa ra ba dmar zal gyi chu bcas gsum gyi bsdus ming ngo / /22 za byedakhams brgyad po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ byed las la bltas nas btags pa'i dngul chu'i dug za bar byed pa'i gser rdo dang / dngul rdo/ chu skyur rdo/ pha wang long bu/ khab len/ba bla/ ldong ros/ lhang tsher bcas brgyad do/ /24 'ching byed lcags brgyad po gang gang yin/lan/ dngul chu'i dug 'ching byed kyi gser dang / dngul/ zangs/lcags/ gsha' dkar/ ra gan/ 'khar ba/ zha nye bcas brgyad kyi bsdus ming yin/25 gser gyi g.ya' pyi ba'isnas gsum po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ chang skyur dang / bul tog tsha la bcas gsum yin/26 lag len gyi skabs su lcags brgyad kyi nang nas zangs de thog mar bsreg dgos don ci yin/lan/ lcags brgyad las zangs ni bsreg sla shos yin pas rten 'brel gyi dbang gis de nyid thog mar bsreg pa yin/27 skyurak+ṣa gsum zhes pa gang dang gang gi khu ba yin/

216 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/lan/ skyur khu gsum ni chang / star bu'i khu ba/ mtshur nag gi khu ba bcas gsum mo/ /2/ dngul chu btso brgyad dang dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad nang gi dngul chu'i 'dul thabs la khyad par ci yod dam/lan/ dngul chu bco brgyad nang gi dngul chu ni tsha 'dul yin la/dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad nang gi dngul chu ni grang 'dul yin/29 dngul chu tsha 'dul dang grang 'dul la ming gi rnam grangs gang gang yod/lan/ dngul chu tsha 'dul la nag 'dul lam drag 'dul zer ba dang /dngul chu grang 'dul la dkar 'dul lam zhi 'dul zhes kyang bya/20 dngul chu legs par grub pa'i byang tshada' ltar yinanam/lan/ dkar yol nang du chu gtsang blugs pa'i khar btso thal cung zad btaban chu'i khar sprin bzhin khyab ste zhabs su mi snyigs na zhag pa'i rtags dang / chu'i khar 'dril ba'am phyogs gcig tu spungs pa/ yang na zhabs su snyigs na ma zhag pa'i rtags yin pas bskyar du 'dul dgos/21 dgas po'i sman nag ces pa'i man 'di gsar du sbyar mkhan su yin nam/lan/ dwags sman bco lnga'am bco lnga drag sbyor/ dwags po'i sman nag ces pa 'di ni bka' brgyud gong ma rnam gsum gyi ya gyal mnyam med dwags po

sman gyi skor/ 217lha rje yis sbyar ba yin/22 dmya nga sel ba'i dar yagan zhes pa'i man de gang yin nam/lan/ de ni sga tig nag po la bya/22 rin chen zhags pa'i sgor ba zhes pa de sman sbyor gang gi ming gi rnam grangs yin nam/lan/ de ni phyi rgyud ga bur bcu bzhi'i ming gzhan zhig yin la zin tig tu ga bur rin chen zhags sbyor kyang zer/24 gser mdog lnga ba zhes pa'i ming de' ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ sman sbyor 'di'i nang a ru gser mdog gtso bo'i sman byas pas de ltar btags pa yin/25 khrag rlung stod 'tshangs smad du 'bebs byed kyi man gser thang bco brgyadakyi minga' ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ de ltar brjod don ni khrag rlung smad du 'bebs par byed par nus pa ches cher thon pa rtsa chen gser lta bu yin pas so/ /24 rlung nad skabs kyi 'don bzhi'i zhib phra'i lag len dang phan yon ji ltar yin nam/lan/ man rgyud las/ 'don la dkar 'don dmar 'don skyur 'don dang / / sgog 'don bzhi las dang po tsag bcad mar/ / tshoms phye 'ol skom sbyar ba 'o mar btsos/ / sga dang rgyam tsha btab pa dkar 'don

218 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/yin/ / lug sha'i khu bar sbyar ba dmar 'don no/ / skyur 'don khugs pa'i glum la nye 'u byas/ / mar rnying bu ram sga btab btsos pa 'o/ / sgog 'don sgog skya tshos par btsos la bsdur/ / mar dang rus khu rgyam tsha'i phye btab btso/ / de rnams gang yang rlung nad ma lus 'joms/ / lus kyi stobs skyed dbang shes gsal bar byed/ / ri thang mtshams kyi rlung la bdud rtsi 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /27 zan bu'i nad nywa log bcos skabs bstan pa'i 'dod chags rtse mo dang / zhe sdang chil bu/ gti mug 'khor lo/ ban+de'i mkhris pa/ bon po'i thalab/ 'dre 'jigs thang chu/ brtan po'i dreg pa/ dri can lte ba zhes pa rnams sman gang dang gang gi gab mingayin/lan/ 'dod chags rtse mo ni bya pho'i ze ba dang / zhe sdang tshil bu ni sbrul gyi tshil/ gti mug 'khor lo ni phag pa'i sna/ ban+de'i mkhris pa ni ngang ser gyi mkhris pa/ bon po'i thal ba ni phug ron brun nus bsreg gi thal ba/ 'dre 'jigs thang chu ni gu gul nag po/ brtan po'i dreg pa ni pha bong gi dreg pa/dri can lte ba ni gla rtsi'o/ /2ra gas pa gso skabs rtsi bzhi dngas ma lnga yi bcud len zhes pa'i rtsi bzhi dang dngas ma lnga ni gang gang yin/lan/ rgyud chen las/ rtsi bzhi dwangs ma lnga yi bcud blangs pa/ / sa yi dwangs ma brag zhun sha yi gsos/ / rdo yi dwangs ma cong zhi rus pa'i

sman gyi skor/ 219gsos/ / shing gi dwangs ma bu ram stobs kyi gsos/ / me tog dwangs ma sprang rtsi mdangs kyi gsos/ / rtsi yi dwangs ma mar dkar bcud kyi gsos/ /shug 'bru ba lu mtshe dang mkhan pa bzhi/ / dgun mi skams pa tshe yi gsos su 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /29 skom gyi mchog tu shong dkar rtse mo mchog ces pa'i shong dkar rtse mo 'di gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ shong dkar rtse mo zhes pa 'di la bshad tshul gnyis yod pa las/byang lugs ltar na rgya nag gi ja zhig gi rtse mo la ngos 'dzin pa dang / zur lugs ltar na shong dkar ni 'o ma dang / rtse mo ni dang po'am bzhos thog gi don yin pas/ shong dkar rtse mo ni bzhos thog 'o ma dron mo yin zer/40 garnya bha dra ni skabs thob tu go dgos pa'i sman zhig yin pas gnyan dang mkhal ma dug nad bcas kyi skabs su gang dang gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ spyir garnya bha dra ni sngo sman gyi rigs shig yin na'ang sgra gcig la don mang pas skabs 'byed dgos te/ gnyan dang tshad pa sogs kyi skabs su ga lha dra zer ba byung na spang spos dang / de bzhin du kha dang so dang mkhal ma'i skabs su go yu/ dreg dang cham pa dug bad kun skya bo skran nad bcas kyi skabs su sngo sman rang yin pas skabs dang bstun pa gces so/ /41 sha sna gnyis zhes pa yang skabs thob tu go dgos pas mkhal nad

220 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/gso ba dang gdon nad gso skabs kyi sha sna gnyis po gang dang gang la go dgos/lan/ mkhal nad gso skabs sha sna gnyis zhes byung na lug 'bras dang da byid gnyis la go dgos shing / gdon nad gso skabs byung na sbal ba'i sha dang sprul gyi sha la go dgos so/ /42 brag ban ni skabs thob tu go dgos pa'i sman zhig yin la mig nad dang skyan nad rlung rims bcas0 skabs su gang dang gang la go dgos/lan/ mig nad kyi skabs su rdo sman mtshur sngon de rang dang / skran nadakyi skabs su byung na tsha la bsregs pa'i thal ba/ rlung nad kyi skabs su sgog skya'i thal ba la 'jug42 man du gtong ba'i phya tshan gsum po gang dang gangayin nam/lan/ mi rta khyi gsum gyi phru gu skyes ma thag nu zho khong du ma song gong gi brun gyi gab ming yin/44 bad gan grang nad la gces par bzung ba'i sman myur bzhi bo gang gang yin/lan/ gong sman pas/ rdo zhun sbyor bas skran rnams brko/ / tshwa yi sbyor bas be snabs bzhu/ / se 'bru'i sbyor bas me drod skyed/ / dwa lis sbyor bas bad spangs zhi/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di'o/ /45 mgyogs me sbyor ba'i phan yon dang ming de ltar btags pa'i rgyu

mtshan ci/lan/ mkhris sna tshogs tshad dang gur kum a wa sogs chu grang la sbyar te khong du btang na khrag gcod pa'i nus pa me yis rtsa kha sdom pa nang bzhin shin tu mgyogs pas mgyogs me zhes su btags pa yin no/ / / / dge legs 'phel/

222dpyad gzhi'i'ag cha/1 g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos mdzad pa'i 〈〈bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud〉〉/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1982lo'i zla3par bskrun/2 khyung po tse tse sogs kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po〉〉/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1985lo'i zla 7par bskrun/2 rdo rje rgyal pos bsgrigs pa'i 〈〈gso ba rig pa'i rtsa 'grel bdam bsgrigs〉〉/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1986lo'i zla 6par bskrun/4 dbang 'dus kyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈gso ba rig pa'i tshig mdzod g.yu thog dgongs rgyan〉〉/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1982lo'i zla 12par bskrun/5 de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈shel gong shel phreng 〉〉mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1986lo'i zla 1par bskrun/6 zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po dang dar mo blo bzang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈mes po'i zhal lung 〉〉/ krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1989lo'i zla 10par bskrun/

dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/ 2237 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mchos mdzad pa'i 〈〈be+e ḍūr sngon po〉〉/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1982lo'i zla 3par bskrun/ra g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po sogs kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈g.yu thog cha lag bco brgyad〉〉/ kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1999lo'i zla 11par bskrun/9 skyem pa tshe dbang gis mdzad pa'i 〈〈rgyud bzhi'i rnam bshad〉〉/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 2000lo'i zla 4par bskrun/1༷ khro ru tshe rnam gyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈rgyun bzhi'i 'grel chen drang srong zhal lung 〉〉/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 2001lo'i zla 10par bskrun/11 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉〉/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 1992lo'i zla 6par bskrun/12 byams pa 'phrin las kyis bcoms pa'i 〈〈gangs ljongs gso rig bstan pa'i nyin byed rim byon gyi rnam thar〉〉/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 2000lo'i zla 5par bskrun/12 bod ljongs sman rtsis khang gis bsgrigs pa'i 〈〈bod lugs gso rig tshig mdzod chen mo〉〉/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2006lo'i zla 8par bskrun/14 skal bzang 'phrin las kyis bcoms pa'i 〈〈bod kyi gso rig byung

224 bod kyi gso rig skor gyi shes bya dris lan blo gsal nyer mkho/'phel gyi lo rgyus〉〉/ krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis 1997lo'i zla 1par bskrun/15 krung go'i bod kyi gso rig ces pa'i dus deb tu 'khod pa'i bya mdo klu byams rgyal dang dpal chen gsang bdag gnyis kyis bod kyi gso rig skor gyi bgro gleng 2009lo'i deb 2pa'i bar cha tshang /16 bod ljongs bod lugs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i 2006dang 2007lo'i gso rig shes bya'i 'gran tshogs kyi dris lan phyogs bsgrigs/(nang khul gyi yig cha)17 rgyal yongs mtho rim slob grwa'i bod lugs gso rig ched las slob deb rtsom zhus u yon lhan tshogs kyis sne khrid nas bsgrigs pa'i dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod lugs gso rig dngos tshan slob gso'i 'char 'god slob deb cha tshang / mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2004lo'i zla 7par bskrun/1/ yum pas brtsams pa'i 〈〈rtsis rig la 'jug pa'i sgo〉〉/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2006lo'i zla 4par bskrun/19 rin chen rgyal gyis bcoms pa'i 〈〈bod kyi skye dngos sman rdzas rig pa'i spyi don〉〉/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis spyi lo 2004lo'i zla 12par bskrun/20 rang nyid slob gnyer byed skabs kyi zin bris/

shām lhag 'chin chikhur pa/ spya ma:spya 'asbya/zlodunaklo ga hās lhagod pa/ snros lhad /da rgyu//bod kyi gso rigasor gyi shes〉rgyadres lanatsātshanasal5)ra mkho/:rkyeXr+sha/na/ spya /// sdo/ṭā zlo/ /dro gi/ bod yig rtsom sgrig khang /k+ṣaX/dzo shās/ /myi (2 /sdu ho phing li byang lam ang 4pa/ṅgha sdu /sngur+shar+sha// bye/ sdu sdi hā /sdu ༷ 〉〉 sna sh+yi sditā sditā shā/nga /byebye snroX sgrig thengs/༷sgyi/ dri pasdo dro trī sna sdi kārji trī ཿgyi/dri/ po brgyab/rinagong tsos97//7diX3—0652—3 358bod17
— rte —sa wa je zhu ci3/ma—— 4
